body:
| | Peter — In both the trauma bay and the Air Force, I learned that to find solutions, we need to focus on the cold, difficult facts. So here’s the reality:

Our **state is 28th in the nation in education.** When compared to other states, we spend roughly **$4,000 less** than the national average on per-pupil spending. **53.5% of our students are at risk of dropping out** , and our teachers are paid **$7,000 less than the national average.**

Our students and teachers are struggling while **gun violence threatens their safety and extremist politicians push their political agenda in the classroom.**

| | | | If you haven't chosen AMAC over AARP yet, you may want to reconsider.

Dear Fellow Friend,

I wanted to bring your attention to an important issue that affects many of us as we approach our senior years. Recently, Republican Senator Rand Paul shed light on the concerning transformation of AARP (formerly known as the American Association of Retired Persons), which has raised questions about its true mission and commitment to seniors. I'd like to share some of Senator Paul's quotes from his article from Townhall, which highlight the issues at hand:
---

| | | | _"Today, AARP primarily functions as a marketing and advocacy tool for United Health, the largest health insurance company in the United States."_

_"AARP's revenue is not primarily derived from membership dues but from lucrative corporate royalty arrangements, notably their highly profitable deal with UnitedHealth, one of the nation's largest health insurance conglomerates."_

_"During the heated Obamacare debate, AARP threw its support behind it, despite the strong opposition of its members. It seems apparent that the allure of mandatory, subsidized health insurance proved to be a significant triumph for UnitedHealth."_

_"AARP strategically invests hundreds of millions of dollars in advertising and events that align with the Democratic Party's policy priorities, subtly influencing voting preferences."_
---

| | | | These quotes underscore the fact that AARP may no longer be the organization it once was, prioritizing the well-being of seniors. Instead, it seems to be more focused on advancing the interests of corporate entities and aligning with partisan politics.

As freedom-loving patriots, we deserve an organization that genuinely advocates for our needs and values - for the values enshrined in our Constitution - that have made America the greatest nation on earth. That's why I'd like to introduce you to the Association of Mature American Citizens (AMAC), the conservative alternative to AARP. AMAC offers comparable services while embracing a more free-market perspective and avoiding any liberal bias.

_First and foremost, AMAC stands for conservative values._

AMAC's commitment to advocacy is evident through AMAC Action, its sister nonprofit organization that advances conservative initiatives at all levels of government. Members can participate in grassroots advocacy efforts to support AMAC's mission, ensuring that the voices of its two million members are heard in Congress, the White House, and the national media.

AMAC Action has participated in over one thousand in-person meetings with congressional leaders, ensuring that your voice is heard on Capitol Hill. AMAC Action is actively fighting for you on the issues that matter - like censorship and suppression on our First Amendment rights, election integrity, stopping the left's efforts to indoctrinate our children and grandchildren at school, and defending the sanctity of human life at all stages.

_Second, AMAC provides members with exceptional money-saving benefits._

Joining AMAC gives you access to a host of money-saving benefits including special rates on cell phones and plans, insurance products, travel and lodging discounts, vision and dental products, financial products, health and wellness products, and so much more!

_Third, AMAC is a source of uncensored information that you can trust._

All AMAC members receive our bi-monthly AMAC Magazine and access to fresh website content powered by the AMAC Newsline team, our Better For America Podcast featuring interviews with America's thought leaders, newsletters, video content, and an app that delivers insightful coverage of the news and issues that matter most.

Here are some key findings from a recent poll conducted by McLaughlin and Associates for American Commitment, which reveal concerns among voters aged 55 and older:
* Over 80% of AARP members worry that the organization receives billions in corporate royalties from health insurance giants like United Healthcare, all while actively lobbying lawmakers and government officials on matters related to drug and insurance costs.
* Shockingly, 80% of these members are unaware that AARP endorsed and supported Biden's Inflation Reduction Act, which brought about changes to Medicare.
* An overwhelming 85% express concerns that these changes could hinder the development of groundbreaking medical advancements and cures for chronic diseases.

It is clear that many seniors have concerns about AARP's financial ties and alignment with certain political interests. Therefore, I encourage you to consider joining AMAC, a senior organization that remains committed to defending constitutional rights, fiscal responsibility, federal solvency, and accountability in government.

body:
This ultra-competitive race will come down to whoever has the most resources to reach voters. And since the GOP has been up on TV for weeks, it’s time to hit the gas.

| Peter—

Logo

** We begin!
------------------------------------------------------------

Hi Patriots,

We begin the journey to make a difference and change the course of history. There is no guarantee of winning this battle but if we don’t try we are guaranteed to lose. And so we try like crazy! Thank you to those who have helped and offered to help so far!

Here are some quick updates from the Campaign Trail.

I’ve been able to speak at a few events and share my story and vision. I’ve gotten good feedback and am still figuring out what works best. We’re knocking on doors, talking to people at the grocery stores, and going to community events to mix and mingle.Thanks again to those who are helping me!

We are also starting to prepare and organize for January and February. This is when we will need as many as possible to canvas, talk to people, and have meet-and-greets and events. If you can get involved let me know.

Here are some upcoming events, where I’ll be speaking:

Monday, November 27 - South Pasadena

Greater Pasadena Republican Assembly meeting,

Griffins of Kinsale, 7:00 - 8:30 pm

Saturday, December 2 - Glendora

Potluck Meeting 4:30 pm

Tuesday, December 5 - Rancho Cucamonga

CRA Meeting, 7:00 pm

Saturday, December 16 - Monrovia

Save the Date!

Let me know if you’re interested in attending any of these. More to come!

We are still living in alternate realities with many of our neighbors. We do not share the same facts or understanding. But reality has a way of creeping up on people and I’m hearing that more and more are waking up. The more people who see it, the more we can do something about it.

Please follow the campaign on Facebook and Instagram and if you want to get involved, email or text me.

Thank you for your support and never give up!

Bonnie

** Standing with Gays Against Groomers.
------------------------------------------------------------

** We have to protect the kids and families from the propaganda and woke agenda. Leave the kids alone!
------------------------------------------------------------

Thank you La Crescenta Republicans

for having me as their guest speaker.

I support Elizabeth Ahlers for CA Senate too!

** Join us for the GPRA Meeting
------------------------------------------------------------

Last meeting of the year!

Monday, November 27, 7:00 PM, Griffins of Kinsale

| | |
## Welcome to the MIGOP Newsletter!
Every Monday evening, you will receive new updates, helpful tips, legislative insights and more from the Michigan Republican Party! Want to share this newsletter with a friend? [Simply click here to open this edition in your browser.](https://mailchi.mp/489f4c805f39/migop-newsletter-november-13-2023?e=a2af77507c)
---
|
---
### Are You Free?
Join fellow Republicans for events around the state, including opportunities to meet party leaders and U.S. Senate candidates and attend the annual MIGOP Christmas Party!

For more information about these and other upcoming events, visit the MIGOP events page [here](https://migop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bcd38e28909007274d8cce33&id=71483fc5a2&e=a2af77507c).
|
---
### Our Most Important Issue

The Michigan Republican Party has launched the **Election Security Operations Program** , which has 18 areas of responsibility—each one is essential to ensure the integrity of elections in our state (see diagram below). From poll challenging to cleaning up the voter rolls, volunteers can start helping TODAY as the MIGOP builds and trains a dynamic team of activists for the 2024 election. Hundreds of Republicans have already signed up but _ many more are needed._

To get involved, contact Phil O'Halloran at [Phil@MIGOP.org](mailto:Phil@MIGOP.org). Please take a moment to share this information with fellow patriots willing to help secure Michigan's elections!
|
---
|
---
|
---
### Good Neighbor Program
Through the MIGOP **Good Neighbor Program** , individuals gain valuable skills, knowledge, and resources necessary for successful political engagement. Delegates receive training in areas such as the electoral systems, political infrastructure, policy understanding, campaign strategies, communication techniques, grassroots organizing, and leadership development. They become equipped to represent the Republican Party effectively, drive voter registration and turnout, and support Republican candidates at the grassroots level.

To learn more about the Good Neighbor Program, contact coordinators Ken Beyer (District 4 Chair) and Ann Clark (Wayne County Republican Committee Chair):

* kenbeyer@protonmail.com
* annpatriot@protonmail.com

|
---
### Stay in the Loop on Wolverine State Legislation
On October 26, 2023 the Michigan Senate passed bills 271, 273, 502, and 519, mandating compliance with the new “clean” energy requirements to be 100% free from carbon-based fuels by 2040. The bills passed along party lines (20 [D] to 18 [R]). The transition to renewable power is set to increase incrementally by 15% by 2027, 50% by 2030, and 60% by 2035.

The Michigan House is accelerating the agenda to have related legislation for revamping our state's energy systems. House bills 5120 - 5123 will allow large renewable energy projects to circumvent local zoning and **_essentially allow the state to place solar and windmill farms wherever the state deems necessary, regardless of zoning_**. The House is attempting to pass these bills before they adjourn early in December.

**_NOTE: If the House votes to adjourn early, this will trigger changing the presidential primary date from March 2, 2024, to February 27, 2024 for both Democrats and Republicans._**

Chairwoman Karamo has stated that “Michigan is ground zero” for the World Economic Forum’s (WEF) desire to implement a one world government. The WEF’s Klaus Schwab said, “In the new world, it is not the big fish which eats the small fish; it’s the fast fish which eats the slow fish.”

**_Clearly, they want us to be the "slow fish" as they grab our beautiful lands. Don’t let that happen!_**

Please get informed about the issues. The Michigan House of Representatives 102nd Legislature can be followed by [clicking this link](https://migop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bcd38e28909007274d8cce33&id=3ab4ed9fe8&e=a2af77507c). Check it often to be aware when the next legislation will be heard.

Take action! Save the Republic!
|
---
### Stay in the Loop on Wolverine State Legislation
[On November 7, 2023](https://migop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bcd38e28909007274d8cce33&id=4cc701c1a2&e=a2af77507c), citizens in Mecosta County voted to remove the entire Green Charter Township board over its support of the Gotion battery plant. Well done, patriots!

This type of action is what will be required of the grassroots constitutionalists if we want to take our country back one neighborhood at a time! The globalists understand this very well. This is the key battleground.
|
---
### Topics of Interest
Also on November 7, there were notable victories and losses throughout the country. Check out People's Pundit Daily pollster Richard Baris's election night coverage and analysis [here](https://migop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bcd38e28909007274d8cce33&id=ca56ea4af5&e=a2af77507c) and [here](https://migop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bcd38e28909007274d8cce33&id=a202250839&e=a2af77507c).

To learn more about the Good Neighbor Program, contact coordinators Ken Beyer (District 4 Chair) and Ann Clark (Wayne County Republican Committee Chair): kenbeyer@protonmail.com annpatriot@protonmail.com | Stay in the Loop on Wolverine State Legislation On October 26, 2023 the Michigan Senate passed bills 271, 273, 502, and 519, mandating compliance with the new “clean” energy requirements to be 100% free from carbon-based fuels by 2040. The bills passed along party lines (20 [D] to 18 [R]). The transition to renewable power is set to increase incrementally by 15% by 2027, 50% by 2030, and 60% by 2035. The Michigan House is accelerating the agenda to have related legislation for revamping our state's energy systems. House bills 5120 - 5123 will allow large renewable energy projects to circumvent local zoning and essentially allow the state to place solar and windmill farms wherever the state deems necessary, regardless of zoning. The House is attempting to pass these bills before they adjourn early in December. NOTE: If the House votes to adjourn early, this will trigger changing the presidential primary date from March 2, 2024, to February 27, 2024 for both Democrats and Republicans. Chairwoman Karamo has stated that “Michigan is ground zero” for the World Economic Forum’s (WEF) desire to implement a one world government. The WEF’s Klaus Schwab said, “In the new world, it is not the big fish which eats the small fish; it’s the fast fish which eats the slow fish.” Clearly, they want us to be the "slow fish" as they grab our beautiful lands. Peter, Let me put the bottom line upfront: I am running for Governor, and I need your support! [_**Will you split a contribution between my campaign and HER Time today?**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/73313140/438114366/1448998739?refcode=AU_HTP_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20231113_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS8xMDI1NDMiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiOWUyOTBkYzMtOGM4Mi1lZTExLTg5MjUtMDAyMjQ4MzJlODExIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=A_i4xn9tiPmi2QRnYhmPE5l3CFaI76lguJjZU8XwfNs=) Now, let me tell you why: Years ago, I swore my first oath to our Constitution. I enthusiastically embarked upon a journey and a career of public service — first in law enforcement and then at CIA. I worked at home and abroad to keep our country safe and protect the country I love. When my husband Adam and I moved our three daughters home to Virginia – just miles from where we had grown up – I thought my days of public service had come to a close. But after the 2016 election, our country was at a crossroads, and I envisioned what it could be if we flipped Virginia’s 7th District and made clear that the people of our district deserved stronger representation. I worked hard, we built an extraordinary team driven by purpose and principle, and in 2018, our district elected a Democrat – me – for the first time since 1968. I have served proudly through some extraordinarily consequential moments in our history, and I have endeavored to do right by my constituents every day. I am proud of the work I have done, the laws I have passed, and the difference I have made. And now, our Commonwealth is at another crossroads – do we continue moving backward with attacks on our rights, our kids’ education, and our communities’ sense of security — or do we move forward on a path of progress? Last week, Virginia’s elections showed that Virginians want to move forward, but we need a new Governor to be driving that progress. I am running for Governor, because I know what I will bring to the job – a deep and abiding love for our Commonwealth, a relentless work ethic, and a focus on bringing people together to solve the real challenges facing Virginians. body:

#

name: Abigail Spanberger
subject: I’m running for Governor
disclaimer_text: Paid for by VPP
body:
| Friend,

Let me put the bottom line upfront: I am running for Governor, and I need your support! [**Will you split a contribution between my campaign and the Voter Protection Project today?**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/57012?t=6&akid=11733%2E878179%2EUHSUPu)

Now, let me tell you why: Years ago, I swore my first oath to our Constitution. I enthusiastically embarked upon a journey and a career of public service — first in law enforcement and then at CIA. I worked at home and abroad to keep our country safe and protect the country I love.

When my husband Adam and I moved our three daughters home to Virginia – just miles from where we had grown up – I thought my days of public service had come to a close. But after the 2016 election, our country was at a crossroads, and I envisioned what it could be if we flipped Virginia’s 7th District and made clear that the people of our district deserved stronger representation. I worked hard, we built an extraordinary team driven by purpose and principle, and in 2018, our district elected a Democrat – me – for the first time since 1968.

I have served proudly through some extraordinarily consequential moments in our history, and I have endeavored to do right by my constituents every day. I am proud of the work I have done, the laws I have passed, and the difference I have made.

And now, our Commonwealth is at another crossroads – do we continue moving backward with attacks on our rights, our kids’ education, and our communities’ sense of security — or do we move forward on a path of progress? Last week, Virginia’s elections showed that Virginians want to move forward, but we need a new Governor to be driving that progress.

I am running for Governor, because I know what I will bring to the job – a deep and abiding love for our Commonwealth, a relentless work ethic, and a focus on bringing people together to solve the real challenges facing Virginians.

[**It is a long road to the 2025 Governor’s election, but will you join me now as a Founding Donor and support my campaign and the Voter Protection Project with a contribution? I am working to build a strong foundation of support, and I need your help.**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/57012?t=7&akid=11733%2E878179%2EUHSUPu) If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Abigail Spanberger and VPP will go through immediately: | [CONTRIBUTE $10 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/57013?t=8&akid=11733%2E878179%2EUHSUPu)

Thank you,

Abigail

name: Kristan Hawkins, Students for Life Action
subject: I know it's short notice, but...
body:
Dear Pro-Life Friend,

I know it’s short notice.

But I’ve set some ambitious plans for our _Students for Life Action_ team over the coming months, and the only way we’ll be able to fund them is by reaching our monthly contributor goals.

As it stands, I’m looking for 37 supporters to step up in the next hour with a monthly recurring contribution of $10 or more.

**[Will you be one of the 37](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-sjhhyjl-duchtdja-y/)?**

**[ |
--- ](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-sjhhyjl-duchtdja-j/)** [](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-sjhhyjl-duchtdja-i/)
Monthly contributors are so critical to all we do because they:

**1) _Allow us to fight Planned Parenthood’s millions during critical election years_. **

With the media, politicians in BOTH parties, Hollywood fat-cats, and Planned Parenthood’s millions all on their side, the Abortion Lobby starts off with some huge advantages.

But thousands of monthly contributors – giving $10 or $25 a month – helps create a snowball effect enabling you and me to make a “Big Money” impact, which can be absolutely critical during election years;

**2) _Guarantee a steady flow of resources I know I can count on every month_.**

This can be critical to my ability to fight bad legislation and work to pass new life-saving laws; and

**3) _Identify and train the next generation of pro-life leaders_. **

You can’t manage a big army without competent leaders. The national grassroots army that _Students for Life Action_ is building requires constant training for young people who are willing to dedicate their lives to abolishing abortion. Monthly contributors play a major role in funding our trainings.

Pro-Life Friend, 2024 is right around the corner.

If you and I don’t start preparing our plans now, I’m afraid we’ll get run over by a pro-abortion freight train.

But that takes resources – resources that don’t just show up overnight.

That’s why monthly contributors are so important.

**[So, will you please join _Students for Life Action’s_ Power Hour by signing up with a monthly recurring contribution of $10 or more right away](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-sjhhyjl-duchtdja-d/)?**

For Life,

Kristan Hawkins
President, Students for Life Action

Students for Life Action is a non-profit, tax-exempt advocacy organization under section 501(c)(4) of the IRC. Contributions or gifts to Students for Life Action are not tax deductible for IRS purposes; they do, however, avoid recognition of gain on appreciated assets. Students for Life Action's mailing address is 600 Princess Anne St #7667, Fredericksburg, VA 22401. Any donations raised above or short of the goal will be used in the next area of greatest need towards our mission, as determined by the organization.

subject: How should we elect the president?
body:
It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation’s future.

This sponsored message from Trump Train News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zoiasdo7a6i7ehpdssgaff6sq3kpp1ksfbk1tjdg_rp22sh2s8i66p74sjim6o34cth2bs) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation’s future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That’s why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** by using the link below: [https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zrrpcn47koo6i136457ef5rn61cesuv61mg0aoh8_rp22sh2s8i66p74sjim6o34cth2bs) For most of our nation’s history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America’s schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics--too many Americans simply don’t understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left’s domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as “Constitution 101” and “The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;”
* **Reaching** over six million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale’s free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America’s founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education by helping establish and guiding classical K-12 schools nationwide and providing, free of charge, Hillsdale’s American classical K-12 curriculum (including American civics) to thousands of American educators and homeschoolers.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America’s future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:** [https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zdots4flai66rshvkhdkn92aj5eplhum0fc9vv8g_rp22sh2s8i66p74sjim6o34cth2bs) And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. subject: The perfect ending to your story
body:
%%previewtext%%

| | | [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zpvo371imj07hajvc92tude5paldko5qocgtu8l0_rp22sh2s8i66p74sjim6o34cth2bs)
---
Hello Friend, Have you been watching what is going on in our world? Do you need help to encourage you in your faith and fortify your hope in these dark days? When anxiety over inflation, wars, and uncertainty strikes, you need hope immediately. That’s why God has given you His Word. He doesn’t want you to have to wait for the peace that comes from knowing He’s in control of the future. God’s Word says that he knows how the end will happen.. Jesus rules victoriously over evil, and you’ll spend an eternity in glory — free from pain and suffering — in His presence. That is such good news! While we wait for that ending, perhaps you or someone you love might have questions about what is happening now in our world and how it fits in with what God says is coming. Those are legitimate questions, and God’s Word has answers! I’ve written a book that outlines the end of your story. That ending is powerful and perfect. You won’t be disappointed, and believe me, you won’t want to change a thing. The name of my book is _Perfect Ending: Why Your Eternal Future Matters Today_. This book will help you face your tomorrows, not in fear, but in absolute confidence, to prepare you for the soon and certain return of Christ. As you read, you’ll:
---
* Gain valuable insight into how future biblical events affect you in the here and now.
* Find the answers to the 10 most frequently asked questions about heaven.
* Discover how some of our government’s policies are paving the way for the Antichrist.
* Come to understand the crucial, but often confusing and overwhelming subject of Bible prophecy.
* Understand the precise sequence and importance of prophetic events like the rapture, tribulation, and millennium.

---
_Perfect Ending_ will be mailed to you as a way of saying thanks for whatever donation you are able to give to the ministry of Pathway to Victory. And as an added bonus, we will include our informative Bible Prophecy Chart to help you visualize end-times events.

name: American Action News
subject: How should we elect the president?
body:
It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation’s future.

This sponsored message from American Action News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zer1dns8ogunsklc3ho9mlp6vk6a1i6t5cs0p5n8_rp22sh2s8i66p74sjhmcoj6c1h2bs) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation’s future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That’s why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** by using the link below: [https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z9eq0ohtrs8sed8ulv9p6rdfjjvlist4283lkd6o_rp22sh2s8i66p74sjhmcoj6c1h2bs) For most of our nation’s history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America’s schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics--too many Americans simply don’t understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left’s domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as “Constitution 101” and “The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;”
* **Reaching** over six million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale’s free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America’s founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education by helping establish and guiding classical K-12 schools nationwide and providing, free of charge, Hillsdale’s American classical K-12 curriculum (including American civics) to thousands of American educators and homeschoolers.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America’s future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:** [https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2ztds68n0rfd66urggua1uacqp8q2bhurqqgt00k8_rp22sh2s8i66p74sjhmcoj6c1h2bs) And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been “pursuing truth and defending liberty.” Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention--and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844
---

name: Dr. Robert Jeffress
subject: Are you ready for the end times?
body:
Have you ever wondered if things could return to God's original plan?

| | | [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c673365%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=WWjW7gLYMV5YRvfvC5CduA&sysid=1)
---
Hello Friend,

Take a moment to look around. It's like we're living out Romans 1:25 - trading the truth of God for a lie and focusing on earthly things rather than our Creator.

Have you ever wondered if things could return to God's original plan?

I want to remind you, Friend, that this chaotic time is fleeting. The shadows will fade, and a new day will dawn. The King of Kings, our Savior, will return.

That's the heart of Revelation.

Each day on this earth shapes us for what's to come - a grand finale. Amidst today's messiness and uncertainty, remember the promise that our story's end is already secured, regardless of the present turmoil or future darkness.

Revelation intricately unveils where our stories lead.

It's a captivating book filled with symbols, creatures, and events yet to unfold. But remember Revelation 1:3 - there's a blessing for those who read, listen, and follow its words because the time is near.

This isn't just a prophecy; it's a blessing-filled journey.

Revelation isn't just about revealing future events; it's about revealing Jesus Christ.

When Jesus came as a man, His divine brilliance was veiled by humanity. It's like dimming a lamp's light. But when He returns, that veil will lift, and we'll see His true glory. That's Revelation's essence.

As the great reveal approaches, I'm here to guide you and your loved ones through the remarkable events preceding the revelation of our King.

In my brand-new book, _Mysteries of the End Times: 5 Truths About God's Future Plans_ , I tackle five common questions about the end times. We'll delve into:

1\. America's Fate: Will America stand for Christ or fall for the Antichrist?
2\. The Day of the Lord: How should we live in anticipation of this apocalyptic event?
3\. The Marriage of the Lamb: What unfolds before and after the rapture?
4\. Gog and Magog: How can we honor God in our lives amid their appearance?
5\. The Tree of Life: What's the significance of this tree in the New Jerusalem?

Understanding these mysteries will anchor you in hope, bolster your trust in God's promises, and equip you to share with the unsure.

In addition to this new book, I would like to share with you "The Major Characters of the End Times," as a token of my gratitude for your support. This full-color, large print booklet introduces key players during the rapture, tribulation, second coming, and final judgment - vital for understanding the grand narrative.
[](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c673366%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=G8%2fJSZIjwxjxvK8pYc7Mtg&sysid=1) I would like to send you my brand-new book _Mysteries of the End Times: 5 Truths About God's Future Plans_ and my brand-new resource “The Major Characters of the End Times” as a thank you for your generous support of $10 or more to the ministry of _Pathway to Victory_.
Make your generous gift here: [https://secure.ptv.org/mysteries-of-the-end-times-generous-gift-1-dr-robert-jeffress](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c673367%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=os784GTJQ6SrH42XNCbeTQ&sysid=1)

_Pathway to Victory_ is committed to equipping believers with biblical teaching and reaching the unsaved by spreading the Good News of Jesus Christ through the most effective means available: radio, television, digital, and print. Your gifts fuel that important work and enable people worldwide to experience an intimate walk with Christ. Thank you for your faithful support.

May our study of Revelation prepare, strengthen, and inspire you. Come quickly, Lord Jesus.

Sharing the Truth of God’s Word, ____
---
| | Dr. Robert Jeffress Senior Pastor, First Baptist Dallas
---

| | | My fellow Americans – this is Mike Johnson.

Why? Because the moment I was elected Speaker by my Republican colleagues, the Radical Left IMMEDIATELY unleashed a coordinated, preplanned political hit job against me.

* And I can’t even begin to tell you how many Democrat fundraising emails and texts I saw in the minutes following the final vote – I’m bracing myself for the next FEC reports.

Look:

These vicious attacks are a dime a dozen in Washington. They don’t intimidate me. _But I’ll let you in on a little secret: that’s not _really_ the goal..._

The _real_ goal of this political ambush is two-fold: **1)** smear the good names of every House Republican to hurt them electorally, and **2)** scare Liberals enough to whip out their credit cards, fill in their info, and donate to Democrats.

## Supreme Court Adopts Formal Ethics Code
The Supreme Court has adopted [its first formal code of ethics](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFyhCAQgOGnwQ4HVtCjoEhjd2lTOgjLuRk8HMAzeftMUqf-m3--j_tyd5To-Xh3O9oW8-J8oxcuUnKpOAyL6oKNiIBDh1aOxphxVGrsNgtaazHpmwCI4QYGpBEaJ78ao4T3sSMLAgYppZJCa4B-GoI2cV1xcqtyq2dKYKCWS_-Z6dk2jOk7v7D0Pu9dsltrR2XDG4OZwXxdVx_z1xOv-tsZzEdO1MhXBnM9j4I7cp_P0rgL-WiV7zlQJAwc20a-cp8D8qNgrWdBvlFKPOBeu2LDcVFKVMeJKfHYHaW_hfa_yE8AAAD__5dAZPc), essentially the same code that applies to other federal judges but with special provisions regarding the use of Court staff and accepting gifts from donors. The new code is a response to pressure from Democrats over gifts accepted by Justice Clarence Thomas and others. The Court said the purpose of the new code was to [clarify the rules](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LtyhCAUxvGnwQ4HDqixoEhjt2lTOlwOKzsoDpd18vYZU6f-N7_v-36sDx1iOJ5fekdVfVq1reGNK-eUSwpilZ1THhFQdKj4OM_zOEo5dptywAbkmk3Mccc-PDNGTAxB2BlHI0QXFDAQnHPJ2TAA9JNww-yNwUkbqY0lkqELNeX-lcJRN_TxJ70x9zbtXVRbrWch4pPAQmC5rqvP2CrmcncCS8SnjgSWVmhpZ8YdqU0tV6qPI7XDYqE-5V1HinULtlCbHNJXKzXc7cbRe6cgsHRZufMKMYYyTkSy565D_HPU_2_5DQAA__-UemS8) the justices were already following. The ethics code leaves compliance up to the justices, with no enforcement mechanism. That drew [some criticism from Congress,](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL1uxCAQhJ8Gd1jsGsNRUKRxd2lTWvwsd0TYWDZ3Vt4-cuo0oylGmk_f132-u1zy-vh0C9mW6uxCy2-aAThIjsMsu2gTEdLQkQVljFFKStU97ejQG23QgPagjBZgvPc3JTTFlEbRZYsCBwCQIMYRsddDHE3ynrTz0vnApKCYW93775rX9qRUfuqb9j7UpSv22dp2sOGD4cRwOs-z32rJLYd6DRhOK50Hw-l6YTgBXHE1WrxrrVDkx2vbaSEe6mtv3MW6tYOHGonXxENd4ys0LgSgumnZ7TZuZy4lH0ozKR6Ly-WPpf2v5jcAAP__1T9jyA) but all nine justices agreed on the new rules.
## U.S. Air Strike Hits Iran Militants in Syria
The U.S. launched its [third air strike targeting Iranian militants](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsj7Fu7CAQAL8GOltmWYMpKF5z3b02pbXA-kyEzckmZ-Xvo0uddkYaaT7u851yyfvjP23s21Jnii2_eFaqU9iBnlEmvzADa8leGeecMYhGrn5ajNMBcQSbJhcTTQSkIiqdrHEEMnsYQCulUA3jCNBbnUa3hMCWAlKIAgdOudWj_6x5bysv5bu--Ohj3WTxa2vPU-h_Am4Cbtd19SHEtxNw2_k637AeJXVfZxdpp0SdsXpSzk7y8Ol55VLyaazA4bFRLr_Z9vflTwAAAP__E3tSUg) in Syria in retaliation for ongoing attacks against U.S. bases in the region. At least 56 American troops have been injured in those attacks. This weekend's air strikes [struck a weapons storage facility ](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0L9u6yAUgPGnwRsW_wzXA8OVKksd0rWjdYBjmwZDBCRR3r5q587f8un3eVkvEFPM-wecaPtWVvA9PnDlnHJFhVzVEOyGKFAOaLme51lrpfRwWGPUZjgX0sxMeu-CniRopoUBpSbuhmgFE5JzrjibJiFGI8M0b86hAafAeaIYhthLHb9KzP3ALb3KA-voyzkke_R-a0T-J2IhYgHnMz7buJefTMTynjvWDD2WDImI5d5ognv2BzYqa6Ct13jFRmOFTB34Kwa613K_NQpnDEQsrZf6InKJgcg3ztQ_qaRkQ7Xh9owpxaYNUWw_Iabfpf630HcAAAD__ywrZ0w)and a command center used by the militants. Defense Secretary Lloyd Austin said strikes will continue if the attacks against U.S. troops don't stop. The U.S. has 900 troops in Syria and 2,500 more in neighboring Iraq. The military is [ramping up patrols ](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0L2SrCAUBOCnwQxL_vQaENzEbDbd0AI5jGcHxYLjWPv2W268aXfydX8-5ofDhPvzw21gKebZLYRvmIXgQnOpZt0EGwEkqAas6Mdx7Hut-2a1zjgvtTBSglpM9GNcYox--GdCGDoXG7Syk0oIoUVnjJTtoIIZo_cwOK-dX5juICDl0n5l3GmFmL7zG0q75K1JdiU6KlP_mZyYnK7ragucBKXe_Z3kkgKT01n5ijtVvuUCvFLBF1R-7glq5VjczhPuLwj8WfJ5VL66RNwRueVV-U3k91rF5NQUG44LU8LaD0x3z81h-tXQ3-f8BAAA__8UGGgS)and intelligence-gathering and left open the possibility of evacuating military families.
## NFL Parlay Wins Bettor $5.5 Million
A Florida bettor [won $5.5 million in profit](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL1yhCAURp8GOxy54F9hkYZu06Z0LnJVEhYcYNf49pndOt038xXnzPm6zTd03oXtE-80lTXOuBT3pFkILhQHOavKTisRkKxoEt04jl2nVFftU7OsQytxFA0pizjiYmRvl1VaWgZUsnITNCCFEEo0bQtQ99K242oM9WgUmoWphqwrMdXf0YWy0-qv-KRUL_Fe-Wkv5chMfjDQDPR5njXlI7xOBvo1GWhDpbiwMdC5xHQx0DMD7SwDLYdh6MTYMdCFfjFkfrrADYUNfeaXI28zj4G4x7RRLvzA5PHiB17xUTJ_ZJ6PmEo2Mf7w3b0BVZrscTrvXe56pprtjs6_fcv_-f4CAAD__yVpdI8) on a $500,000 four-leg NFL parlay that needed four different events to happen in Sunday's Houston Texans-Cincinnati Bengals game. The bet required the total score to go over 44.5 points, Texas running back Devin Singletary to score a touchdown, Singletary to gain over 51.5 rushing yards, and the Texans to win the game, which only happened on a last-second field goal. The size of the bet at the Hard Rock sportsbook [drew attention in the betting world.](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL1uwzAMhJ9G3hToP_GgoYu3dO1oUDaVqJAlwyKS-u0Lde7ygQA_HA73dZ_vkHIqj0_Y0FOsMyyUXjhLyaXhSs9mWH1EVKgH9NKN4-icMW54-ngDMS5Ka3e7ab2OQWhYIFprVwAXxJC8EkpLKY0U1ip1uerVjjEEvEIwEBZmBK6J6nH5rqnQE2M-6wuPy1K3Ifsn0d6Y_mBqYmoq514b9RdTUw9mapKyo19trwe1rsXMAxLVg79Tadxyy7eUc6qF18IJf6A03mBD_ujY4chwMjUNh1_3dzebuzIjHhuk_NeE_h_mNwAA__9MmGPN) Six and seven-figure bets have become more common in Florida since online betting relaunched this month.

This isn’t the news I wanted to share. **In the last two years alone, OVER A QUARTER of the Florida manatee population has been wiped out.**
I’ll get straight to the point. Manatees are starving to death, Friend. In fact, the last few years have been the **deadliest on record** for these gentle sea cows. That’s because our oceans are growing more and more polluted by the day. The pollution feeds algae-blooms and dead zones, which are decimating the seagrass that manatees need to survive. Yet industries like Big Cruise continue to recklessly dump toxic wastewater into the ocean, endangering marine life, coastal communities, and the planet. As you read this, cruise ships are dumping polluted wastewater in manatee habitats. Wastewater pollutants can trigger algal blooms so thick that they block the sunlight needed for seagrass to grow. But manatees need to eat a whopping 10% of their body weight a day to be healthy. **Without access to the seagrass they need, manatees don’t stand a chance against Big Polluters.**
Even more, cruise pollution affects coastal communities that rely on these waters! That’s why I’m reaching out to you. If we don’t act soon, the damage to our oceans and the marine life and communities that rely on them could be irreversible. It’s time to hold Big Cruise accountable and fight for our oceans, wildlife, coastal communities, and the future of our planet. Will you stand with us today before our planet’s waters are destroyed?

It’s not news that the cruise industry is raking in profits at the expense of our planet. Cruise ships can be the size of entire city blocks. _**And every day cruises can emit the same amount of pollution as a million cars.**_ An overwhelming majority of these ships are run off cheaper, heavy, dirty fuel that fills the air with extreme amounts of particulate matter. These pollutants can worsen respiratory illnesses like asthma and even contribute to acid rain. That means cruise ships are directly impacting human health just to save a buck!
Big Cruise is crossing the line, plain and simple. Its negligent dumping practices amount to MILLIONS of gallons of pollution. That’s contributing to seagrass loss.
Believe it or not, seagrass is a vital plant for surrounding communities and our planet. Seagrass beds store **almost a fifth of the world’s oceanic carbon.** That carbon storage helps keep us safe from some of the worst impacts of climate change. And as sea levels rise, these plants also help protect coastal communities from storm surges.
But cruise ship pollution isn’t just leading to dying seagrass. It directly impacts wildlife, too. When these mammoth ships travel close to shore, they churn up sand and contaminants. These practices harm water quality. And **they can cause marine wildlife to suffocate from lack of oxygen.**
What’s more, Big Cruise’s negligence harms coastal communities. The water pollution drives away fish and other marine animals they rely on. That’s not to mention the _**serious health risks and climate pollution associated with cruise ships’ air emissions.**_ Big Cruise is **literally toxifying** our planet’s air, waters, and the ecosystems they rely on -- all for the sake of profit. How long will we let it get away with this?
**We have to stop the cruise industry’s reckless practices for the sake of wildlife, people, and the planet. Rush your $27 donation before the damage is irreversible!**

We’re at a tipping point, Friend. Big Cruise has massive resources that put it in control of the story right now. If we don’t change the narrative soon, we could reach a point of no return when it comes to the health of our planet.
Friends of the Earth is doing everything in our power to fight back against Big Polluters and ensure a better future for our planet. We are working to expose the large cruise industry for the polluting, greenwashing industry that it truly is by calling out all of its polluting ways and helping communities expose the industry as it continues to expand. At the same time, we’re pushing the EPA to regulate cruise ships. But we’re up against powerful foes like Big Cruise. These massive companies will stop at nothing to get their pay day. body:
It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future.

This sponsored message from Conservative Liberty Wire is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=877a2e96de6542a8b9b2e5bb0d080669&_e=KevsXdr41qtDs0vkDbHILuZs0xKEDHoT9S4Hs2v_8Zwrmkezuw_XUEWjYC4NUzwfbg1SeSmE111PTXzeLRqEGFt9YRzmJub61aIwLT829fedt1kmBeiDUEzddiHjZuW6s9h5ZbnF_bH8udU6rp2LEoQ6z99HSLIngzIH2ySTINzM6fNh57jMl98Xsx71wyKH-jEKVwlsAAizECHO9lR989EsNBB1Y7yDARNhAYbIIRuBgkRYKIJNZZ1lj_lLt6Tb-zNCx6KOWl_tipFfHZOXpcwUZWo_w7n_yV_y-slgSH7YdngvAjBfeq4IF9w_OvSbza407-0bXT2U-tFkP7gdIvuP_YES8DJiRBcJNQHLOleP03Mr6jmL-6TU__f37enJkvrcghjp0e3B8hXLAcLP-Q%3D%3D) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** by using the link below: [https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=877a2e96de6542a8b9b2e5bb0d080669&_e=KevsXdr41qtDs0vkDbHILuZs0xKEDHoT9S4Hs2v_8Zwrmkezuw_XUEWjYC4NUzwfbg1SeSmE111PTXzeLRqEGFt9YRzmJub61aIwLT829fedt1kmBeiDUEzddiHjZuW6s9h5ZbnF_bH8udU6rp2LEoQ6z99HSLIngzIH2ySTINzM6fNh57jMl98Xsx71wyKH-jEKVwlsAAizECHO9lR989EsNBB1Y7yDARNhAYbIIRuBgkRYKIJNZZ1lj_lLt6TbwK2fJ_ECrXl5skz0AFrBphJub_jgZ92orYgRUJWB98qSOHW4qYUzqG5xBCpqza8O24N8FgnBIEST1SKss3xqGX8Fg3uC304wfP3JtG1bOfuTh9o7qyefNa53SdukKFkNfdg3dZfd5O7IZVivX86v9w%3D%3D) For most of our nation's history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics--too many Americans simply don't understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;"
* **Reaching** over six million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale's free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education by helping establish and guiding classical K-12 schools nationwide and providing, free of charge, Hillsdale's American classical K-12 curriculum (including American civics) to thousands of American educators and homeschoolers.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America 's future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:** [https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=877a2e96de6542a8b9b2e5bb0d080669&_e=KevsXdr41qtDs0vkDbHILuZs0xKEDHoT9S4Hs2v_8Zwrmkezuw_XUEWjYC4NUzwfbg1SeSmE111PTXzeLRqEGFt9YRzmJub61aIwLT829fedt1kmBeiDUEzddiHjZuW6s9h5ZbnF_bH8udU6rp2LEoQ6z99HSLIngzIH2ySTINzM6fNh57jMl98Xsx71wyKH-jEKVwlsAAizECHO9lR989EsNBB1Y7yDARNhAYbIIRuBgkRYKIJNZZ1lj_lLt6TbHkoGzud1IyxElnd2BRs1gcDSMh47N7-6EbO4NFcjeoYJitecWVxDpXdKpdbtkDSUtmX_BYtCuF3mtyYOtXGooJ9Li1xPv_gFy7rCFSNBu_PbLrkb-7dFRUH3Flkd0bjzjfP2kKiymw8T2xxnxAkjWA%3D%3D) And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention--and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

name: Dr. Robert Jeffress
subject: Are you ready for the end times?
body:
May our study of Revelation prepare, strengthen, and inspire you. Come quickly, Lord Jesus.
188d92cdddd40f90da47bc74ea2ba8fb
| | | [](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/FnPweuFpsguB5R7b8Nzm2Q~~/AARclAA~)
---
Hello Friend,

Take a moment to look around. It's like we're living out Romans 1:25 - trading the truth of God for a lie and focusing on earthly things rather than our Creator.

Have you ever wondered if things could return to God's original plan?

I want to remind you, Friend, that this chaotic time is fleeting. The shadows will fade, and a new day will dawn. The King of Kings, our Savior, will return.

That's the heart of Revelation.

Each day on this earth shapes us for what's to come - a grand finale. Amidst today's messiness and uncertainty, remember the promise that our story's end is already secured, regardless of the present turmoil or future darkness.

Revelation intricately unveils where our stories lead.

It's a captivating book filled with symbols, creatures, and events yet to unfold. But remember Revelation 1:3 - there's a blessing for those who read, listen, and follow its words because the time is near.

This isn't just a prophecy; it's a blessing-filled journey.

Revelation isn't just about revealing future events; it's about revealing Jesus Christ.

When Jesus came as a man, His divine brilliance was veiled by humanity. It's like dimming a lamp's light. But when He returns, that veil will lift, and we'll see His true glory. That's Revelation's essence.

As the great reveal approaches, I'm here to guide you and your loved ones through the remarkable events preceding the revelation of our King.

In my brand-new book, _Mysteries of the End Times: 5 Truths About God's Future Plans_ , I tackle five common questions about the end times. We'll delve into:

1\. America's Fate: Will America stand for Christ or fall for the Antichrist?
2\. The Day of the Lord: How should we live in anticipation of this apocalyptic event?
3\. The Marriage of the Lamb: What unfolds before and after the rapture?
4\. Gog and Magog: How can we honor God in our lives amid their appearance?
5\. The Tree of Life: What's the significance of this tree in the New Jerusalem?

Understanding these mysteries will anchor you in hope, bolster your trust in God's promises, and equip you to share with the unsure.

In addition to this new book, I would like to share with you "The Major Characters of the End Times," as a token of my gratitude for your support. This full-color, large print booklet introduces key players during the rapture, tribulation, second coming, and final judgment - vital for understanding the grand narrative.
[](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/FnPweuFpsguB5R7b8Nzm2Q~~/AARclAA~)I would like to send you my brand-new book _Mysteries of the End Times: 5 Truths About God's Future Plans_ and my brand-new resource "The Major Characters of the End Times" as a thank you for your generous support of $10 or more to the ministry of _Pathway to Victory_.
Make your generous gift here: [https://secure.ptv.org/mysteries-of-the-end-times-generous-gift-1-dr-robert-jeffress](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/FnPweuFpsguB5R7b8Nzm2Q~~/AARclAA~)

_Pathway to Victory_ is committed to equipping believers with biblical teaching and reaching the unsaved by spreading the Good News of Jesus Christ through the most effective means available: radio, television, digital, and print. Your gifts fuel that important work and enable people worldwide to experience an intimate walk with Christ. Thank you for your faithful support.

May our study of Revelation prepare, strengthen, and inspire you. Come quickly, Lord Jesus.

Sharing the Truth of God's Word, ____
---
| | Dr. Robert Jeffress Senior Pastor, First Baptist Dallas
---

Last week, the 7th Circuit Court of Appeals issued a MAJOR anti-gun ruling.

| |
---
| | | [ ](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c35403%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=BjOfHRxST8nEZF%2byEYA8pA&sysid=1)
---
| Friend,

Last week, the 7th Circuit Court of Appeals issued a MAJOR anti-gun ruling.

They’re arguing **_AR-15s are not protected by the Second Amendment_**.

**“Shall not be infringed”** doesn’t have an asterisk.

This year, I introduced the **Shall Not Be Infringed** Act to repeal RINO gun control laws. We knew the Biden administration would use the courts to come for us - and I was prepared to stand in the breach.
---
| [ ](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c35403%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=BjOfHRxST8nEZF%2byEYA8pA&sysid=1)
---
| | | [TELL THE 7TH CIRCUIT: SHALL NOT BE INFRINGED >>](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c35404%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=iDEEnGK6gAlgqXgbD2SVYA&sysid=1 "TELL THE 7TH CIRCUIT: SHALL NOT BE
INFRINGED")
---
| Let me be clear: the Second Amendment (and AR-15s in particular) keeps your family SAFE from harm.

We have this amendment to protect against enemies foreign and domestic. This is precisely why Biden is shipping Ukrainian civilians** _actual_** assault weapons: he knows an armed population is the only way to defend against a foreign power.

The terrorist attack last month in Israel proved that fact.

There’s only one reason to deny it: you want a disarmed populace totally dependent on the government. It’s sickening, and endangers all Americans.

[**_Join me in adding your name to my cause protecting your constitutional right to defend yourself. Americans deserve the right to protect their families and property from aggressors._**](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c35415%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=xn24HyxaBKY7k7bxGmxJmw&sysid=1)

For Freedom, [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c35403%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=BjOfHRxST8nEZF%2byEYA8pA&sysid=1)
Lauren Boebert
Congresswoman, 3rd Congressional District of Colorado

subject: How should we elect the President?
body:
It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future.

This sponsored message from Full Mag News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=9ab4ff5deea3484ba7f9d683f7c51d6c&_e=lPtmHZJrDT3lZxdbbwmiPORbnoaqudh_gdv7LlIa-dGP1LpMjslY_CdZqegazYQcb9fovh0mHk9iOF2xK9FZhZvw1GwkdA7T3ZkXI4b1DRD2nkhRxVYy0WsR15VsSJtTEvrZokzZs1idyChmKlIRi27-SvZMkkCVpQ1X8DvC_6-ZfvuJQI5ayXn5r2-7nZXxtnmiYviU8pZxQYuq6g_HkS5RYfbrYzTMg0Aau44ZQ8e79-dRrHK6q-jU5YWSxa0jPvZNR8cNJFaqKaXVKzQ0guv3IVkdHvqkTt_l31iz16v1yZXgZg9tVL2t6Rnu8sLRAWAYujuT2bv5IDpGzC0U9l32lrmjBgyZksz8eg85tQjbyNIt0z1kH0qSQHK0c7DOkLv8vYvJROsvVdAcBHKO2Q%3D%3D) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** by using the link below: [https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=9ab4ff5deea3484ba7f9d683f7c51d6c&_e=lPtmHZJrDT3lZxdbbwmiPORbnoaqudh_gdv7LlIa-dGP1LpMjslY_CdZqegazYQcb9fovh0mHk9iOF2xK9FZhZvw1GwkdA7T3ZkXI4b1DRD2nkhRxVYy0WsR15VsSJtTEvrZokzZs1idyChmKlIRi27-SvZMkkCVpQ1X8DvC_6-ZfvuJQI5ayXn5r2-7nZXxtnmiYviU8pZxQYuq6g_HkS5RYfbrYzTMg0Aau44ZQ8e79-dRrHK6q-jU5YWSxa0jGyWtIOPMcFLMxZsdACn78OCbfTK4IUUinv1SgXZI8UhIt5Qd0zja4gCcIoBZ6mU1aewZBoQ445ttS1d3JrQ6bY-keGooNdrKwqf-0Thkdsz1RNnReXWaoc4pFOD74BxbYTXvJx8jq2NLOa21GcbPmw%3D%3D) For most of our nation's history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics--too many Americans simply don't understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;"
* **Reaching** over six million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale's free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education by helping establish and guiding classical K-12 schools nationwide and providing, free of charge, Hillsdale's American classical K-12 curriculum (including American civics) to thousands of American educators and homeschoolers.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America 's future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:** [https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=9ab4ff5deea3484ba7f9d683f7c51d6c&_e=lPtmHZJrDT3lZxdbbwmiPORbnoaqudh_gdv7LlIa-dGP1LpMjslY_CdZqegazYQcb9fovh0mHk9iOF2xK9FZhZvw1GwkdA7T3ZkXI4b1DRD2nkhRxVYy0WsR15VsSJtTEvrZokzZs1idyChmKlIRi27-SvZMkkCVpQ1X8DvC_6-ZfvuJQI5ayXn5r2-7nZXxtnmiYviU8pZxQYuq6g_HkS5RYfbrYzTMg0Aau44ZQ8e79-dRrHK6q-jU5YWSxa0jfRLZ0qhoUlnsV-MhCyGYIphWW5cBCrqGxj9GKrEXCoUbkqpRjSpsPFsHfu_XicvSgmIEUc8-PAshpnPAEiypfACT81W8x6nNm6P1qa7vesYOR7xojlL4S_7JRn6rUvBHSKPZUMTCHb2sPWKoVk2FKg%3D%3D) And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention--and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

Thank you for your time and attention--and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States.

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor"** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

**ELECTION ROUNDUP: KEY WINS IN BATTLEGROUND DISTRICTS**
Last Tuesday, over 60% of the candidates endorsed by the 1776 Project PAC were elected to school boards in states across the country, making it clearer than ever: Parents are ready to oust far-left extremists from their school districts and are ready to stand up for the values that make this nation great.

In Matthews County, Virginia, both of our candidates - Jason Maresh and Brandi Perkins- won their races, flipping the school board from liberal to conservative.
In Bedford County, Virginia, Chris Daniels and Dora Purvis delivered major wins, giving conservatives the majority.
In the Upper Perkiomen School District in Montgomery County, Pennsylvania, we won 2 seats in the second-most Democrat county in the state.
In York County, Pennsylvania, we supported 37 school board candidates. 36 of them won.
And over in the South Western City School District in Franklin, Ohio, both of our candidates - Denise D'Angelo and Julie Liskany- won their elections, flipping it to a 4-1 conservative majority.
**TEACHERS UNION CAUGHT IN MASSIVE LIE**
So what did the corrupt cabal of teachers unions minions at the American Federation of Teachers do in response? They spewed a massive, baseless, and pathetic lie about our PAC, claiming that we lost 80% of our races. We demanded a reaction from the Associated Press and they eventually corrected their story.

Tens-of-thousands of children who go to school in districts where our candidates are working to free them from woke politics and trying to achieve academic excellence," 1776 Project PAC founder **Ryan Girdusky** said about the election results.
This cycle we won 69 out of 113 school races, bringing the total number of victories for the year to 103.
And since 2021, we've helped elect more than 200 school board members in a dozen states.

What does this mean?
It means there are now more school board members than ever who are ready to stop Critical Race Theory in its tracks, eliminate radical, sexually-charged materials in school curriculum, and put American patriotism back in the classroom.
But none of this momentum can continue without your support. Our opponents are desperate and on the defensive, which means they're only scheming up more dirty tricks.
It's why need to stay on offense, keep recruiting incredible candidates, and build on all of this success.

And with your help, we'll keep flipping school boards, one by one.
The work we're doing is changing school for the better. We're preserving the dignity of education and dismantling the left's indoctrination agenda.
Every day, we're more and more inspired by the passion of patriots like you, eager to do what's right for parents and students.
Every race is critical, every classroom is worth saving, and every supporter is more valuable than ever.
And together, we're changing education for the better.

Riley Gaines is a former University of Kentucky swimmer who stepped into the spotlight last year when she first spoke out against men competing in women’s sports. Gaines became a 12-time NCAA All-American swimmer and a five-time SEC champion. Riley can recall wondering why no one was standing up for her or for any women in the room when a man was awarded the 2022 NCAA Women's Swimming Championships. This moment became her call to action: she felt compelled to defend and protect America’s daughters against the woke left and their gender-denying ideology. Riley has actively pursued her mission by speaking at events and making media appearances to rally everyday Americans to defend women’s sports and uphold vital truths. I spoke to Riley in our Common Ground podcast. Listen to her story HERE. Everything that Riley Gaines stands for is common sense. Click here to learn more about the 6th Annual Chairwoman's Reception that Riley will be headlining as the keynote speaker. Let's come together on September 19th to make a statement, to inspire change, and to take the reins of America's future. We look forward to standing with you. Until next time, Bill & The Common Sense Action Team

| | | | | Peter, Running for office is tough. You have to ask a bunch of people for money (like this), and then the other side gets together and says lots of mean things about you. Having a baby is tough, too. There’s lots of screaming and crying, poop gets everywhere, and you don’t get any sleep. Now that I think about it, it’s a lot like running for office... Peter, I’m writing because my friend and former Senate counsel Josh Riley is doing BOTH. First, I laughed and told him he was crazy. When I realized he wasn’t joking, I said I’d help! [Josh is running for Congress in NY-19, and his race could decide the House majority. Will you join me and split a contribution between Josh Riley and Blue Amp Action today to help him win one of the most important races in the country.](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tab688619-dfb0-4b09-90a6-20abb0b7ebbb/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

When the local factories closed, Josh saw his community struggle – but he worked to put himself through school and graduated from Harvard Law. In the Senate, Josh and I brought Republicans and Democrats together to actually get stuff done (yes, it really is possible)! The bills we worked on together expanded rights for survivors of domestic abuse and provided new funding for addiction treatment and mental health programs. It wasn’t easy, but Josh got them signed into law. Now, Josh is running for Congress without taking any corporate PAC money. He knows it’s not the easy route, but it’s the right thing to do. But that means he’s relying on folks like you and me chipping in. And with his time spread thin between the campaign, the new baby and, ya know, still having time to breathe, he’s relying on us now more than ever. The third Republican debate went just as well as we knew it
would. We faced the nation, rose..

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/oWzUjbriVN

Friend,

There is no clearer contrast between Joe Biden and the energy we
brought to the stage at the third Republican debate. We just gave
the nation a preview of what the nation will see in the 2024
general election, and the response we're getting now is
unbelievable.

Now
is the time to take action. We put in the work standing up to the
challengers, but we are just getting started. We are facing a
chance to maximize our momentum TODAY if we step up and make this
victory a steppingstone to the next stage of our campaign, but
that means coming together to earn an unprecedented show of
support for our mission.

SUPPORT THE CAMPAIGN NOW: DONATE $25 HERE

Now
that the nation has gotten another chance to see what we're
fighting for, here's what they know:

We WILL put an end to the absurd claims that men can get
pregnant.

We WILL throw every sexually-explicit material they've tried to
shove into our nation's elementary schools in the garbage-where
it belongs.

We WILL go straight to the southern border, ARMED, and leave
Mexican drug cartel members trying to bring thousands of pounds
of fentanyl near young Americans STONE COLD DEAD.

We WILL fire every bureaucrat that siphons off tax-payer dollars
to fund ineffective, corrupt, useless agencies.

We WILL hold federal leaders accountable for the harm they've
done to adult Americans and the futures of American children.

We WILL restore our American dominance and strength from our
military to our manufacturing, to our energy sector.

We WILL END our toxic, abusive relationship with China, and
declare our economic independence from foreign adversaries.

We
are one step closer to slashing the outrageous cost of living
that Biden has imposed on average Americans, stripping the woke
absurdity out of the lives of children, and reinstating our
dominance as a nation so our future is as proud, independent, and
free as our past.

We're doing everything we can to defeat this failing radical Left
for good, but they've seen how strong we are and what we will
achieve, and now we have a giant target on our back. It will take
more than one donation to defeat Joe Biden-we MUST NOT let up.

<<
Help me continue to fight back by sending in a monthly donation
to my campaign here >>

PLEDGE ANY AMOUNT

We
have a long road ahead and these stakes are too high to risk
falling behind. I need you to step up on this team, and I believe
that you will. Click here to send in a quick donation to help
fund our fight for a free American future.

Yours in Freedom,

Ron
DeSantis

Get to Know Ron DeSantis

Ron DeSantis comes from
blue-collar roots in the state of Florida. Nothing was handed to
him, he worked his way through college and led his team as the
Yale Baseball captain.

After earning his undergraduate
degree, Ron DeSantis graduated from Harvard Law School, but was
so moved by the events of September 11, 2001, that he volunteered
to serve in the Navy to fight for our freedom.

When he returned, he started a
life of public service by serving Florida as both Congressman and
now Governor.

Despite all his years of fighting
to ensure the American people enjoy the freedom we're promised in
this country, he's watched the Left strip away freedoms at every
turn and impose radical agendas on children, families, and
consumers nationwide.

In 2009, Ron met the love of his
life Casey in Florida, and he's now the proud father of 6, 5, and
3-year-old children. Because of his kids, Ron DeSantis knows that
this fight is personal and understands the frustration parents
face when teachers' unions and liberal groups shove a political
agenda down the throats of children.

On Day One, Ron DeSantis has
promised that he will bring a RECKONING for what unelected
bureaucrats like Anthony Fauci and DC elites have done to
children. Ron DeSantis will ignite our Great American Comeback by
immediately getting to work stopping the invasion across our
southern border, ensuring our military once again puts the
mission first, declaring our economic independence, and restoring
our American energy dominance so that our country gets back on
track before it's too late.

In Florida, Ron DeSantis' record
speaks for itself. He's taken on the political establishment,
politicized bureaucratic agencies, woke corporations, and the
legacy media countless times and won every single time. Under his
leadership, Florida has cultivated a thriving economy. It has
stood as a citadel of freedom, and with him as our next
President, America can once again be that shining City on a Hill
for the rest of the world to look upon.

That's why he's running for
President of the United States. Ron DeSantis knows that the
decline of our country is a choice that cannot continue for
another four years; the time to lead is now.... the time to act
is now.

| The Gloucester County GOP has just announced that Riley Gaines will be the keynote speaker at the 6th Annual Chairwoman’s Reception! This special event will be happening on Tuesday, September 19th at 6PM at Adelphia Restaurant in Deptford, New Jersey. Learn more and save your spot here. Riley Gaines is a former University of Kentucky swimmer who stepped into the spotlight last year when she first spoke out against men competing in women’s sports. Gaines became a 12-time NCAA All-American swimmer and a five-time SEC champion. But last year, the integrity of her sport — and female sports as a whole — was called into question when University of Pennsylvania swimmer Lia Thomas, who had competed on the school’s men’s team his freshman, sophomore and junior years, began shattering records in the women’s category. Riley can recall wondering why no one was standing up for her or for any women in the room when a man was awarded the 2022 NCAA Women's Swimming Championships. This moment became her call to action: she felt compelled to defend and protect America’s daughters against the woke left and their gender-denying ideology. Riley has actively pursued her mission by speaking at events and making media appearances to rally everyday Americans to defend women’s sports and uphold vital truths. I spoke to Riley in our Common Ground podcast. Listen to her story HERE. Everything that Riley Gaines stands for is common sense. Click here to learn more about the 6th Annual Chairwoman's Reception that Riley will be headlining as the keynote speaker. Let's come together on September 19th to make a statement, to inspire change, and to take the reins of America's future. We look forward to standing with you. Until next time, Bill & The Common Sense Action Team

Hi, Peter – it's Patty. I have a few minutes of free time this morning. And, while I'm drinking my coffee, I thought I'd share a story with you about my journey to the Senate.
The truth is, I never thought I'd become a politician. Back in the 80s, I was a working mom and had enough on my plate as it was! That changed when local officials wanted to cut my kids' preschool program. I worked to save it, and that's when a male legislator told me I couldn't make a difference because I was **"just a mom in tennis shoes."** Well, I laced up those tennis shoes and fought back!
I jumped into action, organizing a coalition of 13,000 parents, and we successfully saved the preschool program. That's when I realized government could make a meaningful difference if officials understood the needs of working moms and their families.
The rest, Peter, is history. From that day on, I've been focused on bringing the voices of working families to the U.S. Senate – and that includes every step of my career from school board to Senate Pro Tempore today.
**But i f I'm going to continue to make progress on the issues that matter most, I need your help. Our Senate majority is hanging by a thread, and I'm falling dangerously short of my mid-month goal.**
**[So I'm asking you to make a $5 donation today.
