body:
Someone stole toilet paper?🚽🧻 | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/ne.gop/n41kepo7ku-12662492?e=25844e23a8)
---
| | [ ](https://mcshanellc.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=59af10f728&e=25844e23a8)
---
| |
#### Good Morning Republicans,

Why does a Political Party even exist? Whom does an elected representative, whether a Chairman or a Governor, do all the work **FOR**? _We do it for people. All...the...People._ The source of any government's authority is “the consent of the governed.” This means that the government is **NOT** the ruler, but **the servant or agent** of the citizens; it means that the government as such, has no rights except the rights delegated to it by the citizens for a specific purpose.

For a political party, the same source of values is derived...from the people. At the very core of a party's governance is a county or political subdivision position called a DELEGATE. These delegates signup every two years to be a voice for others (or maybe just themselves). Regardless, they choose to participate in the county organizational structure known as a County Convention at which the governing body follows a set of rules and procedures to elect smaller subgroups called a Central Committee and an Executive Committee. **Show up & Know the Rules.** You can't know the rules if you don't show up!

At the county level, once the delegates have conducted their business, the Central and Executive Committee take the reins and are supposed to achieve the objectives of the party. The NEGOP's objectives are CLEARLY outlined within our constitution. __ARTICLE I_
**Name and Objectives**_ _**Section 1.** The name of this organization shall be the Republican Party of Nebraska._ _**Section 2.** The **objectives of the Party** shall be the maintenance of _government of, by and for the people_ according to the Constitution and laws of the United States and the State of Nebraska, **AND** _**the furtherance of such principles**_ as may from time to time be adopted._ The county Central Committee can meet as frequently as determined in the County Constitution but they are to meet for a purpose. The purpose is to set standards and create stability of the organization so Republicans, and those considering becoming Republicans, can see the professionalism, stability, and organization to further the principles within the community. The Central Committee can amend constitutions, draft and adopt resolutions, publicly endorse candidates, elect Executive Officers, approve budgets, and support additional committees to further the objectives. _If you'll notice, so far the purpose of the party has little to do with elected officials and should be devoid of personalities._ The organizational foundation of a party HAS to be built FIRST or people simply won't participate.

The Executive Committee of each County comprised usually of a _Chair, Vice-Chair, Secretary, and Treasurer,_ can now implement and facilitate the objectives of the party because they have a framework from which to operate. The connecting of the values of the party to the voters in the county can commence through events and meetings, training, candidate recruitment and development, parades, and of course, fundraising. All we need next is candidates and elected representatives who will do the same, connect the values of the party to the voters. In the next email we will dive further into party formation and how that translates to the State level SCC (State Central Committee) and even on to the RNC (Republican National Committee).

Speaking of fundraising, I've come to realize that not everyone understands what is financially healthy for a political party. **What is financially healthy for a political party is to have the party funded by the people.** I have spoken a lot about the funding that went into the Republican Party of Nebraska previously. Who funded the party and how it was spent is really a question that previous members should be held accountable for. Unfortunately, even though it was constitutionally required to have a budget approved by our State Central Committee, the below image was all that was presented in 2022. **_Side note: Many strong leaders spoke up against the simplicity of the budget and demanded a more substantive redo. _**See the proposed and approved 2022 "Budget". Our 2023 approved budget was actually a 2-year budget and consists of all categories one would expect from a business or non-profit. However, the NEGOP must constantly raise funds in every fashion utilizing events to dinners, to direct and digital mail, to phone calls and one-on-one meetings. Currently, we are sending emails (called digital mail) focused on fundraising and the response has been PHENOMENAL from the people. Our goal was to raise $35,000 to finish out 2023 and as of today we are 80% there. **Ironically, we have received feedback that these emails sounded desperate in nature and would indicate concern as to the financial health of the party.** The following emails were from _early 2022_ (before the current administration and under a different financial "culture") and the NEGOP must have been in the SAME financial STRAIN when they only had a few _major_ donors funding the party.
I probably could've replicated this last email and indicated we had our toilet paper stolen, so if the good people of Nebraska could just chip-in $6, we'd be sanitary.

A bigger point I want to make is about the opposition fundraising. If we are to further our principles in Nebraska we need to understand the well-funded machine we are up against. The Democrats in Nebraska can't fund themselves in-state, so they go outside the state...to the tune of $8,000,000 and spending of $7.8 Million.

We are "this" close to losing our Red state because we are literally fighting, George Soros, Sam Bankman-Fried (Crypto Guy), George Clooney, Steven Spielberg, Jeffrey Katzenberg, and more. In 2020, over **250 Democratic** donors maxed out their Federal limit of $10,000 to the Democratic Party.

Do you know how many of the $10,000 Republican donors from previous years have maxed out their Federal limit to the party in 2023?

_**NONE**_.

This is truly a party of the people, funded BY the people, to do work FOR the people. And, that is what the Republican Party of Nebraska is doing. Day by day, finding every opportunity to build a relationship and connect voters to the Conservative Values of this party.

ALL Republicans are supposed to have the same objectives to promote our values and influence the culture of Nebraska and do so both in government positions as well as citizens. We receive 100's of emails and phone calls from Nebraskans concerned about the erosion of morals and ethics and **consistency to values** from elected officials, but I argue that the erosion of the very same standards has happened exponentially faster **within our society**. From high taxes, to pornography in schools and the curriculum standards, higher education systems of UNL actively promoting woke policies, election security that HAS to be addressed to have Election Accountability and Voter Verification, crime, mental health, environment and energy independence, LIFE - HUMAN LIFE...the people of Nebraska what our principles _**_prioritized_**_ , NOT hurt feelings because of no compromise. [_Standards or principles or values_](https://mcshanellc.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=66f378cef6&e=25844e23a8) are what **separates** the Republican Party from the Democratic Party (or any others). When personalities are removed and values are promoted, the people will SHOW UP because they see what a political party is **FOR**. It's **FOR** them, to represent them, to speak **FOR** them, to promote **FOR** them.

We cannot compromise anymore on our moral principles. When people say "Doesn't life require compromise?" this truly translates to "Doesn't life require the surrender of that which is good and true to that which is evil and false?"

Ayn Rand wrote in 1964...

_"Observe, in politics, that the term "extremism" has become a synonym to "evil," regardless of the content of the issue, (the evil is NOT**what** you are "extreme" about...but that you are extreme-ly _consistent_). **WRITTEN in 1964!!!**_

Meaning... as Conservative or Constitutional and Platform Republicans choose to stand **FIRM** in their values and society _shifts_ its moral pendulum farther away, it is the Republican that is seen as EXTREME. We are a free country and a citizen can shift their moral pendulum with the wind as much as they want as long as it doesn't infringe on the rights of another. But if Republicans and especially elected representatives don't stand FIRM on the values of the party, and actively work TOGETHER to sharpen each other on the values...who's left to defend the American exceptionalism of life, liberty and the pursuit of happiness?

The truth shall set us free.

With much blessings,
---
|
---
| –Chairman Underwood

We are "this" close to losing our Red state because we are literally fighting, George Soros, Sam Bankman-Fried (Crypto Guy), George Clooney, Steven Spielberg, Jeffrey Katzenberg, and more. In 2020, over 250 Democratic donors maxed out their Federal limit of $10,000 to the Democratic Party. Do you know how many of the $10,000 Republican donors from previous years have maxed out their Federal limit to the party in 2023? NONE. This is truly a party of the people, funded BY the people, to do work FOR the people. And, that is what the Republican Party of Nebraska is doing. Day by day, finding every opportunity to build a relationship and connect voters to the Conservative Values of this party. ALL Republicans are supposed to have the same objectives to promote our values and influence the culture of Nebraska and do so both in government positions as well as citizens. We receive 100's of emails and phone calls from Nebraskans concerned about the erosion of morals and ethics and consistency to values from elected officials, but I argue that the erosion of the very same standards has happened exponentially faster within our society. From high taxes, to pornography in schools and the curriculum standards, higher education systems of UNL actively promoting woke policies, election security that HAS to be addressed to have Election Accountability and Voter Verification, crime, mental health, environment and energy independence, LIFE - HUMAN LIFE...the people of Nebraska what our principles prioritized , NOT hurt feelings because of no compromise. are what separates the Republican Party from the Democratic Party (or any others). When personalities are removed and values are promoted, the people will SHOW UP because they see what a political party is FOR. It's FOR them, to represent them, to speak FOR them, to promote FOR them. We cannot compromise anymore on our moral principles. When people say "Doesn't life require compromise?" this truly translates to "Doesn't life require the surrender of that which is good and true to that which is evil and false?" Ayn Rand wrote in 1964... "Observe, in politics, that the term "extremism" has become a synonym to "evil," regardless of the content of the issue, (the evil is NOTwhat you are "extreme" about...but that you are extreme-ly consistent). WRITTEN in 1964!!! Meaning... as Conservative or Constitutional and Platform Republicans choose to stand FIRM in their values and society shifts its moral pendulum farther away, it is the Republican that is seen as EXTREME. We are a free country and a citizen can shift their moral pendulum with the wind as much as they want as long as it doesn't infringe on the rights of another. But if Republicans and especially elected representatives don't stand FIRM on the values of the party, and actively work TOGETHER to sharpen each other on the values...who's left to defend the American exceptionalism of life, liberty and the pursuit of happiness? The truth shall set us free. As a reliable Democrat in 43614, we're personally asking you to endorse Kirsten's must-win reelection campaign. | | Friend, Kirsten Gillibrand has promised results for families — and she's working hard to get the job done. Last year, Kirsten won justice reform for survivors of sexual abuse in our armed forces, expanded health care protections for veterans and passed legislation to crack down on interstate gun trafficking. She spent years fighting to make these bills become law — but she isn't slowing down for even a moment. Now, she's leading the charge to lower the cost of living, secure paid family leave for all Americans and finally certify the Equal Rights Amendment, which would give us a legal basis to restore reproductive rights across the nation. Friend, Kirsten knows exactly how to deliver results and win real progress for Americans.And that's exactly why the GOP is dead-set on defeating her next fall. New York Republicans just had their best election cycle in decades. Now, they think this momentum advantage will be enough to defeat Kirsten and flip her Senate seat RED. Kirsten isn't afraid of a tough fight, but she's counting on a huge surge of grassroots support to show the GOP that her seat isn't up for grabs. | | | * | = A note from Kirsten: Friend, I can’t thank you enough for standing by my side in the critical fights ahead of us. While Republicans only have to defend 10 seats in 2024, Democrats have to defend 23 – and if the GOP flips just two of them, it will deliver Senate control back to Mitch McConnell. Now, experts at FiveThirtyEight are saying that the GOP has a clear path to the majority. As right-wing special interests gear up to pour millions into flipping the Senate, we need to fight back right now. If there’s one thing you need to know about our Senate race, it’s that MAGA Republicans see no greater threat to their power than yours truly. |

Peter, if there’s one thing you need to know about our Senate race, it’s that **MAGA Republicans see no greater threat to their power than yours truly.**

Just look at how they’ve reacted in the last six months since we announced this campaign:

As soon as Kevin McCarthy had scraped by in the Speaker election — with a bare minimum number of votes after his _fifteenth_ humiliating attempt — **he removed me as the top Democrat on the Intelligence Committee.**

McCarthy is so weak that his chief antagonists in the Speaker’s race — like Matt Gaetz and Anna Paulina Luna — have hijacked floor proceedings time and again to target me even further with political attacks.

**Introducing legislation to bar me from receiving classified information.**

**Censuring me in political retaliation for investigating and impeaching Donald Trump.**

**Even trying to fine me $16 million.**

And Trump himself continues to attack me too. Including calling me out by name in an exclusive sit-down interview with _Fox News_ last week, _and expressing his hope that I will not be elected to the Senate._

Why do they continue to make me the target of their attacks?

Because time and again, when Trump has violated the law and abused his power by...
* Soliciting and using Russian help in the 2016 election
* Leveraging his office and U.S. military aid to Ukraine to get Zelenskyy to smear Joe Biden
* Inciting the deadly insurrection to stop the peaceful transfer of power on January 6

**...I’ve stood up again and again to say it isn’t okay. It’s criminal.**

Investigating foreign interference in our elections. Impeaching him for abusing his oath of office. Speaking the truth about what Trump knew and did on January 6.

**MAGA Republicans do not want to see Californians elect me to represent them in the Senate, because no one has stood up to Trump and his cronies as often and as effectively as I have. For _years._**

They aren’t going to stop attacking me or our campaign. And very often I’m going to need your help to respond. That’s why I’m asking:

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

subject: This is why I served

body:
To view this email as a web page, go to the link below, or copy and paste it into your browser's address window.
https://view.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=70f7838032fcf1eb7999f2d2c0dbf8e5d4e8d10aac66485db10eda3eca77dfe1fcde18a81ca8e14cc78a5af9e48e369b7d18823b8f342582c1218f2059b54ad7636773c2600a7c2204a128357f1dfd95

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=f78b680442e1534565ce910aa22b2766ed108925958300a5ec66fa9f9909ea6ac10761225bcd8847e3111b931e0c09f5f6723a71904b4a969703d331fc7681fc

Friend,

If you've heard my story, you know that I went from being a blue-collar kid in Florida, to attending Yale on a baseball scholarship, to working my way through Harvard Law School... all leading up to the day I saw our freedom come under fire on September 11th, 2001, and volunteering to serve in the proudest fighting force in the world.

When I deployed to Iraq with U.S. Navy SEAL Team One, I put on the cloth of my country, shipped out with a sense of confidence, conviction, and patriotic duty to our nation, and served with undying honor. Fighting for this country has always been personal to me, and I will hold that honor close to my chest for as long as I live.

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=f78b680442e1534565ce910aa22b2766ed108925958300a5ec66fa9f9909ea6ac10761225bcd8847e3111b931e0c09f5f6723a71904b4a969703d331fc7681fc

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=f78b680442e1534565ce910aa22b2766ed108925958300a5ec66fa9f9909ea6ac10761225bcd8847e3111b931e0c09f5f6723a71904b4a969703d331fc7681fc

As the only veteran in this race, I feel a responsibility to step up and lead with the conviction I'll never shake from my time in the service. I believe our country deserves a Commander-in-Chief who truly understands what we're fighting for and what we're fighting against.

The gravity of the situation we're now facing is nothing short of dire.

Our nation’s once-proud fighting force has been infected and paralyzed by a political agenda, our military recruitment levels have reached an all-time low, and yet we are expected to salute our "Commander-in-Chief," Joe Biden.

Not only is this a slap in the face to the veterans across this country, but it is an insult to every soldier who has come before our time:

-
Those 56 men who pledged their lives in Independence Hall in 1776 so that they could create a new nation conceived in liberty.
-
Our nation's first Republican President who stood at a cemetery in Gettysburg and pledged this nation to a new birth of freedom.
-
That band of brothers who stormed the beaches of Normandy, defeated the Nazis, and saved this world.

As a veteran, as a former Congressman, as Governor, and as a father, I have remained steadfast in my devotion to reminding those who will listen of the words of Ronald Reagan:

Freedom is one generation away from extinction; it's not passed along in the bloodstream, and it must be protected and cultivated.

Today, I am humbly asking you for support to help me fire Joe Biden and restore this mission and sanity, pride, integrity, and capability to the chief office of our military.

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=f78b680442e1534565ce910aa22b2766ed108925958300a5ec66fa9f9909ea6ac10761225bcd8847e3111b931e0c09f5f6723a71904b4a969703d331fc7681fc
Support my campaign for President

And friend, I am also asking you for one more thing. Please, as our freedoms continue to come under fire every day that we allow Joe Biden to sit in our Oval Office, choose to stand on the side of freedom today, and always. I need you fighting with me.

Yours in Freedom,

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=f78b680442e1534565ce910aa22b2766ed108925958300a5ec66fa9f9909ea6ac10761225bcd8847e3111b931e0c09f5f6723a71904b4a969703d331fc7681fc

Ron DeSantis

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=f78b680442e153454fa1103cae78edc17d8c0e3dc108c79e58070d378b61c544e3fb3855e2e835548586f50b630248ec02003cd93b57a2084d211672256fb775

🚨 ATTENTION 🚨

Our grassroots team drives our every success, and we know we ask a lot of you to help us win this critical election. As this race continues to heat up, we will be relying on our supporters to help us go the distance, and we want to make sure we respect your preferences when we reach out to you. If you'd like to receive fewer emails from our team, please click
https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=f78b680442e153455a8b50c2a0d3b8b22f8c584d01d9fd3f0045ce1dc3f28ac1878db79c64598d8df317efc98c7ce1188714fcb62ee8cf1e6f643253f815da10
here.

Volunteer!

We welcome you to join Team DeSantis by volunteering to spread our message: Decline is a choice. Success is attainable. And freedom is worth fighting for.

Help us lead our Great American Comeback by getting involved today!

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=f78b680442e153457e48de720fff6e40d4542a9eb078ef0d385694b34e1b5239812800c2c02b4a366e55ed3faa21438410edb8afcff909f5025062a132fd12db
Sign up here!

Get to Know Ron DeSantis

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=f78b680442e1534565ce910aa22b2766ed108925958300a5ec66fa9f9909ea6ac10761225bcd8847e3111b931e0c09f5f6723a71904b4a969703d331fc7681fc

Ron DeSantis comes from blue-collar roots in the state of Florida. Nothing was handed to him, he worked his way through college and led his team as the Yale Baseball captain.

After earning his undergraduate degree, Ron DeSantis graduated from Harvard Law School, but was so moved by the events of September 11, 2001, that he volunteered to serve in the Navy to fight for our freedom.

When he returned, he started a life of public service by serving Florida as both Congressman and now Governor.

Despite all his years of fighting to ensure the American people enjoy the freedom we're promised in this country, he's watched the Left strip away freedoms at every turn and impose radical agendas on children, families, and consumers nationwide.

In 2009, Ron met the love of his life Casey in Florida, and he's now the proud father of 6, 5, and 3-year-old children. Because of his kids, Ron DeSantis knows that this fight is personal and understands the frustration parents face when teachers' unions and liberal groups shove a political agenda down the throats of children.

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=f78b680442e1534565ce910aa22b2766ed108925958300a5ec66fa9f9909ea6ac10761225bcd8847e3111b931e0c09f5f6723a71904b4a969703d331fc7681fc

On Day One, Ron DeSantis has promised that he will bring a RECKONING for what unelected bureaucrats like Anthony Fauci and DC elites have done to children. Ron DeSantis will ignite our Great American Comeback by immediately getting to work stopping the invasion across our southern border, ensuring our military once again puts the mission first, declaring our economic independence, and restoring our American energy dominance so that our country gets back on track before it's too late.

In Florida, Ron DeSantis' record speaks for itself. He’s taken on the political establishment, politicized bureaucratic agencies, woke corporations, and the legacy media countless times and won every single time. Under his leadership, Florida has cultivated a thriving economy. It has stood as a citadel of freedom, and with him as our next President, America can once again be that shining City on a Hill for the rest of the world to look upon.

That's why he's running for President of the United States. Ron DeSantis knows that the decline of our country is a choice that cannot continue for another four years; the time to lead is now.... the time to act is now.

Friend, If you've heard my story, you know that I went from being a blue-collar kid in Florida, to attending Yale on a baseball scholarship, to working my way through Harvard Law School... all leading up to the day I saw our freedom come under fire on September 11th, 2001, and volunteering to serve in the proudest fighting force in the world. When I deployed to Iraq with U.S. Navy SEAL Team One, I put on the cloth of my country, shipped out with a sense of confidence, conviction, and patriotic duty to our nation, and served with undying honor. Fighting for this country has always been personal to me, and I will hold that honor close to my chest for as long as I live. As the only veteran in this race, I feel a responsibility to step up and lead with the conviction I'll never shake from my time in the service. I believe our country deserves a Commander-in-Chief who truly understands what we're fighting for and what we're fighting against. The gravity of the situation we're now facing is nothing short of dire. Our nation’s once-proud fighting force has been infected and paralyzed by a political agenda, our military recruitment levels have reached an all-time low, and yet we are expected to salute our "Commander-in-Chief," Joe Biden. Not only is this a slap in the face to the veterans across this country, but it is an insult to every soldier who has come before our time: - Those 56 men who pledged their lives in Independence Hall in 1776 so that they could create a new nation conceived in liberty. - Our nation's first Republican President who stood at a cemetery in Gettysburg and pledged this nation to a new birth of freedom. - That band of brothers who stormed the beaches of Normandy, defeated the Nazis, and saved this world. As a veteran, as a former Congressman, as Governor, and as a father, I have remained steadfast in my devotion to reminding those who will listen of the words of Ronald Reagan: Freedom is one generation away from extinction; it's not passed along in the bloodstream, and it must be protected and cultivated. Today, I am humbly asking you for support to help me fire Joe Biden and restore this mission and sanity, pride, integrity, and capability to the chief office of our military. Support my campaign for President And friend, I am also asking you for one more thing. Please, as our freedoms continue to come under fire every day that we allow Joe Biden to sit in our Oval Office, choose to stand on the side of freedom today, and always. I need you fighting with me. Yours in Freedom, Ron DeSantis 🚨 ATTENTION 🚨 Our grassroots team drives our every success, and we know we ask a lot of you to help us win this critical election. As this race continues to heat up, we will be relying on our supporters to help us go the distance, and we want to make sure we respect your preferences when we reach out to you. If you'd like to receive fewer emails from our team, please click here. Volunteer! We welcome you to join Team DeSantis by volunteering to spread our message: Decline is a choice. Success is attainable. And freedom is worth fighting for. Help us lead our Great American Comeback by getting involved today! Sign up here! Get to Know Ron DeSantis Ron DeSantis comes from blue-collar roots in the state of Florida. Nothing was handed to him, he worked his way through college and led his team as the Yale Baseball captain. After earning his undergraduate degree, Ron DeSantis graduated from Harvard Law School, but was so moved by the events of September 11, 2001, that he volunteered to serve in the Navy to fight for our freedom. When he returned, he started a life of public service by serving Florida as both Congressman and now Governor. Despite all his years of fighting to ensure the American people enjoy the freedom we're promised in this country, he's watched the Left strip away freedoms at every turn and impose radical agendas on children, families, and consumers nationwide. In 2009, Ron met the love of his life Casey in Florida, and he's now the proud father of 6, 5, and 3-year-old children. Because of his kids, Ron DeSantis knows that this fight is personal and understands the frustration parents face when teachers' unions and liberal groups shove a political agenda down the throats of children. On Day One, Ron DeSantis has promised that he will bring a RECKONING for what unelected bureaucrats like Anthony Fauci and DC elites have done to children. Ron DeSantis will ignite our Great American Comeback by immediately getting to work stopping the invasion across our southern border, ensuring our military once again puts the mission first, declaring our economic independence, and restoring our American energy dominance so that our country gets back on track before it's too late. In Florida, Ron DeSantis' record speaks for itself. He’s taken on the political establishment, politicized bureaucratic agencies, woke corporations, and the legacy media countless times and won every single time. Under his leadership, Florida has cultivated a thriving economy. It has stood as a citadel of freedom, and with him as our next President, America can once again be that shining City on a Hill for the rest of the world to look upon. That's why he's running for President of the United States. Ron DeSantis knows that the decline of our country is a choice that cannot continue for another four years; the time to lead is now.... the time to act is now. name: Jay Jones
subject: Support Planned Parenthood today!
body:
Friend,
The results of last week’s election send a clear message that Virginians want our Commonwealth to remain pro-reproductive rights.
We also know that regardless of the outcomes of an election, there will always be actions that threaten to limit access to reproductive healthcare, which is why I will advocate tirelessly over the years ahead that we enshrine a woman's right to choose in Virginia's constitution.
No matter what, our priority remains the same: to protect access to essential, time-sensitive sexual and reproductive healthcare. Part of how we accomplish that is by supporting our community partners on the front lines of reproductive healthcare.
That is why I’m reaching out to you today on behalf of Virginia League for Planned Parenthood (VLPP) to ask that we stand together to ensure continued access to affordable, high quality reproductive healthcare.
Please join me by supporting VLPP today! [https://www.weareplannedparenthood.org/onlineactions/cOJVhOyrzkq4uBcxVekXFA2?sourceid=1000065&affiliateID=091750&_gl=1*1jkdawd*_ga*MTQyNjAwMDg1NS4xNjI0MzAxMDYx*_gid*MjAyNzA2Nzg3Ny4xNjk5NTQ2MzA1]
I believe that every individual’s personal decision about their own reproductive health should be respected and valued.
Thanks for fighting with me.
- Jay

#

It’s important that we speak extremely clearly about this, Peter.
On Veterans Day of all days, Donald Trump threatened to “root out” his political opponents. He called them “vermin.”
His advisors have released draconian immigration plans, calling for the deportation of millions. They plan to hollow out the federal government and replace thousands of career public servants with MAGA fanatics. They have openly talked about weaponizing the military and federal law enforcement against protestors.
They aren’t even trying to hide it anymore. Trump’s ultimate goal is a dictatorship. A second Trump presidency could be the end of American democracy as we know it.
Ruben Gallego is a Marine. He swore to defend our Constitution, and he’s no stranger to a tough fight.
Ruben can beat Kari Lake in Arizona. And if we can beat Kari Lake, there’s a good chance that we can beat Trump, too. We can keep Kari Lake out of the Senate and keep Donald Trump out of the White House.

# [Add your name: The Supreme Court's ethics code doesn't go far enough -- Congress needs to enforce a real code of ethics!](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tab0c99d6-2b5e-41fd-b0f0-39f796c4e5fc/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

| | | After bombshell reports revealed that Supreme Court Justices Clarence Thomas and Samuel Alito have gone on lavish vacations paid for by billionaire GOP donors, the Supreme Court has decided to adopt a new code of ethics. But this “new” code doesn’t really have any new guidelines, and it doesn’t have any clear process to enforce the code. Bottom line: the Supreme Court is paying lip service and we need Congress to enforce an actual code of ethics. Democrats on the Senate Judiciary Committee have been pushing for a set of ethical standards for the Supreme Court, “which would [allow](https://default.salsalabs.org/Te426a883-a231-4dd1-8486-d0bc0f978b3a/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) for independent review of recusal decisions and more.” We need Congress to enforce a code of ethics, not just to trust the Supreme Court to govern themselves. # Campaign News and Views
Ryan becomes first candidate to visit all 99 counties in Iowa!
---
| [ ](https://binkley2024.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5894b488eac5a196e1e5d6896&id=ec197c0a77&e=c1403f41d3)
---
### Huge Announcement!
Ryan visited his 99th county in Iowa on Friday, becoming the first candidate to visit all counties in the state. We celebrated this milestone with an "Ugly Christmas Sweater" party in Des Moines. The great news doesn't stop there. The campaign has over 74,000 unique donors verified by the Republican National Committee. Our next goal is to reach 80k donors and achieve 6% polling to qualify for the next debate in December. _[Watch video here](https://binkley2024.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5894b488eac5a196e1e5d6896&id=db75472b62&e=c1403f41d3)_

---
### YRNF Mock Caucus
Last weekend, Young Republican committee members participated in a mock caucus. Ryan scored 7.8% of the vote, gaining fourth place! While not an official poll, it reflects Ryan's growing presence in the minds of Iowan voters. _[Read here](https://binkley2024.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5894b488eac5a196e1e5d6896&id=fe683889ac&e=c1403f41d3)_

---
### Generational Salute
Ryan spoke at the Generational Salute, an event celebrating the service of veterans. He talked about their sacrifice for America's freedom and how those values still need to be fought for today. [_Watch here_](https://binkley2024.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5894b488eac5a196e1e5d6896&id=3fdaa42cd8&e=c1403f41d3)

### Scott Sands Podcast
Ryan returns to the Scott Sands Podcast and discusses the latest Republican debate. Despite not qualifying, Ryan remains optimistic about his campaign's growing support. __[Listen](https://binkley2024.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5894b488eac5a196e1e5d6896&id=b96435f1b1&e=c1403f41d3)[ here](https://binkley2024.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5894b488eac5a196e1e5d6896&id=97e3ab56da&e=c1403f41d3)__

### ScoonTV's Politickin
Ryan guest starred on the podcast Politickin from ScoonTV. Host Seth Tamarkin asked tough questions about socialism and Ryan's plan for urban America. [_Watch here_](https://binkley2024.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5894b488eac5a196e1e5d6896&id=c30bcdffb6&e=c1403f41d3)

✅Provided universal meals to Minnesota students
✅Put Minnesota on the path to 100% clean energy

Friends,
There is this growing sense of unease, that an impending shoe is about to drop. You probably feel it. I feel it too.
[](https://kathybarnette.substack.com/p/understanding-the-basics-israel-palestine#media-ee9fdbb2-6a8a-42bf-8b7b-b977f0a6d4ef)
This conflict, unravelling in the Middle East, has the making of World War III, especially given the reactions that we are seeing in western countries and from their "leaders". They know exactly what they are doing, and we are the ones who risk paying the price.
This battle is not *just* between Israelis and Palestinians.
In this episode, I address the ongoing conflict between Israel and Palestine. I explain my concern about the growing unease in the world and my desire to seek knowledge for understanding. Since a LOT of people decided to give very uninformed, yet confident, opinions about the conflict and its nature, I felt the need to go over some historical basics.
Does Hamas represent the Palestinian people?
I then analyze the role of the parties involved, including Hamas and the Palestinian Authority, and their impact on the conflict. I question the global response to the conflict, highlighting the contrasting perspectives and actions of world leaders and the media.
We need to understand the importance of historical context and of forming informed opinions based on facts rather than emotions.

While Congress is still debating whether or not to send additional funding to Ukraine, with a congressional funding deadline looming on November 17th, the Biden Administration has sent Transportation Secretary Pete Buttigieg to meet with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky in the city of Kyiv. In a bulletin posted to the Department of Transportation's website, the stated goal of the meeting is for Buttigieg and Zelensky to discuss Ukraine's economic recovery. That bulletin reads... "The discussions will focus on advancing Ukraine's economic recovery and efforts to return Ukraine to economic self-sufficiency, including via supporting investments in transportation infrastructure and reforms that will support a return to private-sector led growth."
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/5a2f1d99-2058-476b-9216-5a476ef3576f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

Also attending the meeting between Buttigieg and Zelensky is the son of billionaire Democrat mega-donor George Soros, Alex Soros. Why is Alex Soros meeting with Biden Transportation Secretary Pete Buttigieg and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelesky just eight days before a Congressional funding deadline in which House Republicans are working to limit additional aid to Ukraine amid threats of a potential government shutdown. This is the same scenario that led to former House Speaker Kevin McCarthy striking a deal with Democrats in September to pass a 45 day Continuing Resolution as opposed to a government shutdown, because McCarthy refused to remove funding for Ukraine in the budget.

| Peter,

Yesterday, I launched my gubernatorial campaign — and I wanted to share a few thoughts after the first 24 hours.

When I launched my first campaign back in 2017, I was inspired to run because of the many stories I’d heard from our friends and neighbors facing healthcare challenges.

Today, like in 2017, I’m running because I want to improve the quality of life and increase opportunities for people across Virginia. Together, we can make our Commonwealth stronger for everyone who lives here.

Whether you live in Richmond, Danville, Norfolk, Leesburg, or Stanley - we can build a prosperous future for everyone. That means a stronger economy, safer communities, more job opportunities, fully funded schools, affordable housing, and lower healthcare costs.

In my first race, many pundits said I couldn’t win. But we proved them wrong — and I became the first Democrat to win VA-07 since 1968. **I know how to win tough races and get things done, because I’ve been doing it for years. And make no mistake: this will be a tough race.**

In the last 24 hours, I’ve heard from so many people across Virginia sharing personal stories about their hopes for the future.

# In The News....
Last week, John made multiple appearances on News Nation to share his expert analysis on the Israel-Hamas war and tensions in the Middle East. John also touched on the leadership (or lack thereof) in the White House, and his thoughts on foreign policy.
Watch his interviews below:
[](https://teichertformaryland.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1ec0c6fa331e836475672e631&id=25bc0d6ba2&e=1b1fb1ad9f)
John Teichert joined [News Nation](https://teichertformaryland.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1ec0c6fa331e836475672e631&id=1334dd8631&e=1b1fb1ad9f) on Thursday to discuss the Israel-Hamas war. During a discussion about the intricate tunnel system created by Hamas, General Teichert noted that **“It’s clear to me and the other experts that the Israelis have started to isolate Hamas within those tunnels which is doing a variety of things: 1) it’s giving civilians the chance to evacuate along that humanitarian corridor that was mentioned previously and it’s also isolating the challenge among the IDF as they continue to squeeze in and take out, tunnel by tunnel, those safe havens for Hamas.”**
[](https://teichertformaryland.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1ec0c6fa331e836475672e631&id=f16d7761d4&e=1b1fb1ad9f)
John joined [News Nation](https://teichertformaryland.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1ec0c6fa331e836475672e631&id=d9562a4ba1&e=1b1fb1ad9f) on Monday to discuss the conflict in Gaza. In response to a Senate resolution, Teichert said, **“All of this is about that word ‘deterrence,’ which means stopping the adversary, Iran in this case, from doing what you don’t want them to do. I think this resolution is rooted in a perceived American weakness in the region. What I mean by that is that we’ve got these great asset capability that we’ve now deployed to the Middle East, as we should, but in the Iranians minds, there’s a question about our will – our actual will to respond if attacked or provoked because we’ve been appeasing Iran for the last three years Ultimately this senatorial resolution would demonstrate a level of will that we haven’t seen from President Biden for the last three years.”**
|

Friends,

Last week 70 House Republicans voted to approve $300 million in funding for the construction of new headquarters for the FBI.

Yes, you read that right. Instead of voting to defund, investigate, or dismantle this weaponized agency working against the interests of the American people, the House GOP voted to give them shiny new offices. **It was nothing short of a stunning betrayal.**

**[Please consider supporting Citizens for Renewing America with a gift of $50, $75, or $100 to hold the House GOP Accountable](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=6ca9176558&e=17913c7d6d)**.

→ Raided President Trump’s home at Mar-a-Lago and my colleague Jeff Clark’s home in the pre-dawn hours.

That’s why we’ve spent the last year raising the alarm bells. Exposing rogue elements in this agency colluding with the left and the D.C. cartel.

Fortunately, we have heroes like my colleague Steve Friend who _sacrificed his career_ to blow the whistle on the FBI’s mishandling of cases related to January 6th. Now he’s on our team and has caught the attention of America First patriots in Congress like Rep. Anna Paulina Luna and Rep. Matt Gaetz.

Mark my words, we’re going to make sure that constituents of the 70 House Republicans know that their member of Congress voted to give hundreds of millions to the weaponized FBI.

| Fellow activist,

According to _AP News_ , last Tuesday’s state Supreme Court election in PA was “unlike any other. There was record-breaking spending, national media coverage, and **_the highest turnout for an odd-year election in at least a quarter-century.”_**

Our CEO, Kadida Kenner, was quoted in the article, talking about how these high-profile judicial races are the product of Republican-backed efforts to overturn elections.

_“This is the future, and I don’t think we’re going back from this,” Kenner said. “And I think our judicial races will be even more partisan in the future.”_

[**We are proud to have turned out voters in support of Judge McCaffery this election cycle. But, with Pennsylvania proving once again to be a top battleground state, the work is far from over. NPP will continue to center historically disenfranchised and underrepresented Black, Indigenous and other people of color, immigrant communities and the youth in our work as we prepare for 2024. Will you help us get started by donating $5 today?**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/73352234/438219188/-1739567893?refcode=EM_F_231114turnout_N_ON_90DO_15_G_N_L1&amount=5&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVjAwMS8xLzkwOTIwIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjg5M2FhOWExLTE3ODMtZWUxMS04OTI1LTAwMjI0ODMyZTgxMSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=9RNA6VUniUJ9Q5fnh7b0H6hqUST5E-xx2OTxHSZYL90=) **[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/73352237/438219190/-1739567893?refcode=EM_F_231114turnout_N_ON_90DO_15_G_N_P1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVjAwMS8xLzkwOTIwIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjg5M2FhOWExLTE3ODMtZWUxMS04OTI1LTAwMjI0ODMyZTgxMSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=9RNA6VUniUJ9Q5fnh7b0H6hqUST5E-xx2OTxHSZYL90=)** Here’s the breakdown of what we accomplished:

**In support of Judge McCaffery, the New Pennsylvania Project...**

🚪 Knocked on more than 18,000 doors.

📲 Sent 14,000 text messages to potential voters.

☎️ Made 26,000 phone calls.

We went ALL OUT. And it worked: Pennsylvania set a record high for turnout during an odd-year election. Turnout increased from 2.52 million in 2019 to 2.76 million in 2021 and 3.04 million this year. **Part of that record-high turnout was achieved by the thousands of conversations that NPP staff had with voters.** **[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/73352238/438219192/-1739567893?refcode=EM_F_231114turnout_N_ON_90DO_15_G_N_P2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVjAwMS8xLzkwOTIwIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjg5M2FhOWExLTE3ODMtZWUxMS04OTI1LTAwMjI0ODMyZTgxMSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=9RNA6VUniUJ9Q5fnh7b0H6hqUST5E-xx2OTxHSZYL90=)****You don’t have to take it from us. Here is a story of one of those conversations:**

_I ran into a voter coming from another house on Broad St and I asked her if she was voting today and she stated that this election was not as important as next year's election for President so I explained to her the importance of the courts as it relates to the rights of the people, especially women. She thought about it, and while she was thinking I said "This may be the most important thing you do this year." She said, "You are going to make me want to vote" so she asked for advice on who to vote for. I gave her the voter education guide and the door hanger with Dan McCaffery at the top then I explained to her that the reason that he is at the top was he has to win the most important position of all, which is PA Supreme Court Justice. He has told all of us that he will hold the line against Republicans taking away our voting rights, women's access to abortions, clean water and air and also school funding. She agreed and she is going to her polling place right now to vote for the Democratic lineup featuring Judge Dan McCaffery._

Our tactics work. Now, we have our eyes set on 2024.

**We will quickly turn our attention back to year-round civic education and voter registration in addition to preparing for the 2024 Presidential election and other critically important judicial seats on the ballot in 2025. But we need your help.**

[**Thanks to you, we are expanding democracy by transforming and expanding the Pennsylvania electorate. We have already seen the impact of our work in 2022 and 2023; now, we are preparing for 2024 and beyond. name: Shamaine Daniels
subject: We won!
body:
www.danielsforcongress.com [www.danielsforcongress.com]
Dear Friend,
One week ago, Dauphin County, the only county contained entirely within PA-10, woke up to BIG news. Democrats had flipped Dauphin County from Red to Blue. For the first time in a CENTURY Dauphin has a Democratic majority on the Board of County Commissioners!
This historic event could not have happened without the tireless work of dedicated Democrats like the late Howard Parker. Your donation supports the work of volunteers like him who showed up regularly to advocate for the candidates that shared their values and helped make history.
Every campaign in Dauphin County has helped to move the needle toward this historic victory, including our campaign in 2022. That means YOU had a hand in making this happen too. Can you make a contribution to our campaign to help us keep the momentum going into 2024! [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sdemail2023]
This is great news for those of us who live in Dauphin County and want to see county government work to make people’s lives better, and it’s big news because it is another indicator that we CAN beat Scott Perry and take PA-10 next year!
We’ve got Republicans on the run in PA-10. Scott Perry has never been more vulnerable than he will be next year. We’ve got this, but we need your continued support to make it happen. Donate now! [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sdemail2023]
In the most recent election for county commissioner, Republicans won the county by 6.49%. In 2022 I won Dauphin County, my home county, by 3.32%. Last Tuesday’s Democratic victories in PA, and across the country, demonstrate that in next year’s re-match with Scott Perry, our campaign can run up the score even further in Dauphin and close the small gap we need to defeat Freedom Caucus Chairman, Scott Perry!
This is exciting news for all of us, and I hope you are as energized as I am. Together, we can finish what we started last year!
With gratitude,
Shamaine

| I am the daughter of legal immigrants from a small, rural town in South Carolina. We were the only Indian family in our town. My father wore a turban as he still does to this day, and my mother wore a sari. No one knew who we were, what we were, or why we were there. But with each passing day, the community began to look beyond our skin color. They began to see my family for who we are: hard working people who held the same values they cherished. Gradually, those initial stares transformed into smiles and we shifted from being excluded to embraced. Not every day was perfect. But every day was better than the one before it.
---
After graduating from Clemson and working in the corporate world, I decided to take a job working for my family's business that my mother started in our living room when I was a child. I was frustrated when I saw how hard it was to make a dollar and how easy it was for government to take it away. When I voiced these frustrations to my mom, she gave me some wise advice which was: _" Don't complain. Do something about it." _
---
| | | So, that's exactly what I did and I decided to run for state legislature. But it wasn't easy. I ran against the longest-serving legislator in the state and hardly anyone thought I had a chance. I was polling at 15 percent a week before the primary. **But the people of South Carolina took a chance on me, and we won. ➡️**

It was an honor to serve the people as a state legislator. I fought against the status quo and stood up for the people of my district. When I fought for government transparency by pushing to make sure important votes were on the record, my colleagues retaliated. They stripped me of my committees. So I decided to run for governor.

When I campaigned for governor, people didn't know who I was. I was polling in fourth place, with limited time until Election Day. I was the least funded and least known GOP candidate. But together, we defied expectations and won. Then, we made a difference in South Carolina by cutting taxes, creating thousands of jobs, and revitalizing our economy.

When I was nominated as Ambassador to the United Nations, people said I didn't have the experience. I proved them wrong. When I got to the UN, I took the "kick me" sign off our back. I told the world that America would have the backs of our allies, and for those who did not have our backs, we were taking names! The dictators, murderers, and thieves at the UN didn't know what hit them.

My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States.

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! **_

Generosity from grassroots supporters like you is the reason I am able to fund my campaign and fight for America's future. Now, I want to take a few minutes to talk with you about the journey I have been on. "Once you’ve finished reading this, please consider making a contribution of any amount to help me fund my campaign so I can get my message out to every voter!" Ever since I launched my campaign for President, I have read and heard my life described in every way imaginable. Today, I want you to hear my story in MY words. | | | | | I am the daughter of legal immigrants from a small, rural town in South Carolina. We were the only Indian family in our town. My father wore a turban as he still does to this day, and my mother wore a sari. No one knew who we were, what we were, or why we were there. But with each passing day, the community began to look beyond our skin color. They began to see my family for who we are: hard working people who held the same values they cherished. Gradually, those initial stares transformed into smiles and we shifted from being excluded to embraced. Not every day was perfect. But every day was better than the one before it. After graduating from Clemson and working in the corporate world, I decided to take a job working for my family's business that my mother started in our living room when I was a child. I was frustrated when I saw how hard it was to make a dollar and how easy it was for government to take it away. When I voiced these frustrations to my mom, she gave me some wise advice which was: " Don't complain. Do something about it." | | | So, that's exactly what I did and I decided to run for state legislature. But it wasn't easy. I ran against the longest-serving legislator in the state and hardly anyone thought I had a chance. I was polling at 15 percent a week before the primary. But the people of South Carolina took a chance on me, and we won. ➡️ | | It was an honor to serve the people as a state legislator. I fought against the status quo and stood up for the people of my district. When I fought for government transparency by pushing to make sure important votes were on the record, my colleagues retaliated. They stripped me of my committees. So I decided to run for governor. When I campaigned for governor, people didn't know who I was. I was polling in fourth place, with limited time until Election Day. I was the least funded and least known GOP candidate. But together, we defied expectations and won. Then, we made a difference in South Carolina by cutting taxes, creating thousands of jobs, and revitalizing our economy. When I was nominated as Ambassador to the United Nations, people said I didn't have the experience. I proved them wrong. When I got to the UN, I took the "kick me" sign off our back. I told the world that America would have the backs of our allies, and for those who did not have our backs, we were taking names! The dictators, murderers, and thieves at the UN didn't know what hit them. Now, I'm running for President because our country is heading down a path of doubt, division, and self-destruction. We need a leader who will rise to the occasion, offer solutions, and prioritize serving the people over the political class. Right now, our Supreme Court doesn't just lean conservative — it’s straight up corrupt. Congress has the ability to change that: We should expand the court, enforce term limits, get politics out of our judicial system, and implement a substantive, enforceable judicial code of ethics.
I’m running for Senate because those in power need to be held accountable to the people they’re supposed to serve. [**I’m fighting to clean up corruption through real, substantive legislation. Can you sign on to show your support for reforming the Supreme Court?**](https://act.katieporter.com/signup/kp4s-em-reform-scotus-2?refcode=EMAN23_1_RSC_20231114_V1_F&akid=33118%2E3422442%2EBgLDg7)

_**The Mackenzie Minute**_

* * *
Peter,

We are now just a little less than 1 year until we unseat Congresswoman Susan Wild. I am working hard every day to make sure that’s what happens - meeting voters throughout the 7th District and earning endorsements from local leaders. Here are a few highlights from my week:

• Charlie Gerow “Defender of Limited Government Award”
• Former Carbon County Republican Chair Endorsement
• Northampton County Republican Women
• Thank You Veterans!
• Did You See A Problem At The Polls?

As always, if you need to get in contact with my campaign, please feel free to reach out at (484) 347-8777.

All the Best,

* * *
**NEWS**
* * *
**Charlie Gerow “Defender of Limited Government Award”**
I was recently recognized with the “Charlie Gerow Defender of Limited Government” Award from the Institute for Legislative Analysis. As State Representative, I have made reforming government, being fiscally responsible, and defending the rights of our citizens my top priorities, and it is always appreciated when that work is recognized.

While I appreciate recognitions like this for what I have accomplished and supported in the past, we must continue working to make government more efficient, more transparent, and better for taxpayers.

* * *
**Former Carbon County Republican Chairman Endorsement.**
This week, former Carbon County Republican Party Chairman Joe Steber joined the list of local leaders endorsing our candidacy for Congress, and I thank him for his support. Steber explained his support for my campaign by saying, “As a former chair for Carbon County, I realized the importance of electing a candidate that showcases their ability to connect with constituents and effectively represent their interests, more importantly, defeat an incumbent entrenched in Washington DC. Ryan is well-prepared to tackle the challenges we face as a community and has a proven track record of success in advocating for our concerns and needs”

* * *
**Northampton County Republican Women**
This week I had the opportunity to speak with the Northampton County Republican Women. I enjoyed conversations with small business owner and veteran, Helena, and so many others who attended.
| |
---|---
* * *
**Thank You, Veterans!**
On Veterans Day, I spent time with my fellow members of the Sons of the American Revolution in Easton. Thank you to all our amazing veterans!

* * *
**Did You See A Problem At The Polls?**

Ensuring the integrity of our elections is an important part of my campaign and the issues I want to address in Congress.

As you may have seen, Northampton County saw numerous issues on Election Day last week, and my Election Integrity Team was there on election night and in the days since to help protect the vote.

If you or anyone you know was turned away at the polls or saw something wrong, please email my campaign at info@mackenzieforcongress.com

* * *
I want to take a moment to thank those Republicans in our communities who stepped forward to run in the 2023 election. I understand and appreciate the time, commitment, and care that goes into running for office and each of our candidates deserves recognition. Now, as we move into the holidays, I hope everyone can take a short, deserved break and then join our campaign as we focus on defeating Susan Wild in 2024 and expanding the Republican majority in the House. If you would like to be part of our team, please reach out at info@mackenzieforcongress.com or (484) 347-8777.

As State Representative, I have made reforming government, being fiscally responsible, and defending the rights of our citizens my top priorities, and it is always appreciated when that work is recognized. While I appreciate recognitions like this for what I have accomplished and supported in the past, we must continue working to make government more efficient, more transparent, and better for taxpayers. Former Carbon County Republican Chairman Endorsement. This week, former Carbon County Republican Party Chairman Joe Steber joined the list of local leaders endorsing our candidacy for Congress, and I thank him for his support. Steber explained his support for my campaign by saying, “As a former chair for Carbon County, I realized the importance of electing a candidate that showcases their ability to connect with constituents and effectively represent their interests, more importantly, defeat an incumbent entrenched in Washington DC. Ryan is well-prepared to tackle the challenges we face as a community and has a proven track record of success in advocating for our concerns and needs” Northampton County Republican Women This week I had the opportunity to speak with the Northampton County Republican Women. I enjoyed conversations with small business owner and veteran, Helena, and so many others who attended. | | ---|--- Thank You, Veterans! On Veterans Day, I spent time with my fellow members of the Sons of the American Revolution in Easton. Thank you to all our amazing veterans! Did You See A Problem At The Polls? Ensuring the integrity of our elections is an important part of my campaign and the issues I want to address in Congress. As you may have seen, Northampton County saw numerous issues on Election Day last week, and my Election Integrity Team was there on election night and in the days since to help protect the vote. If you or anyone you know was turned away at the polls or saw something wrong, please email my campaign at info@mackenzieforcongress.com I want to take a moment to thank those Republicans in our communities who stepped forward to run in the 2023 election. I understand and appreciate the time, commitment, and care that goes into running for office and each of our candidates deserves recognition. Now, as we move into the holidays, I hope everyone can take a short, deserved break and then join our campaign as we focus on defeating Susan Wild in 2024 and expanding the Republican majority in the House. If you would like to be part of our team, please reach out at info@mackenzieforcongress.com or (484) 347-8777. | Paid for by Mackenzie for Congress mailto:info@mackenzieforcongress.com P.O. Fellow Conservative, If you've heard my story, you know that I went from being a blue-collar kid in Florida, to attending Yale on a baseball scholarship, to working my way through Harvard Law School... all leading up to the day I saw our freedom come under fire on September 11th, 2001, and volunteering to serve in the proudest fighting force in the world. When I deployed to Iraq with U.S. Navy SEAL Team One, I put on the cloth of my country, shipped out with a sense of confidence, conviction, and patriotic duty to our nation, _and served with undying honor._ Fighting for this country has always been personal to me, and I will hold that honor close to my chest for as long as I live.
---
| [](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=d6bcb34e29f449aaa8707b94af333fd8&_e=kYbrj0n60lR93vvMLEJhWBs5-DU6I4V5gWRb9ql9wZi-j7puzA2l3ltEIPVaXcJ4m9YtaL_kyPr9KZgwgK19VCFFHlkkuotLU9tDloYRh98ivq9gc1ZQwpJRXwBLgUqGo0gProNqJCRFMKeDy3O8kQWZORI-vbKx3xLWBy2BRO6DrjR6coSmeCc02GTyDFQZhRoHtSfZWqkTcSRomy3LKeEX8T67757BL-5g19xd_-HDREOuqUgHVbhCwvLAE2MGwCNg8qwbk5IbnJRyYTgU9DEsIk-G7NyQIamQIBs633jmyB-IfDX6dFvex03la-ISJr1KjS5V_MmjE6y_6kC-c5JFyOEOTs5c0h3CuFDLTqHl8zXnyazDMQhZjb9e--RufiuwSa_Tvo2rpRI0h5HFmE_UDK2oiH71Ht4z1KDbRKKbepoxxBOjiX31cSJRbzyE)
---
As the only veteran in this race, I feel a responsibility to step up and lead with the conviction I'll never shake from my time in the service. I believe our country deserves a Commander-in-Chief who truly understands what we're fighting for and what we're fighting against. _The gravity of the situation we're now facing is nothing short of_** _dire_** _._ Our nation's once-proud fighting force has been infected and paralyzed by a political agenda, our military recruitment levels have reached an all-time low, and yet we are expected to salute our "Commander-in-Chief," Joe Biden. Not only is this a slap in the face to the veterans across this country, but it is an insult to _every_ soldier who has come before our time:
* Those 56 men who pledged their lives in Independence Hall in 1776 so that they could create a new nation conceived in liberty.

* Our nation's first Republican President who stood at a cemetery in Gettysburg and pledged this nation to a new birth of freedom.

* That band of brothers who stormed the beaches of Normandy, defeated the Nazis, and saved this world.

As a veteran, as a former Congressman, as Governor, and as a father, I have remained steadfast in my devotion to reminding those who will listen of the words of Ronald Reagan: **_Freedom is one generation away from extinction; it's not passed along in the bloodstream, and it must be protected and cultivated._** Today, I am humbly asking you for support to help me fire Joe Biden and restore**this mission and sanity, pride, integrity, and capability** to the chief office of our military.

Ron DeSantis comes from blue-collar roots in the state of Florida. Nothing was handed to him, he worked his way through college and led his team as the Yale Baseball captain. After earning his undergraduate degree, Ron DeSantis graduated from Harvard Law School, but was so moved by the events of September 11, 2001, that he volunteered to serve in the Navy to fight for our freedom. When he returned, he started a life of public service by serving Florida as both Congressman and now Governor. Despite all his years of fighting to ensure the American people enjoy the freedom we're promised in this country, he's watched the Left strip away freedoms at every turn and impose radical agendas on children, families, and consumers nationwide. In 2009, Ron met the love of his life Casey in Florida, and he's now the proud father of 6, 5, and 3-year-old children. Because of his kids, Ron DeSantis knows that this fight is _personal_ and understands the frustration parents face when teachers' unions and liberal groups shove a political agenda down the throats of children.

---

---

On Day One, Ron DeSantis has _promised_ that he will bring a RECKONING for what unelected bureaucrats like Anthony Fauci and DC elites have done to children. Ron DeSantis will ignite our Great American Comeback by _immediately getting to work_ stopping the invasion across our southern border, ensuring our military once again puts the mission first, declaring our economic independence, and restoring our American energy dominance so that our country gets back on track before it's too late. In Florida, Ron DeSantis' record speaks for itself. He's taken on the political establishment, politicized bureaucratic agencies, woke corporations, and the legacy media countless times and **_won every single time_**. Under his leadership, Florida has cultivated a thriving economy. It has stood as a citadel of freedom, and with him as our next President, America can once again be that shining City on a Hill for the rest of the world to look upon. _That's why he's running for President of the United States. Ron DeSantis knows that the decline of our country is a choice that cannot continue for another four years; the time to lead is now.... the time to act is now._

---

Fellow American - when I became Speaker of the House on October 25th, I knew one of the first things we needed to do was build out our team of supporters online.

Federal authorities recorded 240,988 migrant encounters at the
southern border in October, sustaining record highs seen under the
Biden administration, according to Customs and Border Protection (CBP)
data released Tuesday. The number of encounters along the southern
border in September totaled 269,735, marking the highest month on
record.

Peter Willis,

We need Medicare for All — not more profit gouging by multi-billion dollar health insurance companies.

That’s why a recent report from The Lever is so concerning — private health insurance companies are ripping off the government for billions and then turning around and denying healthcare to seniors.

https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/12482?source=EM_NBI_OR_20231114_PT_medicareadv_0_6MO_ourrevolution_na_na_medicareadv&t=1011&akid=4900%2E5885482%2EJ03UnD

Join us today. Add your name to demand an end to the crony capitalism and profit gouging. (https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/12482?source=EM_NBI_OR_20231114_PT_medicareadv_0_6MO_ourrevolution_na_na_medicareadv&t=1012&akid=4900%2E5885482%2EJ03UnD)

"Medicare Advantage" is a joke. The only group gaining an “Advantage” here is the private insurance companies raking in record profits.

Medicare Advantage is a private-sector alternative to traditional Medicare that was designed by Congress two decades ago to encourage health insurers to provide better care at lower cost. By next year, more than half of Medicare recipients will be in a private plan.

Privatization of Medicare is the last thing we need, Peter Willis. We need to work toward single-payer universal healthcare — not the privatized scam that is Medicare Advantage.

Peter,

As a former Navy SEAL and combat veteran, I’ve seen my fair share of battle. Between my and my wife’s service to our country, we’ve sacrificed years of our lives to make America a more safe and prosperous nation and to protect our God-given freedoms and liberties. We served so that our children and yours might grow up to realize their own American Dreams.

Duty to country. Service and sacrifice over self, **those are the traits that define me**. I’m proud of the work we did for our country. That said, the events of August 2021 rocked me to my core and ultimately led me to **[launch a campaign for the United States Senate this past June.](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=51c9576d51f942d092764748c56b7b76&_e=nQoSRV_dRsEbZxqCSHuoLvk3ZXebytP90_gUoKaJM0WnwfckgJs7rFv-DTmKUZOGXpz-EQB1qkzKdW25uEDHZM5hcBQK3Rg7P4V8ZwxsdAlq1wtcy1_t88QkZI6cdYprpcRJzkh4BTBqEx3Pr2LdfPI_RgRowoR7IWm0fOqUJab5Oy9mv2DQFnqqePYVHAP9aRJa0Y6R0zF0EyW3LJ1m-YVsJdrKVHeCKxjw2RalnTD4Tyb2NSzA174bBiD8OY2zCDghngPDt29segn25Q6Bcr2TarX9S95hynlIsrLG8dz7LwF16-7obuMEJ7fouFOW8rl8AoiAd9mVmKK9YIcR5CEebIMrh5bJQeALmxncWtK6J0lT7IbwIHXuDU5eusb-v5ImRhBE7dOnBqMEG1A0tQZPm9rzWPcXWeXNn3SGPktTjn2K3is3FkqZFKYCymZ_)**

In August 2021, I was putting out wildfires in California by day as part of the aerial firefighting company that I run; by night, my colleagues [many veterans like me] and I were working the phones trying to get our friends and allies out of Afghanistan before the takeover by the Taliban. I remember vividly that at one point I was trying to help an ally **sneak through a tunnel to get him and his family to the airport** so that they could be evacuated on a U.S. military aircraft. The Taliban wanted these high-value targets dead; they wanted their families dead.

[](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=51c9576d51f942d092764748c56b7b76&_e=nQoSRV_dRsEbZxqCSHuoLvk3ZXebytP90_gUoKaJM0WnwfckgJs7rFv-DTmKUZOGXpz-EQB1qkzKdW25uEDHZM5hcBQK3Rg7P4V8ZwxsdAlq1wtcy1_t88QkZI6cdYprpcRJzkh4BTBqEx3Pr2LdfPI_RgRowoR7IWm0fOqUJab5Oy9mv2DQFnqqePYVHAP9aRJa0Y6R0zF0EyW3LJ1m-YVsJdrKVHeCKxjw2RalnTD4Tyb2NSzA174bBiD8OY2zCDghngPDt29segn25Q6BchoDG7I4kBVoUOdUFMC7_tRrKwI_AG5Pb7FQxa1Sk20GuvCA6syKzlBJlkLiIQW9KSo6I0EYpkWCCQAaJYJc7tN2X5fYzwE1r0n_xasuKRjfIYiF_jntzNyO-2bPJPHjmRP0EnMnR3zUF9kJjfjOb9frPXQ-iL7fKvYQdWJbtIHB)
This continued for days. Throughout the entire process, _**“I kept thinking to myself, “The adult will come in the room and say, ‘Hey, this is a disaster; we’re going to stop this.’”**_

Every day it got worse.
Every day it was a disaster.
The adult in the room never materialized.

**Then, 13 Americans were vaporized at the gate to Kabul’s airport.** Billions of dollars in military and human assets were left behind – all so Joe Biden could get a press conference saying that he’d pulled the country out of an “endless war.”

I had sat in the homes of the families that we were frantically trying to get out; I had promised them that we weren’t going to leave them behind. _**So, you can imagine the dishonor that I felt**_ because of the promises we weren’t able to keep to the people who’d sacrificed so much to help us combat evil.

**If you're thinking this email is on the longer side, you're right.** If you're short on time and unable to finish reading to the end right now, **[please do me a quick favor and confirm that I have the correct information on file for you](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=51c9576d51f942d092764748c56b7b76&_e=nQoSRV_dRsEbZxqCSHuoLvk3ZXebytP90_gUoKaJM0WnwfckgJs7rFv-DTmKUZOGuJcahx4Q2y-8EVcLF3vxAD-AUgi7VjMNud0ijest7wN5nRMDBirmEKXH3P1X9gfXwdT5dCP845yeP613420rdIPM_ufiN-adjqNAeoVHxb3XHMEQxv-Gl4IDjYfinn8md9jmGg6oU8QF38129sNHhcNw25AGsJmTPUXEKPJ43Xo3Z3J4sUMmmN1dYKHbRZnui3CWiz8AqLJN5zf6tbXbmKp5JaNM9qjHgwJ876apNOazDxPtpr5encAJ_vpyujwnkTitnG4bdX6gOKSdmxeMMQrcBQ5CxmqXLy321GDnyyxEZJZ42cxhY6fiTOJiq2Yq-5Ya1tRjyZt9SiwtG3COYlwPSN1oj5E8QF9ILWWPoBQ%3D)** ; my opponent and his allies will not make winning this seat easy.

[**JOIN OUR FIGHT
ENLIST WITH TIM TODAY->** ](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=51c9576d51f942d092764748c56b7b76&_e=nQoSRV_dRsEbZxqCSHuoLvk3ZXebytP90_gUoKaJM0WnwfckgJs7rFv-DTmKUZOGXpz-EQB1qkzKdW25uEDHZM5hcBQK3Rg7P4V8ZwxsdAlq1wtcy1_t88QkZI6cdYprpcRJzkh4BTBqEx3Pr2LdfPI_RgRowoR7IWm0fOqUJab5Oy9mv2DQFnqqePYVHAP9aRJa0Y6R0zF0EyW3LJ1m-YVsJdrKVHeCKxjw2RalnTD4Tyb2NSzA174bBiD8OY2zCDghngPDt29segn25Q6Bco2C-sJOCOIB2Kk3KKEnszxxqRNjjnM_eN8Nru5PzamPXQyABSRq052TdjrXGAmRym4oZ976NWEdjtk5h-Q37GBt3K7884JlgTObd_HEesVdFsHUB6h65Yg-J5yiH38-3AzVXttGfAWJiPrGG4tP-wWRWNx9zQxpVs9SWoh2zplx)

It was in the aftermath of the fall of Afghanistan that I ever truly considered entering politics. Deciding to launch a campaign for the United States Senate wasn’t an easy decision; **but the United States needs leaders who understand the sacrifice it’s taken to build our country. When your country calls and needs you, you have to answer. **

[](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=51c9576d51f942d092764748c56b7b76&_e=nQoSRV_dRsEbZxqCSHuoLvk3ZXebytP90_gUoKaJM0WnwfckgJs7rFv-DTmKUZOGXpz-EQB1qkzKdW25uEDHZM5hcBQK3Rg7P4V8ZwxsdAlq1wtcy1_t88QkZI6cdYprpcRJzkh4BTBqEx3Pr2LdfPI_RgRowoR7IWm0fOqUJab5Oy9mv2DQFnqqePYVHAP9aRJa0Y6R0zF0EyW3LJ1m-YVsJdrKVHeCKxjw2RalnTD4Tyb2NSzA174bBiD8OY2zCDghngPDt29segn25Q6Bcv-6KCNIv9hz00ZEPSIefUL20Yj90_B9pibon9lwFZJQehFHNVnfnm8DMEuiAfLXLSOuGmWWZVr3iUIWpeNffwLgVQUXWs6nU77VAxP6rVeJ82aM8Tg3dmngr_BONslodoEiPteEV45_lZouf_hLItBaNZIt_QKVtfW0GgOGI_mF)

[600x300] [] US government partnered with universities on election censorship: House GOP report [] Source: Washington Examiner [] An agency within the Department of Homeland Security partnered with several university centers to identify online content worthy of censorship, according to a new report from the House Judiciary Committee. "True information posted by Republicans and conservatives was labeled as 'misinformation' while false information posted by Democrats and liberals was largely unreported and untouched by the censors." "The Biden DHS is unlawfully hiding evidence of their election interference and censorship of Americans,” said Judicial Watch President Tom Fitton. [13x13x1] [] READ MORE [] [180x150x2] [] 2023-11-09 Homeland Security’s Cybersecurity Agency Worked with Election Integrity Partnership to Suppress 2020 Election ‘Disinformation’ [] Source: Judicial Watch [] Judicial Watch received 63 pages of heavily redacted records from the Department of Homeland Security that show the Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency communicated during the 2020 election campaign with the Election Integrity Partnership, which was created to flag online election content for censorship and suppression. Here's what we're up against.

[](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=22160efcf1ad41a0bc62f4fcc7509834&_e=2oVt1p1fQWHH-S0FoU8Tlz1EPRZOd69HLwd5xEhjLQvmmQ4guMmLtpYWsMFEMif1bCc-jQex7GsCm-7HpUjg-mw6luFdS1BimcyET6pnZiguE3Am8wYzMt7QH8iZxGpnHgXAUxMNYTDurntEOo9-ewDlM5kwjExZIaql_Biyrwu_nLpXiL7z3ilWGyAAlIUPrnLnO2bMVppEsbKLjMRZ0PoaiEJNQFuVgCAR-sjqqV9HgKUQfme2nOMwt_LVKmjU "SkyTree Book Fairs")

Friend,

SkyTree Book Fair and I did a deep dive and discovered the cause of why sexually explicit and disgusting books get into our children's schools, classrooms, and libraries.

Here's what we're up against.

These are books Scholastic promotes at book fairs in schools. Here are pages from "Welcome to St. Hell," a 2022 Scholastic book glamorizing gender transitioning to middle schoolers. (We've censored these pages as the original content could violate social media policies against adult material):

Scholastic holds a virtual monopoly on school book fairs. Like many of our cultural institutions in the last decade, Scholastic has fallen prey to the woke mob and radical LGBT political agenda.

Scholastic promotes this agenda over the well-being of our children.

**Here is the solution:**

SkyTree Book Fair offers schools a different option for book fairs. SkyTree Book Fairs is providing schools, parents, and children with an empowering alternative with literature rooted in truth and family values that matches the quality and ease of Scholastic while countering their harmful agenda.

And it's working!

SkyTree has already secured its first public school book fair in Spotsylvania, VA!
