---
| ,
Earlier this week I wrote to you about why I am running for Congress. Among the reasons is the blatant disregard and disrespect that my opponent, Congressman Troy Balderson (R-OH), has for both his constituents and district. Today I’d like to go into a bit more depth:
When you look up _used car salesmen_ in the Oxford dictionary, they describe the term as, **“the stereotype of a used-car salesmen often found in jokes, cartoons etc. is that they are not sincere, honest or reliable.”**
Before running for Congress, Balderson literally owned and managed a used car dealership where he lived up to the stereotype in every sense of the term.
Inheriting his family business, Balderson Motor Sales through nepotism rather than merit, Troy encouraged deceptive business practices and is alleged to have maintained a delicate balancing act of running massive debts.
Things finally came crashing down for Balderson Motor Sales when Troy was in his first term of Congress and Ohio’s Attorney General brought legal action against the dealership.
---
|
---
| [ ](https://dagoyy.clicks.mlsend.com/te/cl/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjY4ODM3OSxcImxcIjoxMDQ4NDk5NzU5MjM0NDMxMDEsXCJyXCI6MTA0ODUwMDkzMjUyODA2MjI4fSIsInMiOiI3YTA5MWE4ZWEzNDhiZjVjIn0)
---
|
---
Dozens of customers who purchased vehicles from Balderson Motor Sales never received their titles, in many cases because the cars they purchased had already had loans taken out on them by Troy’s brother Thomas. Some customers complained that auto loans were initiated without authorization. And when all was said and done the business **owed around $500,000** to banks, former customers, and acquaintances. **
****Now serving in his third term in Congress, Balderson has brought his practices from Balderson Motor Sales to Capitol Hill.**
Rather than fighting for his constituents in his largely rural and poor district he has sold them out at every turn in favor of massive corporations. Take these examples for instance:
* When he had an opportunity to negotiate down prescription drug costs for his constituents he sided with the pharmaceutical industry. Why? Perhaps because Balderson has received $134,208 in campaign contributions from Big Pharma from between 2017-2023.

* He worked to cut Ohioans social safety while serving in the Ohio State Senate and in Congress has worked tirelessly to cut Medicaid and entitlements that protect our most vulnerable Americans.

* In 2019, Balderson voted three separate times supporting a lawsuit to repeal the Affordable Care Act.

* He voted against the bipartisan infrastructure bill, then touted it as a victory in his district when it passed.

On top of his disregard and disdain for the folks who live in his district he has also been a diligent participant in the extreme right wing operation to tear apart the fabric of our democracy.
| | [ ](https://dagoyy.clicks.mlsend.com/te/cl/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjY4ODM3OSxcImxcIjoxMDQ4NDk5NzU5Mjk3MzQ1NjEsXCJyXCI6MTA0ODUwMDkzMjUyODA2MjI4fSIsInMiOiJmMWNiYWU1NzNkMjI0YzJkIn0)
---
| | _Former President Donald Trump and his henchman Troy Balderson hold hands at one of the Congressman’s campaign rallies._
---

| Rep. Balderson failed to hold President Trump accountable for the Jan. 6 insurrection on our Capitol building and did not vote to impeach him. He called the impeachment process “rushed” and withheld his support for it. On top of this, Rep. Balderson voted to stop the formation of the bipartisan Jan. 6 commission.
Earlier this fall, **Balderson voted to elect right-wing extremist Congressman Jim Jordan a whopping**** _THREE TIMES_** and refused to stand with the coalition of principled conservatives who withheld their votes to prevent him from ascending to Speaker.
As an Ohioan, Balderson should know better than to support Jim Jordan who is accused by dozens of his former wrestlers of enabling sexual abuse at Ohio State University while he was a coach there.
[We cannot allow Troy Balderson, a literal used car salesmen, to continue selling out his constituents and our democracy. Peter, If you've heard my story, you know that I went from being a blue-collar kid in Florida, to attending Yale on a baseball scholarship, to working my way through Harvard Law School... all leading up to the day I saw our freedom come under fire on September 11th, 2001, and volunteering to serve in the proudest fighting force in the world. When I deployed to Iraq with U.S. Navy SEAL Team One, I put on the cloth of my country, shipped out with a sense of confidence, conviction, and patriotic duty to our nation, _and served with undying honor._ Fighting for this country has always been personal to me, and I will hold that honor close to my chest for as long as I live.
---

---
As the only veteran in this race, I feel a responsibility to step up and lead with the conviction I'll never shake from my time in the service. I believe our country deserves a Commander-in-Chief who truly understands what we're fighting for and what we're fighting against. _The gravity of the situation we're now facing is nothing short of_** _dire_** _._ Our nation's once-proud fighting force has been infected and paralyzed by a political agenda, our military recruitment levels have reached an all-time low, and yet we are expected to salute our "Commander-in-Chief," Joe Biden. Not only is this a slap in the face to the veterans across this country, but it is an insult to _every_ soldier who has come before our time:
* Those 56 men who pledged their lives in Independence Hall in 1776 so that they could create a new nation conceived in liberty.

* Our nation's first Republican President who stood at a cemetery in Gettysburg and pledged this nation to a new birth of freedom.

* That band of brothers who stormed the beaches of Normandy, defeated the Nazis, and saved this world.

As a veteran, as a former Congressman, as Governor, and as a father, I have remained steadfast in my devotion to reminding those who will listen of the words of Ronald Reagan: **_Freedom is one generation away from extinction; it's not passed along in the bloodstream, and it must be protected and cultivated._** Today, I am humbly asking you for support to help me fire Joe Biden and restore**this mission and sanity, pride, integrity, and capability** to the chief office of our military.

Ron DeSantis comes from blue-collar roots in the state of Florida. Nothing was handed to him, he worked his way through college and led his team as the Yale Baseball captain. After earning his undergraduate degree, Ron DeSantis graduated from Harvard Law School, but was so moved by the events of September 11, 2001, that he volunteered to serve in the Navy to fight for our freedom. When he returned, he started a life of public service by serving Florida as both Congressman and now Governor. Despite all his years of fighting to ensure the American people enjoy the freedom we're promised in this country, he's watched the Left strip away freedoms at every turn and impose radical agendas on children, families, and consumers nationwide. In 2009, Ron met the love of his life Casey in Florida, and he's now the proud father of 6, 5, and 3-year-old children. Because of his kids, Ron DeSantis knows that this fight is _personal_ and understands the frustration parents face when teachers' unions and liberal groups shove a political agenda down the throats of children.

On Day One, Ron DeSantis has _promised_ that he will bring a RECKONING for what unelected bureaucrats like Anthony Fauci and DC elites have done to children. Ron DeSantis will ignite our Great American Comeback by _immediately getting to work_ stopping the invasion across our southern border, ensuring our military once again puts the mission first, declaring our economic independence, and restoring our American energy dominance so that our country gets back on track before it's too late. In Florida, Ron DeSantis' record speaks for itself. He's taken on the political establishment, politicized bureaucratic agencies, woke corporations, and the legacy media countless times and **_won every single time_**. Under his leadership, Florida has cultivated a thriving economy. It has stood as a citadel of freedom, and with him as our next President, America can once again be that shining City on a Hill for the rest of the world to look upon. _That's why he's running for President of the United States. Ron DeSantis knows that the decline of our country is a choice that cannot continue for another four years; the time to lead is now.... the time to act is now._

188d92cdddd40f90da47bc74ea2ba8fb
Dear Friend,
I wish I were writing to you under happier circumstances...
...but my hero police officer husband, Mark Wagner, is the next big target of the radical anti-police movement and I urgently need your help before they make an example out of him.
That's Mark in the picture I sent you, along with our boys Nolan and Jacob and dog Kilo.
[](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/KUhDolDiPGspOo_F6sK5Ww~~/AARclAA~/RgRnNn62P0SGaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS9sZWxkZi9jYTJmNzZhYjY3ZWRkZWJlNTVkZjI_dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1CREctUkVOJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09RU0mdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPTIwMjMxMTE0X0JER19MRUxERl9XQUcxX1JFTl9QQS1ST05XA3NwY0IKZUbT2FNlALWKKlIUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAAAA~)
Not only is Mark a highly respected officer, he's an incredibly supportive father, a loving husband, and a fierce friend.
He's dedicated his life to protecting others. But we live in far-Left Madison, Wisconsin - and the "defund the police" mob whipped up rage, LIED about what happened, and trashed Mark's reputation.
And now Mark faces 10 YEARS behind bars for doing exactly what he was trained to do in the line of duty - and I'm scared I might lose him. [**That 's why I wrote this letter to you, someone I've never met before, to ask for your help.**](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/KUhDolDiPGspOo_F6sK5Ww~~/AARclAA~/RgRnNn62P0SGaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS9sZWxkZi9jYTJmNzZhYjY3ZWRkZWJlNTVkZjI_dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1CREctUkVOJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09RU0mdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPTIwMjMxMTE0X0JER19MRUxERl9XQUcxX1JFTl9QQS1ST05XA3NwY0IKZUbT2FNlALWKKlIUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAAAA~)
But first, let me explain what happened...
On the morning of February 3, 2022, Mark and other officers tried to arrest a _violent_ _criminal_ named Quadren Wilson.
Wilson has a rap sheet a mile long with dozens of arrests for drug distribution, theft, witness intimidation, battery, eluding police, and more. He was wanted for allegedly dealing fentanyl to a man found dead in a restaurant bathroom.
Mark's arrest team planned to capture Wilson in his vehicle using a containment strategy. They pulled in their trucks to block his car on both ends. But Wilson floored the accelerator, spinning his wheels wildly in a desperate attempt to escape justice.
Mark and another officer exited their vehicle to make the arrest. Mark was holding one of those big POLICE shields and had his gun drawn. But Wilson refused Mark's commands to show his hands, continuing to spin his wheels and try to force his way out.
With the wheels screeching and smoking, Mark and the other officer saw Wilson reach into the center console and pull his hand up.
Mark thought Wilson had a gun. He heard what he thought was gunfire. Then Mark felt something hit the shield he was holding and push him backward.** **
**Both Mark and the other officer responded to this life-threatening situation by firing into the vehicle.**
Mark believed his life and his fellow officers' lives were in danger. He did what he was trained to do and stopped the threat.
Thankfully, Wilson survived and no one else was injured. But because Wilson is black and Mark is white - anti-police radicals jumped at the chance to target Mark.
Protesters drummed up a racial firestorm by spreading lies that Wilson "had his hands up" and that he "was shot five times in the back." The corrupt liberal media repeated these lies and painted my husband as a monster.
And on September 22, 2022, the liberal District Attorney caved to the mob and filed BOGUS felony charges against Mark. **Now Mark faces 10 YEARS in prison.**
[**_Now I hope you can see why I 'm turning to you for help today._**](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/KUhDolDiPGspOo_F6sK5Ww~~/AARclAA~/RgRnNn62P0SGaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS9sZWxkZi9jYTJmNzZhYjY3ZWRkZWJlNTVkZjI_dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1CREctUkVOJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09RU0mdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPTIwMjMxMTE0X0JER19MRUxERl9XQUcxX1JFTl9QQS1ST05XA3NwY0IKZUbT2FNlALWKKlIUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAAAA~)
Mark dedicated his life to helping others. He's spent 30 years in law enforcement, most of them with the Milwaukee Police Department (MPD).
We knew fighting alone against the anti-police movement here in Wisconsin would be impossible and our hope that justice would prevail was quickly fading when we received a call from **the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund (LELDF)** offering to help Mark.
This incredible organization helps innocent officers, like my husband, who have been unfairly prosecuted for split-second, use-of-force decisions in the line of duty.
Law and justice experts like President Ronald Reagan's Attorney General Edwin Meese and former FBI Assistant Director Ronald Hosko serve on LELDF's Board. LELDF's president, Jason Johnson, served over 20 years as a police officer, including as Deputy Commissioner of the Baltimore Police Department.
In short, these are experts when it comes to policing. And they thoroughly vet cases to determine if an officer was wrongly accused or charged before deciding to help.
They provide legal counsel, expert witnesses, whatever is needed to make sure wrongly accused police officers get a fair shake in court. And they do it all free of charge!
But LELDF doesn't receive any money from the government to help police officers facing unjust charges. They're funded entirely by the generous support of folks like you who can recognize a miscarriage of justice and want to help fix it.
This is why I reached out to you today. I needed to ask you a very important question:
[**_Will you please help my husband Mark fight the unjust charges against him and clear his name by rushing a generous, tax-deductible donation to LELDF today?_**](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/KUhDolDiPGspOo_F6sK5Ww~~/AARclAA~/RgRnNn62P0SGaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS9sZWxkZi9jYTJmNzZhYjY3ZWRkZWJlNTVkZjI_dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1CREctUkVOJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09RU0mdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPTIwMjMxMTE0X0JER19MRUxERl9XQUcxX1JFTl9QQS1ST05XA3NwY0IKZUbT2FNlALWKKlIUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAAAA~)
Your kind gift today of $35, $50, or $100 to help Mark will mean so much to my family.
Or, if you're blessed with the means to help with a gift of $250, $500, or even $1,000 or more, I pray you will so my husband doesn't spend 10 YEARS behind bars away from his family.
Right now, LELDF is preparing to ramp up legal action in Mark's case. [**So please follow this link to make your tax-deductible donation right away.**](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/KUhDolDiPGspOo_F6sK5Ww~~/AARclAA~/RgRnNn62P0SGaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS9sZWxkZi9jYTJmNzZhYjY3ZWRkZWJlNTVkZjI_dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1CREctUkVOJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09RU0mdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPTIwMjMxMTE0X0JER19MRUxERl9XQUcxX1JFTl9QQS1ST05XA3NwY0IKZUbT2FNlALWKKlIUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAAAA~)
Any gift amount you can send today is truly a blessing. No matter what you're able to give, please say a prayer for Mark and our family.
Thank you in advance for your generous support of my family and LELDF.
With deepest gratitude,
Becky Wagner
P.S. Mark is the type of person who'd offer to donate a kidney to a friend in need just because it's the right thing to do. In fact, that's exactly what he did when he donated one of his kidneys to his former partner of more than a decade! Mark didn't even let his partner know he got checked out as a potential donor. He just said that his partner had young kids who needed him to be around and it was the right thing to do.
This is the type of man the anti-police mob is targeting and trying to destroy: a kidney donor, a youth football coach, a man who assists the elderly from our parish in running errands and doing handy-man projects. A man of faith who's always helping others.
Mark faces 10 years behind bars - simply for doing his job to serve and protect. [**_Will you help him clear his name by making a tax-deductible donation of $35, $50, $100, $250, $500, $1,000 or any amount to the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund today?_** ](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/KUhDolDiPGspOo_F6sK5Ww~~/AARclAA~/RgRnNn62P0SGaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS9sZWxkZi9jYTJmNzZhYjY3ZWRkZWJlNTVkZjI_dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1CREctUkVOJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09RU0mdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPTIwMjMxMTE0X0JER19MRUxERl9XQUcxX1JFTl9QQS1ST05XA3NwY0IKZUbT2FNlALWKKlIUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAAAA~) Your generosity will help LELDF mount the strongest legal defenses for my husband and other wrongly accused officers. Thank you in advance for your prayers and support.

\----------------

_More such officers who sacrifice so much for will face similar fates unless we speak out and stand up for the brave men and women in blue. The next time you see a police officer in your community, please thank them for their service. To read more about our mission or the other Law Enforcement officers we 're defending, please visit **www.leldf.org**. And remember - Blue Lives Matter!_

When I saw everything that we’d worked for in Afghanistan washed away in a matter of days, I decided to consider serving in government once again | [Unsubscribe](http://links.bestamericanow.com/e/encryptedUnsubscribe?_r=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_s=82a99cbc3f464509a9d03ab6af5a704d&_t=xHGUvQPZCkkrTquDmHBZbJzJsOcyVpsmD9denE2a_fcPqPdt2Ur4Cs2ne4CiHj1k7OJ5L9QhEx103nr7KXq7_ZxpLdUUg-VmXoYJJLIhh58%3D) | [Mark as Junk](http://links.bestamericanow.com/e/encryptedUnsubscribe?_r=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_s=82a99cbc3f464509a9d03ab6af5a704d&_t=xHGUvQPZCkkrTquDmHBZbJzJsOcyVpsmD9denE2a_fcPqPdt2Ur4Cs2ne4CiHj1k7OJ5L9QhEx103nr7KXq7_ZxpLdUUg-VmXoYJJLIhh58%3D)

Peter,

As a former Navy SEAL and combat veteran, I’ve seen my fair share of battle. Between my and my wife’s service to our country, we’ve sacrificed years of our lives to make America a more safe and prosperous nation and to protect our God-given freedoms and liberties. We served so that our children and yours might grow up to realize their own American Dreams.

Duty to country. Service and sacrifice over self, **those are the traits that define me**. I’m proud of the work we did for our country. That said, the events of August 2021 rocked me to my core and ultimately led me to **[launch a campaign for the United States Senate this past June.](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=82a99cbc3f464509a9d03ab6af5a704d&_e=696kgRS0rAyzWrgqcPPizyqH9o184vzZA-fSgtcCQOjhg0JZQ_RVhbt9Og_73d0zfZ6Ng2KLLidhlNmnBdisbtHnKE6vAjre0PmSdT7thQLJTKcE0Ju_OqLEEH19qjbcDyz70IyJVSq8xvCW9dgNC2vq2x-txnXtADOxyLsaxHw1Ni2jX2lDcF9lys3IDIYCdOOrR-6HsXHSR6rQzOSFHT4YwfKmxHl469YNM5SWomxzdhvJfvRaQ8IYqyZ3r9h4GTs4PuqOBuuQ_2M4tk5Jmsf34DKCWJjt8qrgqM7OXzlkwhBPkxy5kF2Ub5z54DTkmpbLim_JwJX9wIHBPc5SYR6AtNAFO-WghG5qH0Yr7Ma1TMrCmLzxT84hwqxmDpuqw5xdIoss7GdvBDQ8GZ-x-04O7fFtSSUm7WvEKhU1bfJ76b7VHaS7_7QSnFOcjQQE)**

In August 2021, I was putting out wildfires in California by day as part of the aerial firefighting company that I run; by night, my colleagues [many veterans like me] and I were working the phones trying to get our friends and allies out of Afghanistan before the takeover by the Taliban. I remember vividly that at one point I was trying to help an ally **sneak through a tunnel to get him and his family to the airport** so that they could be evacuated on a U.S. military aircraft. The Taliban wanted these high-value targets dead; they wanted their families dead.

[](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=82a99cbc3f464509a9d03ab6af5a704d&_e=696kgRS0rAyzWrgqcPPizyqH9o184vzZA-fSgtcCQOjhg0JZQ_RVhbt9Og_73d0zfZ6Ng2KLLidhlNmnBdisbtHnKE6vAjre0PmSdT7thQLJTKcE0Ju_OqLEEH19qjbcDyz70IyJVSq8xvCW9dgNC2vq2x-txnXtADOxyLsaxHw1Ni2jX2lDcF9lys3IDIYCdOOrR-6HsXHSR6rQzOSFHT4YwfKmxHl469YNM5SWomxzdhvJfvRaQ8IYqyZ3r9h4GTs4PuqOBuuQ_2M4tk5Jmsf34DKCWJjt8qrgqM7OXzlmt-8VZ3k3hdjcGw_hSDUMLYTh83N4AZH-04lG3EbDtXyNYj8Qg8oVPWAVj-N7w2dpBR5-a_4cp09VjZVEgVBNBUJwUKTjnn1Za37ZDpZQKRKVgq2VwcR8pfyCpmY3wHFVEVgC-2McOIlBKVc86eZN)
This continued for days. Throughout the entire process, _**“I kept thinking to myself, “The adult will come in the room and say, ‘Hey, this is a disaster; we’re going to stop this.’”**_

Every day it got worse.
Every day it was a disaster.
The adult in the room never materialized.

**Then, 13 Americans were vaporized at the gate to Kabul’s airport.** Billions of dollars in military and human assets were left behind – all so Joe Biden could get a press conference saying that he’d pulled the country out of an “endless war.”

I had sat in the homes of the families that we were frantically trying to get out; I had promised them that we weren’t going to leave them behind. _**So, you can imagine the dishonor that I felt**_ because of the promises we weren’t able to keep to the people who’d sacrificed so much to help us combat evil.

When my husband Adam and I moved our three daughters home to Virginia – just miles from where we had grown up – I thought my days of public service had come to a close. But after the 2016 election, our country was at a crossroads, and I envisioned what it could be if we flipped Virginia’s 7th District and made clear that the people of our district deserved stronger representation. I worked hard, we built an extraordinary team driven by purpose and principle, and in 2018, our district elected a Democrat – me – for the first time since 1968.

Last week, Virginia’s elections showed that Virginians want to move forward, but we need a new Governor to be driving that progress.

I am running for Governor, because I know what I will bring to the job – a deep and abiding love for our Commonwealth, a relentless work ethic, and a focus on bringing people together to solve the real challenges facing Virginians.

It is a long road to the 2025 Governor’s election, but will you join me now as a Founding Donor and support my campaign and Fight for Reform with a contribution? I am working to build a strong foundation of support, and I need your help.

Keep the faith |

---
| | **YOU ARE INVITED!**
We will be having a reception to kick off the next phase of the Dellicker for Congress campaign on Thu., Nov. 16 from 5 PM to 7 PM at Seven Sirens Brewery, 327 Broadway, Bethlehem. For details contact:
** [ kristin@ignite-strategies.com](mailto:kristin@ignite-strategies.com?subject=Seven%20Sirens%20Reception)** or **[click here](https://dellickerforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2bced6f51ed1caf3f5b731ec5&id=538aa8dc8b&e=1090c5c412)**.
---
|
---
| | Dear Friends and Neighbors,

I wanted to start by sharing this awesome Veteran's Day card I received from a young man last week. Thank you Paulo, and thank you to all the Veterans and families who served our country. You can view my Veteran's Day tribute [here](https://dellickerforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2bced6f51ed1caf3f5b731ec5&id=a1298ec335&e=1090c5c412).

My message to you today is keep the faith.

Last Tuesday’s election was a setback to those of us who worked hard to elect conservative candidates to state and local offices. Just like you, I’m disappointed with the results. But I’m not discouraged, and I don’t want you to be either. We must regroup and stay strong to protect our American way of life.

We should start by understanding what went wrong. My team is digging into the data and avoiding jumping to conclusions. We will evaluate the facts and adjust our election strategy as necessary. Here’s what we already know about the 2024 congressional race:
* Joe Biden and Susan Wild remain deeply unpopular in our +2 Republican-leaning district
* The presidential race will boost GOP interest, countering the Democrat’s turnout advantage
* Our district will attract national attention as a pivotal race for control of Congress

This is a winnable seat and I’m fully invested. My team and I have a well-thought-out plan that focuses on grassroots efforts and targeted outreach. I deliver authenticity, real-world experience and commitment to conservative values. That distinguishes me from Susan Wild and career politicians. Here’s what I have to offer:
* 40 years of living and working in northwestern Lehigh County
* 28 years of military experience with four combat zone deployments
* 24 years as husband to Susan and father to Will, Jake, and Eli
* 18 years as a technology entrepreneur and small business owner
* Former economic advisor; helped develop largest tax cut in Pa. history
* Trained as a Christian minister and deacon in my church

Career politicians talk about creating safe communities, good jobs, and strong families, but I’ve actually done it. When I get to Washington, I’ll apply the expertise gained from these real-life endeavors to tackle our most important issues, like fighting inflation, securing the border, and strengthening our military.

I invite you to learn more about our campaign at [www.DellickerForCongress.com](https://dellickerforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2bced6f51ed1caf3f5b731ec5&id=7f62468595&e=1090c5c412). You can volunteer [here](https://dellickerforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2bced6f51ed1caf3f5b731ec5&id=0679ee361d&e=1090c5c412) and donate to our campaign [here](https://dellickerforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2bced6f51ed1caf3f5b731ec5&id=835f8c4619&e=1090c5c412). We are rapidly approaching the April 2024 primary election and then on to defeat Susan Wild. Let's work together to win.

**Keep America Free.**

_Kevin Dellicker is a husband and father who has lived in the Lehigh Valley for 40 years. He's the founder of a successful technology company and a 28-year veteran of the U.S. Armed Forces. Kevin's not running for Congress because he needs a job. He's running because he's got the experience, vision, and courage to defend our American way of life. _

Thank you!

body:
Years ago, I volunteered to serve in our nation's military, and nothing could shake the indescribable sense of pride I gained from those years. I was called to serve, and I will never stop.
---

Fellow Conservative, If you've heard my story, you know that I went from being a blue-collar kid in Florida, to attending Yale on a baseball scholarship, to working my way through Harvard Law School... all leading up to the day I saw our freedom come under fire on September 11th, 2001, and volunteering to serve in the proudest fighting force in the world. When I deployed to Iraq with U.S. Navy SEAL Team One, I put on the cloth of my country, shipped out with a sense of confidence, conviction, and patriotic duty to our nation, _and served with undying honor._ Fighting for this country has always been personal to me, and I will hold that honor close to my chest for as long as I live.
---
| [](http://links.americanlibertyalert.com/u/click?_t=3c9a9e018cb54768aae32f693c7987c9&_m=83348453cb054cb1af038827aa883cbc&_e=jHJFt4TnXfwJJF79nEgmtT4hewcv5A8ypmuUwU4UqbXnVf-ED1-TccgI5xr1pR68IMz1ymAAuA6b3-Ao5RpOSFk_Qo5hPdCyJKv5SdqBGl7n3B7bAVR01BafjES648BKSB667pcRovPiKIiyu9cr9WXANVLDOjfhwjPRqgBCWqcbGlU9pgXoU5dPAIg2fR0ZsjIHc68HFqPGIazaRcSULc927NvUjL5WBwV0lRSkMgT9j2SEjED-UPkcMqz2GqiY0Dw7Mqh8leA-cpg5rdDp_xWKhfT5PST5YHIB_Lw0XkLib0PbaFgduxTemKuH-IJXwP92qslehbOKFg1PTgZenqOg0MsbnqafqbpGH742uoQEKW9nlqndMEfT50oGXFjx1IkWCDnbRetBlzoHNb-1Hh4RxXRHeldoAEoyBeZj5Xuth3ESra3lJwSSX1OkDeUy)
---
As the only veteran in this race, I feel a responsibility to step up and lead with the conviction I'll never shake from my time in the service. I believe our country deserves a Commander-in-Chief who truly understands what we're fighting for and what we're fighting against. _The gravity of the situation we're now facing is nothing short of_** _dire_** _._ Our nation's once-proud fighting force has been infected and paralyzed by a political agenda, our military recruitment levels have reached an all-time low, and yet we are expected to salute our "Commander-in-Chief," Joe Biden. Not only is this a slap in the face to the veterans across this country, but it is an insult to _every_ soldier who has come before our time:
* Those 56 men who pledged their lives in Independence Hall in 1776 so that they could create a new nation conceived in liberty.

* Our nation's first Republican President who stood at a cemetery in Gettysburg and pledged this nation to a new birth of freedom.

* That band of brothers who stormed the beaches of Normandy, defeated the Nazis, and saved this world.

As a veteran, as a former Congressman, as Governor, and as a father, I have remained steadfast in my devotion to reminding those who will listen of the words of Ronald Reagan: **_Freedom is one generation away from extinction; it's not passed along in the bloodstream, and it must be protected and cultivated._** Today, I am humbly asking you for support to help me fire Joe Biden and restore**this mission and sanity, pride, integrity, and capability** to the chief office of our military.
---

And Fellow Conservative, I am also asking you for one more thing. Please, as our freedoms continue to come under fire every day that we allow Joe Biden to sit in our Oval Office, choose to stand on the side of freedom today, and always. I need you fighting with me.

Yours in Freedom,
---

Ron DeSantis comes from blue-collar roots in the state of Florida. Nothing was handed to him, he worked his way through college and led his team as the Yale Baseball captain. After earning his undergraduate degree, Ron DeSantis graduated from Harvard Law School, but was so moved by the events of September 11, 2001, that he volunteered to serve in the Navy to fight for our freedom. When he returned, he started a life of public service by serving Florida as both Congressman and now Governor. Despite all his years of fighting to ensure the American people enjoy the freedom we're promised in this country, he's watched the Left strip away freedoms at every turn and impose radical agendas on children, families, and consumers nationwide. In 2009, Ron met the love of his life Casey in Florida, and he's now the proud father of 6, 5, and 3-year-old children. Because of his kids, Ron DeSantis knows that this fight is _personal_ and understands the frustration parents face when teachers' unions and liberal groups shove a political agenda down the throats of children.

---
| [](http://links.americanlibertyalert.com/u/click?_t=3c9a9e018cb54768aae32f693c7987c9&_m=83348453cb054cb1af038827aa883cbc&_e=jHJFt4TnXfwJJF79nEgmtT4hewcv5A8ypmuUwU4UqbXnVf-ED1-TccgI5xr1pR68IMz1ymAAuA6b3-Ao5RpOSFk_Qo5hPdCyJKv5SdqBGl7n3B7bAVR01BafjES648BKSB667pcRovPiKIiyu9cr9WXANVLDOjfhwjPRqgBCWqcbGlU9pgXoU5dPAIg2fR0ZsjIHc68HFqPGIazaRcSULc927NvUjL5WBwV0lRSkMgT9j2SEjED-UPkcMqz2GqiY0Dw7Mqh8leA-cpg5rdDp_xWKhfT5PST5YHIB_Lw0XkK5kOV90SQqJH14xgHp8Z2l-m0wmNWrXyLYVb1xoudj7eZGeo1dXGUyDdPpTdAzF-CeAyhyvN9kjWJvMK7zGCpodck9lxE4_0hSA6EqDv1ds_Kkt6EqxovI0xMFSYlSyc1Ahbho6l1z9UHE4K9ez9Wu)
---

On Day One, Ron DeSantis has _promised_ that he will bring a RECKONING for what unelected bureaucrats like Anthony Fauci and DC elites have done to children. Ron DeSantis will ignite our Great American Comeback by _immediately getting to work_ stopping the invasion across our southern border, ensuring our military once again puts the mission first, declaring our economic independence, and restoring our American energy dominance so that our country gets back on track before it's too late. In Florida, Ron DeSantis' record speaks for itself. He's taken on the political establishment, politicized bureaucratic agencies, woke corporations, and the legacy media countless times and **_won every single time_**. Under his leadership, Florida has cultivated a thriving economy. It has stood as a citadel of freedom, and with him as our next President, America can once again be that shining City on a Hill for the rest of the world to look upon. _That's why he's running for President of the United States. Ron DeSantis knows that the decline of our country is a choice that cannot continue for another four years; the time to lead is now.... the time to act is now._

Peter, If you've heard my story, you know that I went from being a blue-collar kid in Florida, to attending Yale on a baseball scholarship, to working my way through Harvard Law School... all leading up to the day I saw our freedom come under fire on September 11th, 2001, and volunteering to serve in the proudest fighting force in the world. When I deployed to Iraq with U.S. Navy SEAL Team One, I put on the cloth of my country, shipped out with a sense of confidence, conviction, and patriotic duty to our nation, _and served with undying honor._ Fighting for this country has always been personal to me, and I will hold that honor close to my chest for as long as I live.
---
| [](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=5c32b57da97247008da32e06539b5165&_e=0H2GOz7_FPjShE71z8aVnZCjCO2TECfIZy4z4u9Jy3Agxeg03FnYm-UdJ1NV4kC0O2MNHcO4ugM2YvNUeYvRRell2AbKnODXoFb_arhC2_O2Q26-mbs2H5iwC15qfTR6JDPzK-0P-lwqIHcMSi3UWrEsDz8tyTwQMfHFrYEONSbr84jEWMwgFBiARPZArjrlrlXGym0AXvOBtIrRAcYhSScA_FWafWy5AshFE9zHTQi6HVqOdyvcBXdgKSSvNyzwZziGgRu8Z2HbgfDCayaSM6q0pWal85fNXJoaQwiSG54GkIkrdWc8kv7hAnASqkcPZ6SnxUuUwQAXqq-lOuH8SqDU_My0yosuEMvuLUM-GC4YOy8G9mt38UrZb8cWhBD9_UEfiKPzcz2e5f-X5WdxY5CFC4Vv-rXh_TXzNXMZo2gjrv99uEaRxl8ePaqj36oD)
---
As the only veteran in this race, I feel a responsibility to step up and lead with the conviction I'll never shake from my time in the service. I believe our country deserves a Commander-in-Chief who truly understands what we're fighting for and what we're fighting against. _The gravity of the situation we're now facing is nothing short of_** _dire_** _._ Our nation's once-proud fighting force has been infected and paralyzed by a political agenda, our military recruitment levels have reached an all-time low, and yet we are expected to salute our "Commander-in-Chief," Joe Biden. Not only is this a slap in the face to the veterans across this country, but it is an insult to _every_ soldier who has come before our time:
* Those 56 men who pledged their lives in Independence Hall in 1776 so that they could create a new nation conceived in liberty.

* Our nation's first Republican President who stood at a cemetery in Gettysburg and pledged this nation to a new birth of freedom.

* That band of brothers who stormed the beaches of Normandy, defeated the Nazis, and saved this world.

As a veteran, as a former Congressman, as Governor, and as a father, I have remained steadfast in my devotion to reminding those who will listen of the words of Ronald Reagan: **_Freedom is one generation away from extinction; it's not passed along in the bloodstream, and it must be protected and cultivated._** Today, I am humbly asking you for support to help me fire Joe Biden and restore**this mission and sanity, pride, integrity, and capability** to the chief office of our military.
---

Ron DeSantis comes from blue-collar roots in the state of Florida. Nothing was handed to him, he worked his way through college and led his team as the Yale Baseball captain. After earning his undergraduate degree, Ron DeSantis graduated from Harvard Law School, but was so moved by the events of September 11, 2001, that he volunteered to serve in the Navy to fight for our freedom. When he returned, he started a life of public service by serving Florida as both Congressman and now Governor. Despite all his years of fighting to ensure the American people enjoy the freedom we're promised in this country, he's watched the Left strip away freedoms at every turn and impose radical agendas on children, families, and consumers nationwide. In 2009, Ron met the love of his life Casey in Florida, and he's now the proud father of 6, 5, and 3-year-old children. Because of his kids, Ron DeSantis knows that this fight is _personal_ and understands the frustration parents face when teachers' unions and liberal groups shove a political agenda down the throats of children.

Ron DeSantis will ignite our Great American Comeback by _immediately getting to work_ stopping the invasion across our southern border, ensuring our military once again puts the mission first, declaring our economic independence, and restoring our American energy dominance so that our country gets back on track before it's too late. In Florida, Ron DeSantis' record speaks for itself. He's taken on the political establishment, politicized bureaucratic agencies, woke corporations, and the legacy media countless times and **_won every single time_**. Under his leadership, Florida has cultivated a thriving economy. It has stood as a citadel of freedom, and with him as our next President, America can once again be that shining City on a Hill for the rest of the world to look upon. _That's why he's running for President of the United States. Ron DeSantis knows that the decline of our country is a choice that cannot continue for another four years; the time to lead is now.... the time to act is now._

# Our Veterans Deserve Better!
---
---
| | | [](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001LaQiPR_kmXJ8-9viO0Wgyke2xc8Ch4C8DW1A4nzUPqjV9iqVQRpraeaMDx1TWIO_JxvNePAtJMfxhcG6tn_dCmPEz8qXbSIYPrvKPwevLxocniWU1M6KoVQSRrG2G_HjmIaM1rb25ogXZK0p1CYHYIBTZNo8oN9D3pfn9VQebu0rpeqIuajCmoDEWgWNDZrF7zluQf2f04kr1AYFHP0cCvXDQ_moWcEemscj6mSihFbesYow0VIxCggjNNknSj2Lk-Fc75F6ES4OhxMB43WYsg==&c=xr5EIaHMkyTD13-MSMLwWqP3u2zpNW2iI6EQ5xPHstynaJQWxKlJ8g==&ch=JJ9MWkoAlhnZEaax-fETEppA_P9cYPhIhamw75BuxlbGrBmRmveH6w==)
---|---

Thank You, Veterans!

To every veteran, I want to express my heartfelt gratitude for the lifelong sacrifice, dedication, and commitment to our nation and the freedoms we all hold dear!

The 2nd Congressional District is home to nearly 30,000 veterans. Each one of them has risked everything for the freedoms we continue to enjoy. We, as American citizens, have the responsibility to not let them down, but to continue the fight for our freedoms against power-hungry leaders and unelected bureaucrats attempting to take them away.

Our nation needs to preserve a culture of respecting, thanking, and truly appreciating what our veterans have done for us! Unfortunately, the sacrifice is often taken for granted. This cannot continue.

On a day when our young people need to be encouraged to focus on the sacrifices that have preserved this great nation, Mark Pocan is prioritizing his own agenda. Today, he is praising the young people of Madison for attending a conference on climate change, where they will be discussing new ideas and ways to stamp out the national security of energy independence and put tyrannical regulations in place that will handicap our economy, farmers, businesses, neighbors, and families.

Instead, we should be exploring new ways to thank our veterans! Ideas such as:

* Equipping our vets to engage in the workforce and community after service by expanding the transfer of applicable military experience and training as college course credits
* Protecting our vets' 2nd Amendment rights, giving them the confidence to seek help for PTSD, depression, and other war-associated mental health without fear of discrimination
* Improving our VA system to put easy access to necessary specialized treatment, accurate diagnoses, and shortened wait times for care within reach of every veteran

These are just a few examples of ways that I will be prioritizing our veterans from the halls of Congress.

I look forward to being able to serve our vets and each one of the constituents of the 2nd Congressional!

Thank you!

Charity Barry

P.S. Don't forget to follow the campaign on social media!

Fellow American,

My name is Kevin Lincoln. I’m a proud United States Marine Corps veteran, and I’m a conservative Republican running for Congress in California’s competitive 9th district.

I joined the Marine Corps in 2001 and became a military police officer. In the aftermath of the September 11th attacks, I was assigned to the White House Military Office attached to the Marine One aircraft – _an assignment of great honor and great responsibility._

**Our mission was to protect and securely transport the President of the United States following the attack on our country.**

[](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=335c754c18d74ba7b26272b336e323d0&_e=AvDfT-QKcf5ysJA_txYrWSWtnzEZh4990J5MS-cuQ4UpWE7dflCxQetWRzjvVxcDPb5WEqo5aSqEEfxaz_xL-uoV1JY-vOmw1xpRFlDgvZuTQwzyhT7uwIcahG3BADlYGt3GE2AzsOQZWErnVD1a-WMcklJ_R6Nn-X_1T0NG6pG3nkQtjOnbQMhqF3ps5CfAI0MCO0Rh0J21qejECBZzYbkKfeNfzni9Fn-JZLf_4s-jsQUW85kmhuMLXjmJfPpUNyy2lT3_sNOuTMLMUpPRJ3_DDuVDg79-sWgG8Uzq2V8pPgOpY-3KIJQt8R792_Rd8FuOXV-rAoHUQVgc3z75Kc0_OCXrNSAcO5vBWmcbTInVDPGvPIMevTsk_JkI91c7)
**Now, I’m stepping up to serve my country again – this time in the House of Representatives.**

[ ** Send a Marine to Congress ➞ **](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=335c754c18d74ba7b26272b336e323d0&_e=AvDfT-QKcf5ysJA_txYrWSWtnzEZh4990J5MS-cuQ4UpWE7dflCxQetWRzjvVxcDPb5WEqo5aSqEEfxaz_xL-uoV1JY-vOmw1xpRFlDgvZuTQwzyhT7uwIcahG3BADlYGt3GE2AzsOQZWErnVD1a-WMcklJ_R6Nn-X_1T0NG6pG3nkQtjOnbQMhqF3ps5CfAI0MCO0Rh0J21qejECBZzYbkKfeNfzni9Fn-JZLf_4s9FfJ34On4BLIabOMOP1lVZuM7V_J3QSSMHi0aPe6M9eebb5EW9-rCK6QsQJLejSw0CTJWzrvqN5m922FRuCu54DS3X3taDVt3Io4ZEsfi3e7qYSO5qygECxmKZhJABtMzlqC7OKO9H4o4_jP49DFX5)
My incumbent Democrat opponent, Josh Harder, is not serving our country. He has failed not just our district, but also those who wear the uniform.

Harder voted AGAINST protecting critical benefits for our veterans and AGAINST raising the pay of our active-duty service men and women. _This is unacceptable!_

**Together, Harder and Biden have failed our veterans and our military.**

**Those who serve our country, along with their families, deserve so much better. In Congress, I will make protecting veterans’ benefits and raising military pay among my top priorities.**

[**If you support our veterans and active-duty military, will you ensure they have a voice in Congress by supporting my campaign with a contribution of $10, $25, $50 or more today?**](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=335c754c18d74ba7b26272b336e323d0&_e=AvDfT-QKcf5ysJA_txYrWSWtnzEZh4990J5MS-cuQ4UpWE7dflCxQetWRzjvVxcDPb5WEqo5aSqEEfxaz_xL-uoV1JY-vOmw1xpRFlDgvZuTQwzyhT7uwIcahG3BADlYGt3GE2AzsOQZWErnVD1a-WMcklJ_R6Nn-X_1T0NG6pG3nkQtjOnbQMhqF3ps5CfAI0MCO0Rh0J21qejECBZzYbkKfeNfzni9Fn-JZLf_4s9Y3zmKug75pOO1htiMxuaDJiQUWaz1_DIh0dlN1I7b0R545s-LiHc_HU3bC00NYyVZ4f344h3NzuA79v0TPtQ8oW_CJonnZ1ei-jkFZmB5jbRmltsiyUnKJ2UGdIuzK1PKar2ahiEKXEI7jW7mybTp)

Together, we can ensure those who fight for us have someone fighting for them.

For America,

Sgt. Kevin Lincoln, USMC (vet)
Republican for Congress

| **Meet Kevin Lincoln
**
My name is Kevin Lincoln, and my story, is the Valley’s story. I am a 3rd generation Stocktonian, raising a 4th generation in the city I love. I’m the grandson of Mexican immigrants, and my stepfather is an Army veteran.

Like many Stocktonians, my family has overcome economic setbacks. My own father struggled to survive on these streets, and was at one time, homeless. But I never let adversity define me. I joined the Marines and served in the White House Military Office, assigned to Marine One. I graduated college while working full-time and raising a family. I’ve worked in corporate America and served our community as a pastor, and as a non-profit leader.

I’m blessed with a beautiful wife, Bonnie, and two amazing children. I’ve lived a life of service, but the greatest honor of my life has been giving back to my community, through serving as Mayor of my hometown, Stockton.

Tom is the proud husband to Rhonda and the proud father to two beautiful daughters. Their family resides in the wonderful city of Westfield, New Jersey. Tom's commitment to the people of New Jersey has been inspired by a legacy of **dedicated public service** from his grandfather, former U.S. Representative Robert Kean, to his father, former Governor Thomas H. Kean Sr. Kean has always understood and recognized the importance of civic engagement and is honored to **represent the people of New Jersey's 7th Congressional District** in Congress. From his early days in the Environmental Protection Agency during the George H.W. Bush Administration (where he met his incredible wife Rhonda), to serving as a volunteer firefighter and an emergency medical technician in Washington, D.C. — Tom has always had a heart for making our world a better, freer, safer place. Determined to answer the call to public service again, Tom Kean Jr. believed he, personally, could turn ideas into action and make a lasting difference in people’s lives. In 2001, Tom was elected to the New Jersey General Assembly, and two years later, was named to the upper house of the state legislature after his tireless work in ethics reform. Then in 2008, his peers unanimously elected him Republican Leader in the New Jersey Senate. Shortly thereafter, he unveiled his caucus’ job creation package, **“Common-Sense Plan for a More Affordable New Jersey,”** which ultimately reversed the course that previous administrations were quickly leading the state down. To this day, Tom continues to build upon his proven track record of delivering for the people of New Jersey in Congress:
* **Passed legislation advocating for Veteran Owned small businesses**
* **Passed legislation to improve commuter rail transportation**

clean_body: Recipe for victory. | | | | | Friend, with the 2024 election racing towards us, here’s our secret recipe for VICTORY: Things are heating up fast, friend. You’ve heard the phrase “too many cooks in the kitchen”, but that doesn’t apply here. Extreme DC Democrats have made it clear: Tom is their top priority for 2024. Thanks, CalliTeam Kean — MEET REP. TOM KEAN, JR. — Tom is the proud husband to Rhonda and the proud father to two beautiful daughters. Their family resides in the wonderful city of Westfield, New Jersey. Tom's commitment to the people of New Jersey has been inspired by a legacy of dedicated public service from his grandfather, former U.S. Representative Robert Kean, to his father, former Governor Thomas H. Kean Sr. Kean has always understood and recognized the importance of civic engagement and is honored to represent the people of New Jersey's 7th Congressional District in Congress. From his early days in the Environmental Protection Agency during the George H.W. Bush Administration (where he met his incredible wife Rhonda), to serving as a volunteer firefighter and an emergency medical technician in Washington, D.C. — Tom has always had a heart for making our world a better, freer, safer place. Determined to answer the call to public service again, Tom Kean Jr. believed he, personally, could turn ideas into action and make a lasting difference in people’s lives. In 2001, Tom was elected to the New Jersey General Assembly, and two years later, was named to the upper house of the state legislature after his tireless work in ethics reform. Then in 2008, his peers unanimously elected him Republican Leader in the New Jersey Senate. Shortly thereafter, he unveiled his caucus’ job creation package, “Common-Sense Plan for a More Affordable New Jersey,” which ultimately reversed the course that previous administrations were quickly leading the state down. To this day, Tom continues to build upon his proven track record of delivering for the people of New Jersey in Congress: Passed legislation advocating for Veteran Owned small businesses Passed legislation to improve commuter rail transportation Passed a resolution affirming strong US support to Ukraine Passed legislation to support mental health for school children And with your continued support today, Tom Kean will be able to defeat Nancy Pelosi’s hand picked opponents that want to take the House Majority in 2024. Fellow Conservative,

As a former Navy SEAL and combat veteran, I’ve seen my fair share of battle. Between my and my wife’s service to our country, we’ve sacrificed years of our lives to make America a more safe and prosperous nation and to protect our God-given freedoms and liberties. We served so that our children and yours might grow up to realize their own American Dreams.

Duty to country. Service and sacrifice over self, **those are the traits that define me**. I’m proud of the work we did for our country. That said, the events of August 2021 rocked me to my core and ultimately led me to **[launch a campaign for the United States Senate this past June.](http://links.conservativesfordjt.com/u/click?_t=05b03ef2209247bcbdad7fd5099cd670&_m=7bc6b5004feb4f7e80c18cdbbda9c6ea&_e=cf2f1l96_pbYT_Ves34qGUKHdv9JrSdKUwrni_q3rFs124jn65KG1RiOWveFEYnf8VC86-etgJisi9PUc-44S9oHkHfVfaiLnXNwZuSDaQNk-6S2BTtKfNjbudz-HBl8_c6u8kw2Y6tUgeG-yBztw30G4-rqCGEcpw_pF589gZmdB-je4evtyyzu8fHxa7lYss182iL9q8i1UCcAzqHKKXwK1r04mtqeCGG2jsi9p0nLohLD0LhpHAbJEEGaNqRsnytFAsIm1zVc60thSsreJ_ZbCWUntme_Au1WiDeucvDu1aT0f2pfbPLv-Gs_cxfQxUC_MYrVIBTBkBDoklE9V383BdwhaDHdI97-aYb91Ysttoud3T4bGIKadUUfi_iZWyvHh4eOuRv1o4kC8jI_pepQjLyMTOb_ZymSk0q_ILQq7xtj-NvzRw4AwhrQ54b6)**

In August 2021, I was putting out wildfires in California by day as part of the aerial firefighting company that I run; by night, my colleagues [many veterans like me] and I were working the phones trying to get our friends and allies out of Afghanistan before the takeover by the Taliban. I remember vividly that at one point I was trying to help an ally **sneak through a tunnel to get him and his family to the airport** so that they could be evacuated on a U.S. military aircraft. The Taliban wanted these high-value targets dead; they wanted their families dead.

[](http://links.conservativesfordjt.com/u/click?_t=05b03ef2209247bcbdad7fd5099cd670&_m=7bc6b5004feb4f7e80c18cdbbda9c6ea&_e=cf2f1l96_pbYT_Ves34qGUKHdv9JrSdKUwrni_q3rFs124jn65KG1RiOWveFEYnf8VC86-etgJisi9PUc-44S9oHkHfVfaiLnXNwZuSDaQNk-6S2BTtKfNjbudz-HBl8_c6u8kw2Y6tUgeG-yBztw30G4-rqCGEcpw_pF589gZmdB-je4evtyyzu8fHxa7lYss182iL9q8i1UCcAzqHKKXwK1r04mtqeCGG2jsi9p0nLohLD0LhpHAbJEEGaNqRsnytFAsIm1zVc60thSsreJyq2Zf8HrM8h_rryxAe-mtDFmaaGdb1pQPIuUOb7EsWu2EHIkubb8wdQt8PRNosJwcwlwdO7HwxC268xS3c0-CJl--cdOirLPAzh-bzLY6VwSh0gIH8AmafvO0PrX7U_lVXHXDhz00qs4Pp6aLTHsVC7mnvrsX5N3uCe7OjKjd4r)
This continued for days. Throughout the entire process, _**“I kept thinking to myself, “The adult will come in the room and say, ‘Hey, this is a disaster; we’re going to stop this.’”**_

Every day it got worse.
Every day it was a disaster.
The adult in the room never materialized.

**Then, 13 Americans were vaporized at the gate to Kabul’s airport.** Billions of dollars in military and human assets were left behind – all so Joe Biden could get a press conference saying that he’d pulled the country out of an “endless war.”

I had sat in the homes of the families that we were frantically trying to get out; I had promised them that we weren’t going to leave them behind. _**So, you can imagine the dishonor that I felt**_ because of the promises we weren’t able to keep to the people who’d sacrificed so much to help us combat evil.

**If you're thinking this email is on the longer side, you're right.** If you're short on time and unable to finish reading to the end right now, **[please do me a quick favor and confirm that I have the correct information on file for you](http://links.conservativesfordjt.com/u/click?_t=05b03ef2209247bcbdad7fd5099cd670&_m=7bc6b5004feb4f7e80c18cdbbda9c6ea&_e=cf2f1l96_pbYT_Ves34qGUKHdv9JrSdKUwrni_q3rFs124jn65KG1RiOWveFEYnfL0TWAazUlB5xIiZcinD9YxnYkYXcucbnesTs6TE-mhtA7XjEDX97judPweVyklvKskXJkPb6J5otKP2FMcfTH-SidMpGwoCK06kD-gwwON-26WjfO2ADVnR_TypGjVUP5RjtC0Kqhc3OTtn2pU6OjsQ73kAlO6BAEzWubfiUiH4RC3J6YdHXJVp7OgSBwQg23iYKf9tlbgRHPwb4p2zQjW2uE2OSkSN6zFMKxDFFLQWvw012Tnp0Oem6lj2KhuDOoMJnwwLJlPAtljY_Z27OuMSuM9f6irp5VUSAW8PWeqmaaiaj2KLcv4Nxo-thDUp7da53VDsECl2w-t6ATxjboEVrHbR7C6s6N1xan-V8bXI%3D)** ; my opponent and his allies will not make winning this seat easy.

[**JOIN OUR FIGHT
ENLIST WITH TIM TODAY->** ](http://links.conservativesfordjt.com/u/click?_t=05b03ef2209247bcbdad7fd5099cd670&_m=7bc6b5004feb4f7e80c18cdbbda9c6ea&_e=cf2f1l96_pbYT_Ves34qGUKHdv9JrSdKUwrni_q3rFs124jn65KG1RiOWveFEYnf8VC86-etgJisi9PUc-44S9oHkHfVfaiLnXNwZuSDaQNk-6S2BTtKfNjbudz-HBl8_c6u8kw2Y6tUgeG-yBztw30G4-rqCGEcpw_pF589gZmdB-je4evtyyzu8fHxa7lYss182iL9q8i1UCcAzqHKKXwK1r04mtqeCGG2jsi9p0nLohLD0LhpHAbJEEGaNqRsnytFAsIm1zVc60thSsreJ7Of1vun6Goq2kXU1Y52lZHaHjt3OtxJgfS1x0iFObPV-cg1GAFgKWlt8uXBw95FHP6B8j-l7WHpqbUXjRD_gK1_jesA42XUi3GtoBbmx7ESfQCn-Tcdm_W8RPKYOs0ppuJagZcpgFlSzslZ-DXwp_5EzdL2YtCtRY11uoJAdore)

It was in the aftermath of the fall of Afghanistan that I ever truly considered entering politics. Deciding to launch a campaign for the United States Senate wasn’t an easy decision; **but the United States needs leaders who understand the sacrifice it’s taken to build our country. When your country calls and needs you, you have to answer. **

[](http://links.conservativesfordjt.com/u/click?_t=05b03ef2209247bcbdad7fd5099cd670&_m=7bc6b5004feb4f7e80c18cdbbda9c6ea&_e=cf2f1l96_pbYT_Ves34qGUKHdv9JrSdKUwrni_q3rFs124jn65KG1RiOWveFEYnf8VC86-etgJisi9PUc-44S9oHkHfVfaiLnXNwZuSDaQNk-6S2BTtKfNjbudz-HBl8_c6u8kw2Y6tUgeG-yBztw30G4-rqCGEcpw_pF589gZmdB-je4evtyyzu8fHxa7lYss182iL9q8i1UCcAzqHKKXwK1r04mtqeCGG2jsi9p0nLohLD0LhpHAbJEEGaNqRsnytFAsIm1zVc60thSsreJwB7vJQNzzzZujscl4sOMkUkMEWZ7vG_D11X_HV76CgrLdlK74tPSTFuMzo6aKKJ3JEFG1wdMmdnWiGFvsvkyzohqk7j9MnE_m96eVdih_N5pN4viWViEDGy-AKn58Ha2Dotx2leEvAmC0iTCvwuxh4KTVOYyKV28ItPrXfzHAek)
**Unlike Joe Biden, I understand what it is to serve our country. Not service in politics, but on the battlefield.** I’ve been wounded in service of our nation; I’ve lost mentors and friends who were willing to make the ultimate sacrifice so that future generations will be free. [**ENLIST WITH TIM
CONFIRM YOUR SUPPORT TODAY->** ](http://links.conservativesfordjt.com/u/click?_t=05b03ef2209247bcbdad7fd5099cd670&_m=7bc6b5004feb4f7e80c18cdbbda9c6ea&_e=cf2f1l96_pbYT_Ves34qGUKHdv9JrSdKUwrni_q3rFs124jn65KG1RiOWveFEYnf8VC86-etgJisi9PUc-44S9oHkHfVfaiLnXNwZuSDaQNk-6S2BTtKfNjbudz-HBl8_c6u8kw2Y6tUgeG-yBztw30G4-rqCGEcpw_pF589gZmdB-je4evtyyzu8fHxa7lYss182iL9q8i1UCcAzqHKKXwK1r04mtqeCGG2jsi9p0nLohLD0LhpHAbJEEGaNqRsnytFAsIm1zVc60thSsreJzFQiT2AWJdmxS7t3E3H-oZU_kMkkCEvhrkZXGb5n0YkwT_El11mFtdBcd7AHTQHBCWA9a5ijcu0QuSmMJA3zFBpPBXVDouINsfsD-0YHMs8L_7nSgBaHJaFsbAPj8j0RWSsT80hMuaNpg8d98thrjfP9qrttt4UfdeYSSJsoQBa)

I’m reaching out to you today because if this campaign to flip Montana’s U.S. Senate seat is going to be successful, **[I’m going to need the help of every conservative donor who reads this letter.](http://links.conservativesfordjt.com/u/click?_t=05b03ef2209247bcbdad7fd5099cd670&_m=7bc6b5004feb4f7e80c18cdbbda9c6ea&_e=cf2f1l96_pbYT_Ves34qGUKHdv9JrSdKUwrni_q3rFs124jn65KG1RiOWveFEYnf8VC86-etgJisi9PUc-44S9oHkHfVfaiLnXNwZuSDaQNk-6S2BTtKfNjbudz-HBl8_c6u8kw2Y6tUgeG-yBztw30G4-rqCGEcpw_pF589gZmdB-je4evtyyzu8fHxa7lYss182iL9q8i1UCcAzqHKKXwK1r04mtqeCGG2jsi9p0nLohLD0LhpHAbJEEGaNqRsnytFAsIm1zVc60thSsreJ0LNDSsft3uyp3dv5nRDY4zvGTX-GLJLlyleFXlXw5LNrgqAg5NgHv4sX-0QqqDYfDoFk2v9J0HtvK0AWKDEu7LoOwnnfo4sxdKy7qQEQg4pkcsXdgVSe5wpjQNgF6r0OhDN-GwuQkpCNkP5GpPN0vQgXg4M3eVdOo9GNVjG7b4_) **

subject: The Supreme Court has never done this before

body:
Add your name if you agree: Supreme Court justices must follow an enforceable code of ethics.

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=1817%2E4032634%2EiVZXCf)
---
Yesterday, for the first time ever, the Supreme Court announced a code of conduct for its justices. It’s an acknowledgment that public trust in the Court has plummeted. But here’s the thing: it doesn’t come with any way to enforce it. In other words, it’s useless. And it won’t restore the American people’s confidence in the Court after hearing about justices receiving secret, lavish gifts — a luxury yacht ride here, a stay at a high-end resort there — from billionaires and business magnates involved in cases before the Court. **If the justices won't step up, Congress must act.** We need an enforceable code of ethics for Supreme Court justices. And with the Court’s latest announcement, we’ve got new momentum to get it done. But Washington needs to hear the American people demanding action. [**Add your name if you agree: we must pass judicial ethics reform to restore the public’s trust in our judicial system.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/ew-em-ethics/?source=EMZ17O_JUD_E_20231114_V1S1&t=8&akid=1817%2E4032634%2EiVZXCf) I’ve also introduced a bill, the Judicial Ethics and Anti-Corruption Act, which would implement important reforms to ethics in the federal judiciary:
* Make the Supreme Court follow a binding Code of Conduct
* Ban federal judges from owning or trading individual stocks
* Tighten restrictions on gifts and privately funded travel
* Overhaul the broken recusal process
* Create new tools to hold judges — including Supreme Court justices — accountable for ethical misconduct

We've got to get this done. The honor system hasn’t been cutting it, pure and simple, and it won’t do the trick now either. When someone has their day in court, they shouldn’t have to wonder whether the judge in front of them is making decisions based on their financial interests rather than the rule of law. I’ll keep working to clean house and restore public confidence in the courts by pushing for an enforceable code of ethics for Supreme Court justices, and working to pass the Judicial Ethics and Anti-Corruption Act. But I can’t do it alone. [**Please add your name to say you support tackling corruption in our federal judiciary — and let’s fight side by side to get this done.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/ew-em-ethics/?source=EMZ17O_JUD_E_20231114_V1S1&t=9&akid=1817%2E4032634%2EiVZXCf) Thanks for being a part of this, Elizabeth

I’m back on the farm this month with Sharla, where we’ll be pulling 16-hour days in the fields now that the peas are ready for harvest.
I love being a farmer. I knew I wanted to take over my family’s farm since I was eight years old. It gets my hands dirty and keeps me grounded. It’s tough—but it reminds me why I fight so hard for Montana’s families.
It also means that since I’ll be working on the farm all month, I have a lot less time to fundraise than our opponents.
And trust me, I hate asking for money. I know how hard you work for every dollar. But the truth is, this race will be the most expensive Senate election in Montana’s history.
Outside groups will pour upwards of $100 million into our state to distort my record and mislead voters. We really do need early money to combat attacks like that. So, here’s the part where I ask:
With farming taking up most of my time this month, we can’t afford to come up short in fundraising. Could you pitch in a split donation between my campaign and Wiley Nickel to help us make up the difference? Peter — We’re officially less than a year away from Election Day. [**I’ll be upfront — in a moment, I’m going to ask to to begin a recurring contribution for the next twelve months, but first, let me tell you why.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/73368278/438267906/-919676807?recurring=12&refcode=AU_TNDP_FR_GEN_GEN_AC60_20231114_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NzEzNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiOWVhM2VkNS00MDgzLWVlMTEtODkyNS0wMDIyNDgzMmU4MTEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=FsHcw3bB88-g5vv01cihhhWKeX9HODVrTM1cz-F_WpA=) Marsha Blackburn. Mark Green. Andy Ogles. The list goes on. These extremist, right-wing candidates will be on the ballot next year, and we’re working to defeat them ALL. Tennessee has garnered a reputation as a deeply-entrenched red state, but if you know your history, you’ll see that it’s just not true. Tennessee used to be a state where Democrats could easily be elected, but partisan gerrymandering handed Republicans the state legislature and a majority of our Congressional seats. **The good news? With their increased attempts to silence the voice of Tennesseans, the GOP has fueled an energy for change like I’ve never seen before.** While our state was thrust into such an unfortunate spotlight, it’s time that this country sees exactly how the GOP legislates here in the Volunteer State. By increasing turnout we can close the margins and gaps necessary to win a more representative government. Together, we can break up the supermajority in the statehouse. Fellow Conservative,

As a former Navy SEAL and combat veteran, I’ve seen my fair share of battle. Between my and my wife’s service to our country, we’ve sacrificed years of our lives to make America a more safe and prosperous nation and to protect our God-given freedoms and liberties. We served so that our children and yours might grow up to realize their own American Dreams.

Duty to country. Service and sacrifice over self, **those are the traits that define me**. I’m proud of the work we did for our country. That said, the events of August 2021 rocked me to my core and ultimately led me to **[launch a campaign for the United States Senate this past June.](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=a37d7620f5714957b389cedcc0b86f86&_e=0zIczR-6DDY8gKZmKDNYzEz7KGuDvYr5ROz8AUuDdJe7tWFXOq9ViMiHKgL80SEGD1NppbjLge8Jqh91dc3hYJdFijEZmz9PS_9bIHHBemqktPj7jnHCxyNWCfCmupswwV75a1B1EbWBvsONeGhzWnsLdTm-M0GAF6V3wefCvb-fvloDbkt6MH3FFKcMR7zNHUQzcBAXfacvuBYzMcqv5HKl1CNVzphf20whOmNFN--eRJRdhhnJzBBByBZyVxitl3Wa8HWUXBX6GleVf7p-AKEhKvG6SBkkbuhsbpG3VMhC8B5K7iicEcH2x9wFtsW50TfSZv7p8RUvCsovhRye0rpgITXpZ9YRPNEiFdXJJJedKzLGoMWK3HahZYcB8ergAC1nOMGTHd4pDfs8yKuYr32l3ybYe-67fGhnEiZw4baFk_WVkWzogWcUR8iq5iRj)**

In August 2021, I was putting out wildfires in California by day as part of the aerial firefighting company that I run; by night, my colleagues [many veterans like me] and I were working the phones trying to get our friends and allies out of Afghanistan before the takeover by the Taliban. I remember vividly that at one point I was trying to help an ally **sneak through a tunnel to get him and his family to the airport** so that they could be evacuated on a U.S. military aircraft. The Taliban wanted these high-value targets dead; they wanted their families dead.

[](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=a37d7620f5714957b389cedcc0b86f86&_e=0zIczR-6DDY8gKZmKDNYzEz7KGuDvYr5ROz8AUuDdJe7tWFXOq9ViMiHKgL80SEGD1NppbjLge8Jqh91dc3hYJdFijEZmz9PS_9bIHHBemqktPj7jnHCxyNWCfCmupswwV75a1B1EbWBvsONeGhzWnsLdTm-M0GAF6V3wefCvb-fvloDbkt6MH3FFKcMR7zNHUQzcBAXfacvuBYzMcqv5HKl1CNVzphf20whOmNFN--eRJRdhhnJzBBByBZyVxitl3Wa8HWUXBX6GleVf7p-AKEhKvG6SBkkbuhsbpG3VMhD9DX2WMDfA0nm1vhrmUX6B2fSuf5lrmn-xPHp1gvHm21ON3y5jz3xYh3hEpmleU2TnGpQS2S4S7ijUo-IYsRdw3lf4XY7wWT2Eho00NP-PuuXNRpJMAmCXqbxmKtdAcBwkKfINT9dSvKDTateMNN8)
This continued for days. Throughout the entire process, _**“I kept thinking to myself, “The adult will come in the room and say, ‘Hey, this is a disaster; we’re going to stop this.’”**_

Every day it got worse.
Every day it was a disaster.
The adult in the room never materialized.

**Then, 13 Americans were vaporized at the gate to Kabul’s airport.** Billions of dollars in military and human assets were left behind – all so Joe Biden could get a press conference saying that he’d pulled the country out of an “endless war.”

I had sat in the homes of the families that we were frantically trying to get out; I had promised them that we weren’t going to leave them behind. _**So, you can imagine the dishonor that I felt**_ because of the promises we weren’t able to keep to the people who’d sacrificed so much to help us combat evil.

**If you're thinking this email is on the longer side, you're right.** If you're short on time and unable to finish reading to the end right now, **[please do me a quick favor and confirm that I have the correct information on file for you](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=a37d7620f5714957b389cedcc0b86f86&_e=0zIczR-6DDY8gKZmKDNYzEz7KGuDvYr5ROz8AUuDdJe7tWFXOq9ViMiHKgL80SEGWu5ykLyNb2LxYos0f2eEZCziuYUbA9fanMGZGYqnFx1Qnl33XXHBK9H06diHQXbkgaTVe2-eZQbJqPna61Z4TLI3RzWNmzlfBDQ9zmE59jiQcVXMYyAlqjd-nSXkKKUexKW8s-sqm6uM6k-txV-OhThj1uGNW1HPq9oOahGuNFixlKuhnN1FwT5krYLFy2ieIgnHrxWSUPBK6fBPgI__6puFkSUTRDxh3TxGezkr_0FszFNhJx5VuCJIyMmXrtaC6DTEPuoLOC6av-KVlqggiGILbcSDM2FzXLshcBYjRSyY921d0n-9oEkT_B1uZN2cE95AYhWnB5yn10_f8Wl1FmytncdpvX8c7XvaKZjeLTg%3D)** ; my opponent and his allies will not make winning this seat easy.

[**JOIN OUR FIGHT
ENLIST WITH TIM TODAY->** ](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=a37d7620f5714957b389cedcc0b86f86&_e=0zIczR-6DDY8gKZmKDNYzEz7KGuDvYr5ROz8AUuDdJe7tWFXOq9ViMiHKgL80SEGD1NppbjLge8Jqh91dc3hYJdFijEZmz9PS_9bIHHBemqktPj7jnHCxyNWCfCmupswwV75a1B1EbWBvsONeGhzWnsLdTm-M0GAF6V3wefCvb-fvloDbkt6MH3FFKcMR7zNHUQzcBAXfacvuBYzMcqv5HKl1CNVzphf20whOmNFN--eRJRdhhnJzBBByBZyVxitl3Wa8HWUXBX6GleVf7p-AKEhKvG6SBkkbuhsbpG3VMj3yIV07N26VBH1B6ctLoVJntJfTHTYN_-e-HTD9nGCUupuQ7GKBWfcujVcRaGz5WJRCm_mK3r-zqfUtpO7vI35h3D8BfzRkbkB1tcRjmstI9uo8U_li1e8vaocV6ziSyBu7TAevuVSmCN8UXQJC6Bb)

It was in the aftermath of the fall of Afghanistan that I ever truly considered entering politics. Deciding to launch a campaign for the United States Senate wasn’t an easy decision; **but the United States needs leaders who understand the sacrifice it’s taken to build our country. When your country calls and needs you, you have to answer. **

[](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=a37d7620f5714957b389cedcc0b86f86&_e=0zIczR-6DDY8gKZmKDNYzEz7KGuDvYr5ROz8AUuDdJe7tWFXOq9ViMiHKgL80SEGD1NppbjLge8Jqh91dc3hYJdFijEZmz9PS_9bIHHBemqktPj7jnHCxyNWCfCmupswwV75a1B1EbWBvsONeGhzWnsLdTm-M0GAF6V3wefCvb-fvloDbkt6MH3FFKcMR7zNHUQzcBAXfacvuBYzMcqv5HKl1CNVzphf20whOmNFN--eRJRdhhnJzBBByBZyVxitl3Wa8HWUXBX6GleVf7p-AKEhKvG6SBkkbuhsbpG3VMgXbucgQYVeULC_NFxqqnX37JruxS_sWngvP0MIj8XQOstJrdt_x84PZru6XQhWHqLZyngf_Jwpr_aUeXT4bwdTh4x39S2tu3P9hKedOox5YkKGpJh4_DU3QeW44_q-4BH1LMMjr_lsLAr2RK0GvzxR)
**Unlike Joe Biden, I understand what it is to serve our country. Not service in politics, but on the battlefield.** I’ve been wounded in service of our nation; I’ve lost mentors and friends who were willing to make the ultimate sacrifice so that future generations will be free. [**ENLIST WITH TIM
CONFIRM YOUR SUPPORT TODAY->** ](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=a37d7620f5714957b389cedcc0b86f86&_e=0zIczR-6DDY8gKZmKDNYzEz7KGuDvYr5ROz8AUuDdJe7tWFXOq9ViMiHKgL80SEGD1NppbjLge8Jqh91dc3hYJdFijEZmz9PS_9bIHHBemqktPj7jnHCxyNWCfCmupswwV75a1B1EbWBvsONeGhzWnsLdTm-M0GAF6V3wefCvb-fvloDbkt6MH3FFKcMR7zNHUQzcBAXfacvuBYzMcqv5HKl1CNVzphf20whOmNFN--eRJRdhhnJzBBByBZyVxitl3Wa8HWUXBX6GleVf7p-AKEhKvG6SBkkbuhsbpG3VMjIYwjX729-rddIJtjkv7BZxQ0TQECvr_p_ECbjLHuP7YF0tLOFQTC4OgC_0eM8nHwgd5Ij5cmA6ihfNWlCw5kHNL2ES8l01VCmZ1iQBw7KhDoBoZx7dcpBajkJEYwU6g7gnZuEHrU6HDt2WABAbWXT)

I’m reaching out to you today because if this campaign to flip Montana’s U.S. Senate seat is going to be successful, **[I’m going to need the help of every conservative donor who reads this letter.](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=a37d7620f5714957b389cedcc0b86f86&_e=0zIczR-6DDY8gKZmKDNYzEz7KGuDvYr5ROz8AUuDdJe7tWFXOq9ViMiHKgL80SEGD1NppbjLge8Jqh91dc3hYJdFijEZmz9PS_9bIHHBemqktPj7jnHCxyNWCfCmupswwV75a1B1EbWBvsONeGhzWnsLdTm-M0GAF6V3wefCvb-fvloDbkt6MH3FFKcMR7zNHUQzcBAXfacvuBYzMcqv5HKl1CNVzphf20whOmNFN--eRJRdhhnJzBBByBZyVxitl3Wa8HWUXBX6GleVf7p-AKEhKvG6SBkkbuhsbpG3VMgzpSXl2LN_wdXNavTkR2EVF_HKhSi3-s_mvgFoesW4VACqc1zPHJEt8B-ALEMuopd0lN_kJpPpbyK_lHLHRZdSo6YPlH-Rg9DO7natTpNV4WNnnzYqK884XT3fS5iZ2_HzK-wBiRIaVcC0gxFLlExd) **

Twice in a row, Joe Biden has pulled us out of two wars for political purposes.

We fought in Iraq, _**I was there.**_ We fought in Afghanistan, _**I was there.**_

And each time, for political purposes, Biden pulled out our forces and damaged our nation’s reputation in the process. And my opponent in the Senate race, Democrat Jon Tester, supported Biden both times.

I want to look at my children and tell them, _**“Yes, you should serve your country, as your mom and dad did. Your parents put on the uniform; you should do the same.”**_

[](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=a37d7620f5714957b389cedcc0b86f86&_e=0zIczR-6DDY8gKZmKDNYzEz7KGuDvYr5ROz8AUuDdJe7tWFXOq9ViMiHKgL80SEGD1NppbjLge8Jqh91dc3hYJdFijEZmz9PS_9bIHHBemqktPj7jnHCxyNWCfCmupswwV75a1B1EbWBvsONeGhzWnsLdTm-M0GAF6V3wefCvb-fvloDbkt6MH3FFKcMR7zNHUQzcBAXfacvuBYzMcqv5HKl1CNVzphf20whOmNFN--eRJRdhhnJzBBByBZyVxitl3Wa8HWUXBX6GleVf7p-AKEhKvG6SBkkbuhsbpG3VMjJBQC3wRz94A8e8W250eRtz5peIo5nN4mpOxPH94NPGoshnJ5e9FwXqsomGqiOFZKT7qOlyPfShvr-iFbpaYshZFYHGfPR_4vofHYOmH5R3hcRt4hK0pFPI4trJvObXmqka6iRIXX1ticvop2x3vvj)
**But when we have a president who is willing to pull the plug on a whim for political purposes, it’s hard to tell future generations the sacrifices in service of God and country will be worth it.**

clean_body: The day 13 Americans were vaporized at the entrance to the Kabul airport was the first time I’d ever considered serving in government again | | Fellow Conservative, As a former Navy SEAL and combat veteran, I’ve seen my fair share of battle. Between my and my wife’s service to our country, we’ve sacrificed years of our lives to make America a more safe and prosperous nation and to protect our God-given freedoms and liberties. We served so that our children and yours might grow up to realize their own American Dreams. Duty to country. Service and sacrifice over self, those are the traits that define me. I’m proud of the work we did for our country. That said, the events of August 2021 rocked me to my core and ultimately led me to In August 2021, I was putting out wildfires in California by day as part of the aerial firefighting company that I run; by night, my colleagues [many veterans like me] and I were working the phones trying to get our friends and allies out of Afghanistan before the takeover by the Taliban. I remember vividly that at one point I was trying to help an ally sneak through a tunnel to get him and his family to the airport so that they could be evacuated on a U.S. military aircraft. The Taliban wanted these high-value targets dead; they wanted their families dead. This continued for days. Throughout the entire process, “I kept thinking to myself, “The adult will come in the room and say, ‘Hey, this is a disaster; we’re going to stop this.’” Every day it got worse. Every day it was a disaster. The adult in the room never materialized. Then, 13 Americans were vaporized at the gate to Kabul’s airport. Billions of dollars in military and human assets were left behind – all so Joe Biden could get a press conference saying that he’d pulled the country out of an “endless war.” I had sat in the homes of the families that we were frantically trying to get out; I had promised them that we weren’t going to leave them behind. So, you can imagine the dishonor that I felt because of the promises we weren’t able to keep to the people who’d sacrificed so much to help us combat evil. If you're thinking this email is on the longer side, you're right. If you're short on time and unable to finish reading to the end right now, ; my opponent and his allies will not make winning this seat easy. It was in the aftermath of the fall of Afghanistan that I ever truly considered entering politics. Deciding to launch a campaign for the United States Senate wasn’t an easy decision; but the United States needs leaders who understand the sacrifice it’s taken to build our country. When your country calls and needs you, you have to answer. Unlike Joe Biden, I understand what it is to serve our country. Not service in politics, but on the battlefield. I’ve been wounded in service of our nation; I’ve lost mentors and friends who were willing to make the ultimate sacrifice so that future generations will be free. I’m reaching out to you today because if this campaign to flip Montana’s U.S. Senate seat is going to be successful, Twice in a row, Joe Biden has pulled us out of two wars for political purposes. We fought in Iraq, I was there. We fought in Afghanistan, I was there. And each time, for political purposes, Biden pulled out our forces and damaged our nation’s reputation in the process. And my opponent in the Senate race, Democrat Jon Tester, supported Biden both times. I want to look at my children and tell them, “Yes, you should serve your country, as your mom and dad did. Your parents put on the uniform; you should do the same.” But when we have a president who is willing to pull the plug on a whim for political purposes, it’s hard to tell future generations the sacrifices in service of God and country will be worth it. So, Fellow Conservative \- that’s what I’m fighting for. I’m fighting to restore faith in our American way of life. SkyTree Book Fair and I did a deep dive and discovered the cause of why sexually explicit and disgusting books get into our children’s schools, classrooms, and libraries.

name: Mazie Hirono
subject: Better late than never
body:
|
#
Peter, Yesterday, the Supreme Court announced a first-ever Code of Conduct for all Supreme Court justices. This comes after numerous reports alleging that Justice Clarence Thomas and Justice Samuel Alito accepted luxurious gifts and vacations worth hundreds of thousands of dollars from prominent right-wing activists and GOP megadonors — some of whom had business in front of the Court. And it comes after months of our advocacy calling for the Supreme Court to hold its justices accountable and preserve whatever legitimacy it has left so that Americans can be confident they will get a fair shake. **My reaction?__Better late than never.__** Let’s be clear: this is a necessary step forward. The Court’s release of a written Code that Americans can view and judge against their behavior, was needed. **I hope that it means I will never have to read another story about a conservative billionaire wining and dining a Supreme Court justice.** But something’s missing: **_there is no enforcement mechanism for this code of conduct._** That will need to change. **I will continue watching this space very closely, and I know this team will too. But no matter what, I will not be afraid to speak plainly about what I see coming from this ideologically-driven Supreme Court — from their unbridled attack on the freedoms and bodily autonomy of women to their blatant misconduct and conflicts of interest.** [**So please, Peter, add a donation today to support my work advocating for a fair, just, and transparent federal judiciary — free of corruption and conservative extremism. #

I’m at a loss, Peter.
Kari Lake announced her campaign on Tuesday, October 10th.
We saw a huge swing of support — endorsements, media coverage, and most importantly to our ultimate chances at winning this race, donations.
It was an incredible moment, honestly.
But this month, things started to taper off a bit. Sorry to be so blunt here, but to beat Kari Lake and Kyrsten Sinema, we can’t have bad days moving forward.
And with our mid-month deadline tomorrow at midnight, we really need to see a surge of support to stay on track to our goals. These deadlines help us mark our progress, and our goals aren’t arbitrary. They are critical benchmarks that help us make important funding decisions.
These goals are what we need to raise to win — to beat Kari Lake.
Now, I never thought I’d have to ask so many people I’ve never met to support me and help me defend our Senate majority. But that is what I have to do. I have to ask you for your help.

Peter,

My name is Kevin Lincoln. I’m a proud United States Marine Corps veteran, and I’m a conservative Republican running for Congress in California’s competitive 9th district.

I joined the Marine Corps in 2001 and became a military police officer. In the aftermath of the September 11th attacks, I was assigned to the White House Military Office attached to the Marine One aircraft – _an assignment of great honor and great responsibility._

**Our mission was to protect and securely transport the President of the United States following the attack on our country.**

[](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=14f580e48b9743fda66a0cd373f88a90&_e=hBQmbldAc-ms0SCdBSWkgmf3kWTONSkYjKgeYz9Y1N80NzSE61cVAJyOZ7mGmLpmthc-tdpml8YJs-0EZM1FvjZZq__OtRpW3gKrqpQYcXP4vUV9acvEfganT1Ff3B2hxw1iMQ3Q_E6RTUC8YHKwv6-IpK8qbnOa539XXfIVi40YHEgEMOyjFCS2fXq-iehj8wjNLVmOr9-WjkZpF_T6zHvWXGR2E6XzfJtvW6cxpTBArLo1vBg8UfGNMtqUa0yBvLMZUPv0kkIDp9pDGX1JDZCVGEQUYAqPmuVRmlQ8iLPR2ByhJDbSzP7cDU0w_a13DmNMmmUDWqtKZsaepZnph0IZvLZ8xq1jbLbZ0s_asnir5ABy8YWgoookz8234OSe)
**Now, I’m stepping up to serve my country again – this time in the House of Representatives.**

[ ** Send a Marine to Congress ➞ **](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=14f580e48b9743fda66a0cd373f88a90&_e=hBQmbldAc-ms0SCdBSWkgmf3kWTONSkYjKgeYz9Y1N80NzSE61cVAJyOZ7mGmLpmthc-tdpml8YJs-0EZM1FvjZZq__OtRpW3gKrqpQYcXP4vUV9acvEfganT1Ff3B2hxw1iMQ3Q_E6RTUC8YHKwv6-IpK8qbnOa539XXfIVi40YHEgEMOyjFCS2fXq-iehj8wjNLVmOr9-WjkZpF_T6zHvWXGR2E6XzfJtvW6cxpTACUIQ0yaK1tsgQclcKdqT5ZjSl743bICrKAfHzqhY1vMVw3K5Apk8JTtqCdistyP-QQDGshfqJE7XkqqUV4kqcmc-gULISuJSdR4MubMZwMCfgnGIP2X8iX08ZyKZ1jwtBFxhYpoIWpcuTrIKhorSc)
My incumbent Democrat opponent, Josh Harder, is not serving our country. He has failed not just our district, but also those who wear the uniform.

Harder voted AGAINST protecting critical benefits for our veterans and AGAINST raising the pay of our active-duty service men and women. _This is unacceptable!_

**Together, Harder and Biden have failed our veterans and our military.**

**Those who serve our country, along with their families, deserve so much better. In Congress, I will make protecting veterans’ benefits and raising military pay among my top priorities.**

[**If you support our veterans and active-duty military, will you ensure they have a voice in Congress by supporting my campaign with a contribution of $10, $25, $50 or more today?**](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=14f580e48b9743fda66a0cd373f88a90&_e=hBQmbldAc-ms0SCdBSWkgmf3kWTONSkYjKgeYz9Y1N80NzSE61cVAJyOZ7mGmLpmthc-tdpml8YJs-0EZM1FvjZZq__OtRpW3gKrqpQYcXP4vUV9acvEfganT1Ff3B2hxw1iMQ3Q_E6RTUC8YHKwv6-IpK8qbnOa539XXfIVi40YHEgEMOyjFCS2fXq-iehj8wjNLVmOr9-WjkZpF_T6zHvWXGR2E6XzfJtvW6cxpTB4bTDeGV7Jj7L4UHb5t6spVx8lAQ_a06Nzf7xgO9pQrLeevZ2TGW8A277_wQ4IUsCgzRxSEUonxZwgF4vQi0P5qRyQP_LWBihdmBoV66IxfLon025aWHpKrLrt7hGI51H0X9YBQQYwN-HKVY-_zMWY)

Together, we can ensure those who fight for us have someone fighting for them.

For America,

Sgt. Kevin Lincoln, USMC (vet)
Republican for Congress

| **Meet Kevin Lincoln
**
My name is Kevin Lincoln, and my story, is the Valley’s story. I am a 3rd generation Stocktonian, raising a 4th generation in the city I love. I’m the grandson of Mexican immigrants, and my stepfather is an Army veteran.

Like many Stocktonians, my family has overcome economic setbacks. My own father struggled to survive on these streets, and was at one time, homeless. But I never let adversity define me. I joined the Marines and served in the White House Military Office, assigned to Marine One. I graduated college while working full-time and raising a family. I’ve worked in corporate America and served our community as a pastor, and as a non-profit leader.

I’m blessed with a beautiful wife, Bonnie, and two amazing children. I’ve lived a life of service, but the greatest honor of my life has been giving back to my community, through serving as Mayor of my hometown, Stockton.

clean_body: I’m stepping up to serve my country again – this time in the House of Representatives. | | Peter, My name is Kevin Lincoln. I’m a proud United States Marine Corps veteran, and I’m a conservative Republican running for Congress in California’s competitive 9th district. I joined the Marine Corps in 2001 and became a military police officer. In the aftermath of the September 11th attacks, I was assigned to the White House Military Office attached to the Marine One aircraft – an assignment of great honor and great responsibility. Our mission was to protect and securely transport the President of the United States following the attack on our country. Now, I’m stepping up to serve my country again – this time in the House of Representatives. My incumbent Democrat opponent, Josh Harder, is not serving our country. He has failed not just our district, but also those who wear the uniform. Harder voted AGAINST protecting critical benefits for our veterans and AGAINST raising the pay of our active-duty service men and women. This is unacceptable! Together, Harder and Biden have failed our veterans and our military. Those who serve our country, along with their families, deserve so much better. In Congress, I will make protecting veterans’ benefits and raising military pay among my top priorities. Together, we can ensure those who fight for us have someone fighting for them. As the only veteran in this race, I feel a responsibility to step up and lead with the conviction I'll never shake from my time in the service. I believe our country deserves a Commander-in-Chief who truly understands what we're fighting for and what we're fighting against. _The gravity of the situation we're now facing is nothing short of_** _dire_** _._ Our nation's once-proud fighting force has been infected and paralyzed by a political agenda, our military recruitment levels have reached an all-time low, and yet we are expected to salute our "Commander-in-Chief," Joe Biden. Not only is this a slap in the face to the veterans across this country, but it is an insult to _every_ soldier who has come before our time:
* Those 56 men who pledged their lives in Independence Hall in 1776 so that they could create a new nation conceived in liberty.

* Our nation's first Republican President who stood at a cemetery in Gettysburg and pledged this nation to a new birth of freedom.

* That band of brothers who stormed the beaches of Normandy, defeated the Nazis, and saved this world.

As a veteran, as a former Congressman, as Governor, and as a father, I have remained steadfast in my devotion to reminding those who will listen of the words of Ronald Reagan: **_Freedom is one generation away from extinction; it's not passed along in the bloodstream, and it must be protected and cultivated._** Today, I am humbly asking you for support to help me fire Joe Biden and restore**this mission and sanity, pride, integrity, and capability** to the chief office of our military.
